videos.title: Mel Gibson, Christine Lahti, Joni Mitchell
videos.overview: NYC Marathon winner Giacomo Leone runs through the set, while Mel Gibson presents ""Top Ten Lines You'll Never Hear Me, Mel Gibson, Say in a Movie.""

videos.title: Marisa Tomei, James Carville, John Michael Montgomery
videos.overview: It's the day after Election '96, so Dave tells his last ""Bob Dole is old"" joke.  Also, Dave fidgets with his unusually long tie, while Calvert conducts exit polls.

videos.title: Brett Butler, Gary Sinise, Bob McCoy
videos.overview: During Mailbag, a viewer pleads for no more Dole jokes, so ""Bob Dole"" (Calvert) appears on stage and sings Lionel Richie's ""Say You, Say Me,"" a pop ditty which includes the immortal lines, ""I had a dream; I had an awesome dream.""

videos.title: Bob Dole, Ted Koppel, Mary Chapin Carpenter
videos.overview: Ten noteworthy anchormen appear in the top ten list while Dave chats with recently denied presidential candidate Bob Dole.

videos.title: Jeff Bridges, Diane Sawyer, Bryan White
videos.overview: It's the official 3rd Anniversary special, with clips and highlights from the past three seasons.

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Kristin Scott Thomas, Alan Jackson
videos.overview: Biff interrupts Dave's monologue ""just to be on TV;"" Kristen Scott Thomas plugs â€˜The English Patient.""

videos.title: Ron Howard, Patrick Ewing, Gene Catron
videos.overview: Saxaphonist Joshua Redman sits in; Gene Catron performs a trick involving dominoes and a pool ball; Dave gives out candy.

videos.title: Tony Randall, Wendy Liebman, Helena Bonham Carter
videos.overview: Dave's artificial tooth comes loose, while Ed McMahon imitates Leonard Tepper's impression of the former ""Tonight Show"" sidekick.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Anthony Edwards, Natalie Cole
videos.overview: From Chicago: Paul meets his long-lost brother Matt Shaffer on ""Jerry Springer"" just as Dave was going to admit to being a transvestite.  Also, Dave introduces ten citizens with distinct names for ""Top Ten Our Favorite Illinois Names."" His choice for #1, Springfield resident Minnie Cocke, has her mug displayed on the United Center jumbotron.

videos.title: Sarah Ferguson, Derek Jeter, Reba McEntire
videos.overview: Throughout the night, audience members walk onstage to tell jokes.

videos.title: Heather Locklear, Sinbad, Tony Toni Tone
videos.overview: Dave calls a desk jockey from across the street named Samantha Giafoni, asking for her opinion about Michael Jackson.  After calling her, autumn leaves are dumped in her office.

videos.title: Glenn Close, Marc Maron, Eriq LaSalle
videos.overview: Glenn Close promotes the live-action remake of ""101 Dalmations.""

videos.title: Phil Hartman, Bob Costas, Luther Vandross
videos.overview: When Dave gives a ham to an audience guy, he gives him five more when he says it's going to a senior citizens' group.  Soon enough, Biff practically gives him the whole store.

videos.title: Kid Inventors, Will Smith, Jimmy Buffett
videos.overview: Friday Night on the Road finishes in Miami, Florida. It's so hot in the Coconut Grove Playhouse that Dave strips off his suit and hosts the show in his khakis and t-shirt: ""This is exactly what rehearsal looks like.""

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow, Delroy Lindo, Wynonna
videos.overview: A ""News in Review"" segment is translated into Chinese, while Dave accidentally cuts himself while crawling under his desk.

videos.title: Jeff Daniels, Dolly Parton
videos.overview: John Popper of Blues Traveler sits in, and later he performs with Dolly Parton.

videos.title: Martin Short, Scott Bryan, Rita Wilson
videos.overview: Thanksgiving and the holidays are the topics du jour in the latest edition of ""Dave Talks to Kids.""

videos.title: Lea Thompson, Natalie Portman, Stone Temple Pilots
videos.overview: Gerard makes a cameo in the annual ""Thanksgiving Day Quiz,"" while Dorothy bakes cherry and hickory nut pies.

videos.title: Teri Hatcher, Brent Spiner, Luscious Jackson
videos.overview: After Dave offers a million dollars claiming that there's no such person named Sivareddy Gotike, whose letter was read on the CBS Mailbag the week before, Sivareddy appears on the show to collect. Dave offers him and his friend Srinivas a hotel room, dinner at Tad's, dinner at the 21 Club, two tickets to ""Cats,"" two tickets to a Jets game, a camera, car service, and dates instead.

videos.title: John Cleese, Martha Stewart, David Copperfield
videos.overview: Biff gives out hams to the audience during the second-ever appearance of ""Know Your Current Events,"" while Martha Stewart shows Dave how to make a scented wreath.

videos.title: Nicole Kidman, Laura Dern, Gloria Estefan
videos.overview: Dave announces he's #45 on TV Guide's greatest stars list; after interviewing Nicole Kidman, Dave is dyspeptic and demands a roll of Tums®; the roof cam reveals Santa dumping a corpse in a garbage disposal.

videos.title: Kenneth Branaugh, Bonnie Hunt, Counting Crows
videos.overview: Dave calls the corner pay phones, but no one answers. He finally steps outside and tells anyone to pick up the phone. After some guy named Phil answers it, Dave has to scream at him to come inside.

videos.title: James Woods, Bob Odenkirk, Counting Crows
videos.overview: 1996: Two merchant marines do push-ups onstage; Dave and Paul reprise the roles of their alter egos, Gator and Skunk; Leonard Tepper performs in the Late Show ""kid's nativity play""; Counting Crows appear for the second night in a row.

videos.title: Albert Brooks, Beavis & Butthead, Neil Diamond
videos.overview: Skunk and Gator hang out in the green room; Beavis and Butthead plug their upcoming movie; Paul performs an original holiday number.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Mathias Pakula, Faith Hill
videos.overview: Somebody named Matias Paluka is interviewed by Dave, then does a weather forecast.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, Jimmie Walker, Rhett Atkins
videos.overview: Tony sits in the audience, while Rupert shows Dave a ""Tickle Me Giuliani"" doll.

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr., Walter Cronkite
videos.overview: Mayor Giuliani shows up to put an apple on the Christmas tree, then gets in on a few pictures with Dave, Paul, and two audience members.  Also, hockey great Gordie Howe calls Dave.

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Neve Campbell, Dave Matthews Band
videos.overview: During a ""New for Christmas"" segment, Biff is nearly injured by a motorized hula hoop; Neve Campbell promotes ""Scream.""

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Cuba Gooding Jr., Darlene Love
videos.overview: Dave hugs a male audience member; fake snow falls on the backdrop, then on the audience; Darlene Love (featuring Bette Sussman) continues her holiday tradition of singing ""Christmas (Baby, Please Come Home).""

videos.title: John Travolta, Julianna Marguiles, St. Luke's Bottle Band
videos.overview: Midway through Dave's interview with ""Michael"" star John Travolta, the buxom president of John's fan club gets a hug and an autograph.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Kelly Preston, Rich Hall
Jane Pauley, Robert Pastorelli, Blues Traveler
videos.overview: John Popper of Blues Traveler sits in, while Biff gives dating tips.

videos.title: Mary Tyler Moore, Jerry O'Connell, Oseola McCarty, Deana Carter
videos.overview: Calvert DeForest is live at Times Square as the show is taped hours earlier.  Tom Arnold appears again on New Year's Eve, this time without Roseanne.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Kamarr, Joe Queenan
videos.overview: Calvert DeForest is live at Times Square as the show is taped hours earlier; Tom Arnold appears again on New Year's Eve, this time without Roseanne; Biff gets scissors from Dave to get rid of the Cabbage Patch doll chewing on his ear; Kamarr the Discount Magician tries in vain to impress the audience.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Cast of Chicago
videos.overview: Dave introduces an audience member named Tara to Alec Baldwin; Dave shows a drawing of him in a 70's-era leisure suit; from the hit Broadway revival ""Chicago,"" Bebe Neuwirth and Ann Reinking perform ""And All That Jazz.""

videos.title: Courtney Cox, Lee Marek, Damon Hill
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, a viewer asks what Dave did for New Year's.  Dave flashes back to a wild night with a bunch of fabulous babes, while Paul brings him back to earth, and Dave flashes back to a night spent at the laundromat drinking Tide.

videos.title: Kids Tell Jokes, Tracey Ullman, B.B. King
videos.overview: BB King sits in; Dave accidentally tears up the Top Ten blue card, so he reads the list via teleprompter; Tracey Ullman promotes her new HBO show, ""Tracey Takes On...""

videos.title: Ray Liotta,  Norm MacDonald
videos.overview: Dave swipes Tony's gum, which he had tried to hide on top of one of the cameras.  Also, Rupert of Hello Deli is pitted against Amando of Stage Deli in a little competition called ""The King of Meats."" It was a close battle throughout, but Amando ends up victorious.

videos.title: Woody Harrelson, Jackie Chan, John Pizzarelli
videos.overview: Dave fondly looks back at the one-year anniversary of ""El Blizzardo,"" then does a spit take with Windex®.  Also, Woody Harrelson plugs hemp products and The People vs. Larry Flint.

videos.title: Matt Dillon,  Rebecca Ramijn, Cassandra Wilson
videos.overview: Dave sends an audience babe out to get some snow, and throughout the night the show is interrupted by a three-way snowball war between Dave, Inky and Anton.

videos.title: Eddie Murphy, Dwight Yoakam, Veronica Paridee
videos.overview: An audience member celebrating her birthday dances onstage; Inky threatens to throw a rock at Dave; Dave chats with a nine-year-old girl that delivered her baby brother in a stuck elevator; Inky settles his differences and dances with Kim the audience girl.

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Madeline Kahn, Harry Hill
videos.overview: Dave deems the show to be such a success that he announces the production of four spin-offs, ""Rupert Touches Meat,"" ""Leonard's Candid Camera,"" ""Kenny's Baywatch"" (with the stagehands running in slow motion), and ""Late Show with Carlos Huaycaga.""

videos.title: Penelope Ann Miller, Skeet Ulrich, BR5-49
videos.overview: It's time for another Late Show experiment: ""Who Will Get Kicked Out of TGIF's Sooner, a Shirtless Guy or a Guy with Ten Dogs?"" Answer: the shirtless guy.  Later, Dave instructs Chris from the audience to negotiate with TGIF (where he works), and soon enough, everyone is allowed inside.

videos.title: Chris O'Donnell, Debbie Reynolds, Yo Yo Ma, Edgar Meyer, Mark O'Conner
videos.overview: Dave shows QVC footage of a Cabbage Patch Bill Clinton doll eating French fries; Actor Chris O'Donnell does a Stupid Human Trick; the drama class from Calhoun High School re-enacts the first half of the show.

videos.title: Tom Selleck, Art Donovan, Babyface
videos.overview: Paul shows a clip of his new home video ""The Late Show Made Easy,"" while ""Know Your Cuts of Meat"" makes its debut on ""Know Your Current Events.""

videos.title: Kevin Kline, Kevin Sorbo, Kevin Brennan
videos.overview: It's an ""All Kevin Spectacular"" as Kevin Kline, Kevin Sorbo, and Kevin Brennan guest on the show. The closing credits on the show include all staffers named Kevin (Kevin Burnett, Kevin Foley, Kevin Gaines, Kevin Mulligan [actually the name of Gerard's son], and so on).

videos.title: David Schwimmer, Carmen Electra, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: Alan interrupts the monologue to comment on yesterday's Packers-Patriots Super Bowl; an audience member receives Dave's autograph; Calvert reports from New Orleans, where football fans are still celebrating after yesterday's championship.

videos.title: Tony Danza, Desmond Howard, Helena Bonham Carter
videos.overview: Biff presides over another segment of ""What They Would Have Had for Lunch If They Were Still Alive."" Tonight, Lorne Greene: ""a BLT."" Also, Tony Williams sits in on drums, while Dave introduces Paul as ""Little Jimmy Dickens.""

videos.title: Dan Rather, Jane Leeves, Tori Amos
videos.overview: Dave calls up an audience guy to meet Tori Amos, but he has to frisk him first.

videos.title: Matthew Perry, Natasha Lyonne, Jewel
videos.overview: Dave shows a promo of ""Rupert Jee's Private Parts,"" a spoof of the upcoming Howard Stern movie.  Amongst those who participate in this parody are Rupert, Leonard, and ""Paul Shaffer as â€˜David Letterman.'""

videos.title: Rhea Perlman, Ray Ramano, Ice Cube
Stupid Human Tricks, Elle MacPherson, Charles Barkley
videos.overview: Dave celebrates a decade and a half in late night television by introducing some of his favorite Stupid Human Tricks.  Later, he chats with basketball star Charles Barkley.

videos.title: Isabella Rossellini, Billy Bob Thorton, Tokyo Shock Boys
videos.overview: In honor of the re-release of the entire Star Wars trilogy, Dave moves his coffee mug with a little help from ""the force"";  Billy Bob Thornton promotes his Academy Award-nominated film Sling Blade; the acrobatic Tokyo Stunt Boys bomb in their first (and ultimately only) American television performance.

videos.title: Fran Drescher, Eva Herzigova, Tony Bennett
videos.overview: Flugelhorn great Al Chez sits in with the band, while Leonard appears in a educational film about the First Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Pierce Brosnan, Lance Alstodt, Brian Regan
videos.overview: Know Your Current Events: Dave promises an audience participant named Brian (who Dave keeps calling ""Larry"") that if he can kick a field goal outside, he can sit onstage. Brian hits the field goal post at 20 yards and wins his onstage seat.

videos.title: Brett Favre, David Spade, Silverchair
videos.overview: Mailbag: Paul appears in a commercial for ""Uncle Dave's Non-Alcoholic Gin.""  Also, Dave and Green Bay Packers QB Brett Farve throw footballs into cabs, and David Spade promotes his new sitcom, ""Just Shoot Me.""

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Brett Butler, Fugees
videos.overview: In a remote featuring Dave talking to various fan club presidents, a swordfight breaks out between the ""Cats"" and ""Star Wars"" fans.  Also, Bob Borden professes his love to a disturbed Martha Stewart.

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker, Geoffrey Rush, Barry Manilow
videos.overview: Dave ponders another one of his deep thoughts: ""How Long Can a Guy Spin a Revolving Door Before Somebody Stops Him?"" It takes 40 minutes and 6 seconds before security escorts the man out.

videos.title: Richard Harris, Siskel & Ebert, Far East Circus
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Biff, Pat and Kenny recreate scenes from Academy Award-nominated films, including ""The English Patient"" and ""Jerry McGuire.""  The gag comes to an abrupt end when, while attempting to spoof ""Secrets and Lies,"" they can't find anybody who saw the film.

videos.title: Peter O'Toole, Salma Hayek, Jazz Passengers
videos.overview: Dave brags that he had an incredible Valentine's Day last year, until Paul persuades him to admit that he spent it watching TV with an amorous Leonard.  Also, the Jazz Passengers (featuring Deborah Harry and Elvis Costello) perform ""Doncha Go 'Way Mad.""

videos.title: Sarah Ferguson, Allan Weimerskirch, Patti Smith
videos.overview: Marv Albert is credited with six seperate appearances tonight, thus raising his total on the show to an even one hundred.  Later, Sarah Ferguson, the Duchess of York, promotes her new cookbook.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Laura Linney, BLACKstreet
videos.overview: Two weeks before, NBC denied Dave permission to use clips from his old show. So tonight, Tom Brokaw arrives and offers Dave a crumpled-up videotape from Late Night with David Letterman.  Also, Dave shows a faux-documentary short called ""Dave's Family Weekend"" (with Andrea as his sister and Leonard as Mr. Rogers).

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Ving Rhames, Jeff Gordon
videos.overview: The outside cam goes to Joe G's to launch production of the quickie movie ""Space Volcano""; Bruce Willis murders Mujibur and Sirajul; Demi Moore shows up with 15 dogs as a gift for Dave, and later the mutts storm the control room.

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Jon Voight, The Wallflowers
videos.overview: Throughout the night, various civilians tell jokes about their jobs, while Dave admits that he has fallen in love with this year's Sports Illustrated swimsuit issue.

videos.title: Julie Andrews, Doug E. Doug, The Amazing Jonathan
videos.overview: The latest edition of ""Leonard Tepper's Hidden Video"" takes place entirely at Hello Deli, while ""Cosby"" star Doug E. Doug does standup.

videos.title: Tony Randall, Juliette Binoche, David Brenner
videos.overview: Frequent CBS Mailbag contributor Jerry Scales appears in the audience and is given a roast chicken made of Nyquil.  Also, Tony Randall talks about becoming a parent for the first time.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, David Hacker, Tina Turner
videos.overview: On the three-year anniversary of his memorable first appearance on the Late Show, super-bowler Dick Weber rolls one strike after another out on 53rd Street.  Later, he and Bill Cosby go one-on-one on the specially-built lane, with Weber decimating the sitcom star.

videos.title: Mia Farrow, Anne Heche, Elvis Costello & Burt Bacharach
videos.overview: James Cotton sits in; while pedestrians footrace against each other over on 54th and Broadway.

videos.title: Howard Stern, Valeria Mazza, Porno for Pyros
videos.overview: Leonard Tepper is live at Madison Square Garden, annoying participants at this year's Grammy Awards.  He closes the segment by calling Dave a jackass.

videos.title: Pauly Shore, Merrill Markoe, Celine Dion
videos.overview: Dave shows outtakes of Leonard's Grammy report, and then gets thrown out of a taping of ""Wheel of Fortune"" by a security guard resembling Bill DeLace.

videos.title: Bill Pullman, Richard Lewis, Lyle Lovett & Randy Newman
videos.overview: Trumpeter Al Chez sits in; the ""First Annual Biff Henderson Award"" goes to a much-serving Biff; Randy Newman and Lyle Lovett perform ""You've Got a Friend In Me.""

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Debi Mazar, Duncan Sheik
videos.overview: Dave comments on ""El Blizzardo Diablo,"" a raining snowstorm that practically has New York City in a standstill.  Also, Dave and Paul participate in a cutthroat battle of putdowns towards each other.

videos.title: Robin Quivers, Adam Arkin, James
videos.overview: Dave points out that the wet snow of yesterday's ""El Blizzardo Diablo"" has already melted and/or evaporated.  Also, Adam Arkin promotes the upcoming made-for-TV movie Not In This Town.

videos.title: Chevy Chase, Mary McCormack, Phish
videos.overview: During ""Rejected Commercial Characters,"" jokes are translated for a select audience onstage from English to Japanese.

videos.title: Kids Tell Jokes, Mary Steenburgen, Ray Wold
videos.overview: Bluesman Keb' Mo sits in; Dave and Paul shill a new sleeping enhancer called EclipseQuil; ""pyrotechnic madman"" Ray Wold blows up stuff and somehow avoids burning himself.

videos.title: Ted Danson, Famke Janssen, Mitch Hedburg
videos.overview: CBS Mailbag: Jerry Scales asks, ""What do viewers miss?"" Gerard Mulligan comes out in costume as ""A 50-year-old guy dressed like Zorro."" Also, The Biff Henderson Players present ""Send in the Clones.""

videos.title: Howard Stern, Ray Ramano, Chieftains
videos.overview: Sean Pelton sits in for Anton, while Howard Stern promotes his new movie.

videos.title: Martin Short, Larenz Tate, Kodo
videos.overview: The camera fixates on a guy in the audience with a gigantic gut with DAVE written on it.  Also, Martin Short does another musical number, with a final note so extended that he leaves the stage, goes to the bank, buys a sandwich at Hello Deli, picks up his dry cleaning, and returns to the theater just in time for the big climax.

videos.title: Cindy Crawford, Robert Townsend, Chris Whitley
videos.overview: The Late Show Current Events Singers take on Clinton's recent leg injury, then performs some sort of a cappella apology to Cindy Crawford.

videos.title: Mike Myers, Sophie Marceau, Alison Krauss
videos.overview: Today's burning question: ""How Many Guys in Bunny Suits Can Get into a Coffee Shop?"" All 23 guys that volunteered get in, and they are later joined by a geeky audience member from Georgia, who is later carried back to the stage by the bunnies.

videos.title: Marv Albert, Anthony LaPaglia, Big Head Todd & the Monsters
videos.overview: In honor of his birthday, former president Thomas Jefferson is seen skydiving over the city, followed shortly by William McKinley and Paul Shaffer.

videos.title: Teri Garr, George Stephanopolous, Amanda Marshall
videos.overview: Dave announces that today is Tony Mendez' 60th birthday, even though he's only 52; Dave orders Anton to fetch him some coffee; a man-on-the-street segment dissects tonight's ""Top Ten Easter Bunny Pet Peeves.""

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Marlon Wayans, The Cardigans
videos.overview: Mailbag: Alan has an announcer sitting in with him, only to realize he's not his intern but his willing replacement.  Meanwhile, Academy Award winner Billy Bob Thornton (live via satellite) presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Bryant Gumbel, Kadeem Hardison, Bandbaz Brothers
videos.overview: Songwriter Jimmy Webb sits in, and throughout the night the band plays his songs; Dave shows a tape of Rob Burnett's daughter being scared to death by Daddy as the Easter Bunny; Dave tells a story about how he spent his Easter with Nadine Hennelly, but as usual Paul coerces him into telling the sad, awful truth.

videos.title: Tara Lipinsky, Margaret Colin, Nanci Griffith
videos.overview: Dave calls a pay phone on Broadway, and then calls in a guy from Jersey named Rocky to tell the first ""Mets suck"" joke of the season.  Also, Biff gives a pep talk to some grade-school students.

videos.title: Dan Akroyd, David Kruithoff, Cyndi Lauper
videos.overview: A man claiming to be Paul's brother Kenny sits in the audience, while amateur dentist David Kriuthoff fidgets with a special camera that can go inside the mouth.

videos.title: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Brad Garrett, Chris Fonseca
videos.overview: ""Colin Dunner"" (Gerard), the lead dancer in the Broadway hit ""Riverdance"" promotes his new videotape ""Riverdancin' to the Oldies.""  Also, Will Lee demonstrates how to play a guitar like a piano.

videos.title: John Cusak, Liv Tyler, David Bowie
videos.overview: Mailbag: a man on the street is decapitated by a giant, renegade blue card. Also, Pat Farmer introduces his new segment ""Live Action Editorial Cartoon.""  Tonight's piece: ""Busting the Budget.""

videos.title: Anthony Clark, Joan Lunden, Eryka Badu
videos.overview: Dave says he's discovered he's been combing his hair wrong, so he fidgets with it throughout the show.  Also, Zahshu, the ""World's Only Performing Hippo,"" rolls over and begs.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Justine Bateman, Trace Adkins
videos.overview: ""How Many Guys in a Bunny Suit Can Get Into H&R Block?"" Only two, until both are kicked out.  Right after the first commercial break, Biff then tries to get in wearing a dog suit and, despite being escorted by Bill DeLace, is also ejected.  When all is said and done, Dave announces the tax company's new slogan: ""And stay out!""

videos.title: Charles Grodin, David Alan Grier, Matthew Sweet
videos.overview: In a running gag that was started two nights before (in homage to something that appeared occasionally on Late Night), Zahshu, ""The World's Only Performing Goldfish,"" develops a severe case of stage fright.  At the end of the show, he is removed from his fishbowl and is placed on top of a skateboard.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammar, Jake Johannsen, Tracy Chapman
videos.overview: Champion weightlifter Magnus Vermagnusson lifts various objects, including Mujibur and Sirajul; Dave comments on his upcoming 50th birthday; Zhushi ""The World's Only Performing Dog"" is the latest animal to stand on stage in lieu of attempting some sort of stunt.

videos.title: Martin Mull, Alicia Witt, Mary J. Blige
videos.overview: Marv Albert interviews accountants, then shows a blooper real along side it; Dave notices that Tony is holding cue cards with gloves on; ""Pat Farmer's Live-Action Political Cartoon"" takes a swipe at President Clinton.

videos.title: Katie Couric, Roma Downey, INXS
videos.overview: Dave finds a patron named Bob Reedy, in Joe G's Pizza to star in another fake film epic, the Anaconda spoof ""Snakequest 2000."" Quote Dave: ""For the love of god, it's a giant snake!""

videos.title: Tony Randall, Steven Weber, Wilco
videos.overview: Allen Toussant sits in; Dave announces that in honor of the recent media hoopla over Ellen DeGeneres, the Late Show will now be ""more gay""; Wilco performs ""Someone Else's Song.""

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow, Umberto Buccigrossi, Verve Pipe
videos.overview: Biff announces that if Lyndon Johnson were alive today, he would've had a roast beef sandwich for lunch.  Also, The Verve Pipe performs ""The Freshman.""

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Rosie Perez, John Hiatt
videos.overview: On a special Indianapolis-themed night on the Late Show, Dorothy interrupts a comedy bit to give Dave a hug, while Reggie Miller presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Kurt Russell, Sinbad, Paula Cole
videos.overview: Rupert Jee drops by to make an important announcement: ""America, I am a lesbian.""  This inspires Regis to walk over and give him a hug.

videos.title: Robin Williams, Tanya Tucker
videos.overview: Dave shows a clip from the latest Charlie Brown Special: Charlie Brown declares, ""I think I'm a lesbian.""  Also, two dorky audience members help wash a cab outside the theater, then get hosed down by the NYFD.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Joey Lauren Adams, Indigo Girls
videos.overview: It's ""Awards Night"" on the Late Show, as throughout the night Biff presents Gordie Howe with the Stanley Cup, Walter Payton with the Super Bowl Trophy, Bobby Allison with the Harley J. Earle Trophy, Kareem Abdul Jabbar with the Larry O'Brien Trophy, Alec Baldwin with the World Series Trophy, and Tony Mendez with the Best Cue Card Boy Trophy.  Also, Alec announces on the in-theater PA system that he's a lesbian.

videos.title: Garry Shandling, Luke Perry, Wendy Liebman
videos.overview: Wendy Liebman discusses mammograms, while Luke Perry rappels off the side of the theater.

videos.title: Roseanne, Justin Miller, Chuck Berry
videos.overview: In honor of tonight's audience (all residents of St. Louis and its suburbs), the backdrop is altered to show the city's skyline; Dave shows live footage of the Mets/Cardinals game in progress at Shea Stadium; Roseanne arrives for her interview on a Clydesdale-driven sleigh.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Elizabeth Hurley, Maxwell
videos.overview: Dave dumps the show early yet again, and after searching high and low in Manhattan, Biff finally finds him demonstrating knife tricks at Benihana's.

videos.title: John Goodman, Kathleen Quinlan, Hanson
videos.overview: ""How Many Guys in Bunny Suits Can Get into a Fountain?"" Only about six, as the men in costume are thrown out of Central Park by the NYPD. After the first commercial break, John Goodman lunges into the fountain. Also, Hanson performs ""MmmBop.""

videos.title: Mike Myers, Danny Aiello, Crossbows of Death
videos.overview: Tony Mendez does the Watusi; Biff announces that if Burt Lancaster were alive today, he would've had cream of mushroom soup and a tuna fish sandwich for lunch; stuntmen Ross and Elisa Hartzell shoot crossbow arrows at each other.

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Kristen Johnson, Bee Gees
videos.overview: Rupert stars in a parody of those financial-success tapes that they sell in infomercials, while Kirsten Johnston promotes the 3-D season finale of Third Rock from the Sun.

videos.title: Ricki Lake, Kirby Puckett, Soul Asylum
videos.overview: With tonight's audience being from the Twin Cities, Dave makes them feel at home by having a faux snow fall in the theater.  Also, the Top Ten home office is temporarily relocated to nearby Edina, Minnesota (and is presented by Twins great Kirby Puckett), while Calvert takes a tour of Minneapolis.

videos.title: Cybil Shepard, Darrell Hammond, Linda Eder
videos.overview: Tonight, Dave promises to show things that have never been on television before, including Marv Albert dancing with a giant squirrel, a gay man kissing a lesbian, and Biff playing solitaire topless.  Also, Grover Washington, Jr. sits in, while Dave and Rupert do another one of their hidden-mic gags.

videos.title: Andy Garcia, George Foreman, Travis Tritt
videos.overview: Dancers from Riverdance make a return appearance on the show. Actually, they're staff writers Gerard Mulligan and Eric Kaplan, Leonard Tepper, and financial wiz/Dave buddy Jim Peterson.  Soon after, Robin Williams walks in from Broadway in a similar toe-tappin' style.

videos.title: David Hyde Pierce, Dana Delany, Spice Girls
videos.overview: In honor of Late Show's 800th episode, Dave introduces ""Where Are They Now?"" pieces describing the whereabouts of Bernie Kopell, Howie Mandel, Olivia Newton-John, and Bill Clinton.  Also, the Spice Girls perform ""Who Do You Think You Are.""

videos.title: Helen Hunt, Susie Maroney, Jeffery Tambor
videos.overview: Late Show airs its second and last installment of Peanuts, as Lucy once again foils Charlie Brown's attempt to kick a football: ""Never mess around with a gangsta bitch.""

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Jeff Goldblum, Foo Fighters
videos.overview: With tonight's audience representing Denver, Colorado, Dave interrupts the monologue to introduce an audience guy who ends up proposing to his girlfriend.  Later in the show, Jeff Goldblum gives the happy couple a blender.

videos.title: Meg Ryan, Lance Henriksen, Mary Chapin-Carpenter
videos.overview: Biff brings out a Billy goat that supposedly won the Kentucky Derby last weekend; Dave leaves the show to play for the New York Yankees, then goes on a half-hearted tirade when he's cut by the team; ""Leonard Tepper's Mile-High Hidden Video"" observes unsuspecting tourists at the World Trade Center.

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Ida Doggett, God's Property with Kirk Franklin
videos.overview: After showing past clips of disastrous attempts at stuffing guys in rabbit outfits inside various locales, Dave announces that it's time to play ""How Many Sailors Can Get into a New York City Chicken Restaurant?""  With the nearby Ranch 1 offering their services, a whopping 68 sailors walk in without a problem.  Also, Dave chats with Ida Doggett, 1997 world bed-making champion.

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Kelly Preston, Toad the Wet Sprocket
videos.overview: It's time yet again for ""What They Would Have for Lunch if They Were Alive Today"" with Biff Henderson.  The celebrity: Dean Martin.  The lunch: mac n' cheese.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Nicole Sullivan, Savion Glover & Stomp
videos.overview: ""Steven Spielberg"" (Gerard) brags out his new movie The Lost World, while Savion Glover performs a tap dance solo from the hit musical ""Stomp.""

videos.title: Jason Alexander, Griffin Dunne, Sammy Hagar
videos.overview: Mailbag: a horrific freak accident turns Rupert into the mysterious ""Dr. Meat.""  Also, Jason Alexander promotes Love! Valour! Compassion!

videos.title: Elle MacPherson, Vince Vaughn, Jewel
videos.overview: Remote on the 14th Floor: Late Show staffers Eric Stangel, Matt Roberts, Bob Borden, Rodney Munoz, Christian Breheney, and Eric Kaplan relate their Prom Nightmares while eating in the coffee room, with dramatizations that include Rupert Jee and Richard Simmons.

videos.title: Michael Richards, Rick Reynolds, Steve Winwood
videos.overview: Customer Bob Barrett from Joe's Pizza is invited into the theater to act in the monster movie spectacular ""Ghost Dinosaur '97,"" co-starring Mujibur and Sirajul as ""Dinosaur #1"" and ""Dinosaur #2.""

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Elaine Cunningham, Squirrel Nut Zippers
videos.overview: The squash family is represented tonight by a visit from Elaine Cunningham, ""The Zucchini Lady""; Bill Cosby talks about his various medications.

videos.title: Alicia Silverstone, Andy Dick, John Fogerty
Farrah Fawcett, John Fogerty
videos.overview: Promoting an upcoming TV special, Farrah Fawcett walks out in a boozy daze, complimenting Dave for the view of the skyline when it's really a backdrop, then crawls around and makes animal noises. At the end of the show, Dave thanks Farrah for ""almost being here tonight.""

videos.title: Harrison Ford, Steven Wright, Dave Matthews Band
videos.overview: Biff reports from the NBA Finals in Salt Lake City; Dave makes his usual joke about buying his first car at Harrison Ford in Indiana; Dave Matthews Band performs ""Too Much.""

videos.title: Isabella Rossellini, Dave Chapelle, Bono & Larry Mullen
videos.overview: Dave shows an altered clip of President Clinton admitting his dislike for cloning, and later Dave is once again visited by ""the lovely Is-a-bella Ros-sell-ini.""

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Susan Molinari, Seven Mary Three
videos.overview: Dave turns the hose on pedestrians outside the theater; Jaleel ""Urkel"" White helps ""Les Moonves"" promote CBS' fall lineup; Seven Mary Three performs ""Lucky.""

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Janeane Garafolo, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: Tom Brokaw explains why he turned down an offer to leave NBC for CNN: ""Same as you with CBS: more money, smaller audience.""  Also, Sheryl Crow performs ""A Change (Will Do You Good).""

videos.title: John Travolta, Grant Hill, Sinead O'Connor
videos.overview: Mailbag: ""Farrah Fawcett"" (Calvert) explains her behavior from last week.  Also, Kenny ""The Quick-Witted Stagehand"" Sheehan makes his 1000th TV appearance, which is followed by footage of his (bogus) television debut on Ed Sullivan in 1964.

videos.title: George Carlin, Nick Chinlund, James Taylor
videos.overview: Paul is introduced as ""Radu,"" then shows Dave a Happy Meal toy that looks just like him. Also, Dave hides in an apartment, harassing delivery people as they come and go.

videos.title: Kathy Ireland, Jeremy Holz, Michael Story
videos.overview: A new challenge: ""Who Can Hail a Cab First""- a pantsless Mets fan or a pantless Yankees fan?  For once, the Mets win the big one.

videos.title: Matt Lauer, Ruthie Bolton-Holifield, Mighty Mighty Bosstones
videos.overview: Dave gives an audience woman a ham just for being Polish; several members of the cast of Cats go inside FlashDancers; Alan Kalter promotes ""Late Show: The Game""; The Mighty Mighty Bosstones perform ""The Impression That I Get.""

videos.title: Julia Roberts, Jon Bon Jovi
videos.overview: Julia Roberts is treated to a clip of her first appearance on Letterman from 1990, only to watch the clip blackened out by NBC.  Also, Jon Bon Jovi performs ""Janie, Don't Take Your Love to Town.""

videos.title: Siskel & Ebert, Dermot Mulroney, King Charles Troupe
videos.overview: ""Riverdancers"" Gerry Mulligan, Mike McIntee, Eric Kaplan, and Jim Peterson amaze and delight the studio audience and the home viewers in response to a letter in the CBS Mailbag.

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Doug E. Doug, Johnny Lang
videos.overview: Anton is introduced as ""Anton Zip""; Dave shows the audience a chart of who's permitted to be on the show and who isn't; in tonight's remote, Dave goes to a private school in Manhattan to chat with child prodigies.

videos.title: Nick Turturro, Daisy Fuentes, Motley Crue
videos.overview: The outside cam heads to Joe G's looking for a guy to write a theme song for, where they stumble across Brian and his girlfriend.  Also, Dave takes the audience outside to watch Motley Crue perform on the sidewalk.

videos.title: Peter Fonda, Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Ricki Lee Jones
videos.overview: It's 91 degrees outside, so Biff decides to watch ice melt on the street.

videos.title: Brian Williams, Diane Cannon, Gil Shaham
videos.overview: A flying saucer heckles Dave from the backdrop, while Dyan Cannon promotes Out to Sea and makes friendly with Dave.

videos.title: Martin Lawrence, Robert Zemeckis, Sarah McLachlan
videos.overview: Dave declares a guy named Jeff as ""Captain of the Audience,"" helping the host out with menial tasks such as helping present the Top Ten and keeping the audience awake.  Also, film director Robert Zemeckis makes a rare television appearance, promoting his new movie Contact.

videos.title: Will Smith, Heidi Klum, Brad Byers
videos.overview: Bowling great Dick Weber sits in with the band; Calvert kicks someone in the nether regions for the shear fun of it; Dave and Paul trade faces.

videos.title: Jason Priestly, Patricia Richardson, The Cicadas
videos.overview: Dave gets two girls at a nearby cafe to help celebrate Canada Day with Canada Dry®, which gets delivered by a Mountie; to continue a running gag started the previous night, bowler Johnny Petraglia sits in; various staffers describe clips from America's Funniest Home Videos.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Mitchell Libonati, Blur
videos.overview: During the ""Supermarket Finds"" segment, Dave takes a sample of something called ""White Fungus"" and spits it out; another bowling great (Marshall Holman) sits in with the band on tambourine; Dave chats with Mitchell Libonati, the man who found the piece of Evander Holyfield's ear that was chewed off in the infamous boxing match that previous weekend; Blur performs ""Song 2.""

videos.title: Evander Holyfield, Lee Marek, Sarah Silverman
videos.overview: Dave talks about the a new unauthorized autobiography of Martha Stewart; tonight's guest bowler is Hall of Famer Carmen Salvino; Dave appears in a 50's-style cigarette ad; Evander Holyfield gives Dave his account of the incident that occurred in his fight last weekend with Mike Tyson.

videos.title: Martin Short, Manny the Hippie, Fang Fang
videos.overview: Pro bowler Nelson Burton, Jr. sits in; during Mailbag, Tom Arnold bits his own ear off; Manny the Hippie resurfaces; for the second year in a row, Dave sends audience members from San Francisco to the Empire State Building to display the US flag.

videos.title: Don Rickles, Brendan Fraser, En Vogue
videos.overview: Dave shows off his new, shorter haircut; an audience member sings the theme song from Grease; Tim Allen presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Tim Robbins, Jackie Chan, Shawn Colvin
videos.overview: It's a balmy 97 degrees outside, so Biff fries an egg on the sidewalk, later adding bacon and toast.

videos.title: Mary Tyler Moore, Querbe Tirmizi, Matchbox 20
videos.overview: Dave interviews NYC taxi driver Querbe Tirmizi, who returned $30,000 he found in his cab.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Robey Morgan, Third Eye Blind
videos.overview: Dave begins a month-long campaign to run into the ground his current favorite phrase: ""Something from the meat case, Linda?"" Also, Dave, Tony Randall, and a dozen or so triple-named child actors star in CBS' hot new situation comedy ""The Letterman Family.""

videos.title: Pauly Shore, Leslie Mann, Puff Daddy
videos.overview: Dave congratulates Paul on being #6 on the Forbes 500; Biff and Eric Kaplan explain how they make Dave's coffee mug levitate; Sean ""Puff Daddy"" Combs, Faith Evans, and 112 perform ""It's All About the Benjamins.""

videos.title: Kids Tell Jokes, Mario Andretti, John Hiatt
videos.overview: It's time once again for ""King of the Meats,"" the mano-a-mano kosher competition between Rupert of Hello Deli and Amando Vasquez of the nearby Stage Deli.  Amando sweeps the three rounds, but Rupert goes home with the ladies.

videos.title: John Turturro, Kathy Kinney, Radish
videos.overview: Harrison Ford reports from Hawaii; in the debut edition of ""Pointless Celebrity Cameo Theater,"" Calvert, Regis, and Tony Randall stand around like goons while the audience cheers them on; Radish (a band fronted by an early Ben Kweller) perform ""Little Pink Stars.""

videos.title: Dan Rather, Kathy Griffin, k.d. Lang
videos.overview: The Harrison Ford World Tour (in which he's promoting The Devil's Own) makes a stop in Paris, France; Dave suggests the Paul legally change his name to ""Radu""; CBS anchorman/folkie at heart Dan Rather sings ""The Wabash Cannonball.""

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Barry Sonnenfeld
videos.overview: During ""CBS Mailbag,"" we look into a day in the life of a ""Accident-Prone Blood-Gorged Tick"" (Leonard Tepper).

videos.title: Jennifer Anniston, Brian Regan, William H. Macy
videos.overview: It's so hot outside that Biff tries to start a fire on the sidewalk with a magnifying glass and a bundle of sticks, as members from New York's Fire Department stand by; Rupert and Leonard bother people per Dave's requests; Jennifer Aniston promotes Picture Perfect.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Phylicia Rashad, Jamiroquai
videos.overview: Dave gets four galpals from West Virginia to go on a tour of the city with Biff; Physilla Rashad promotes her sitcom Cosby; Jamiroquai performs the #1 hit ""Virtual Insanity.""

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Billy Connolly, David Byrne
videos.overview: Dave congratulates Rob Burnett upon the birth of his daughter; a ""What's On Other Channels"" bit is interrupted by a car honking, courtesy of Creepy Dave; David Byrne performs ""Daddy Go Down.""

videos.title: Julia Roberts, Blues Traveler
videos.overview: John Popper sits in with the band; Dave asks a paramedic about a piece of carrot he ""horked"" into his left lung during lunch today; Julia Roberts promotes Conspiracy Theory.

videos.title: Tony Danza, Michael Rapaport
videos.overview: Dave shows some ""Surprising Facts About Celebrities.""  Later, Tony Danza promotes his new sitcom.

videos.title: Bob Dole, Bill Bellamy, Ziggy Marley & the Melody Makers
videos.overview: Dave presents a Wall Street quiz; Bob Dole talks about retirement.

videos.title: Ray Liotta, David Brenner, Natalie Desselle
videos.overview: Deliberately-obvious stunt doubles pose as Dave and Paul showing off their bike skills, while Dave carves a sculpture of Paul made from butter; a man claiming to be Garth Brooks is interrogated on ""The Biff Henderson Celebrity Telephone Interview.""

videos.title: Jay Thomas, Annabella Sciorra, Tonic
videos.overview: Jay Thomas shows Dave a tape of himself spitting out something during a recent television appearance.  The footage is repeated several times.

videos.title: Sylvester Stallone, Tommy LaSorda
videos.overview: Joe Perry of Aerosmith sits in with the band; Biff reports from the Garth Brooks concert in Central Park and meets ""Garth"" himself (Leonard Tepper).

videos.title: Demi Moore, Jay Mohr, Aerosmith
videos.overview: The new sitcom ""The Letterman Family"" is promoted, starring Dave, Tony Randall, and Nadine Hennally.  Later, Demi Moore shaves an audience member's head.

videos.title: Tom Selleck, Billy Joel
videos.overview: Dave feeds Tom Selleck some avocados.  Later, they make a crank phone call to Al Roker.

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Charles Dutton, Morrissey
videos.overview: Barbara Walters promotes her new talk show, ""The View.""

videos.title: Mira Sorvino, Jeff Altman, Coolio
videos.overview: Dave compares President Clinton's 51st birthday to meatloaf.  Later, he chats with his old friend Jeff Altman.

videos.title: Donald Trump, Janine Turner, Ruth Brown & Bonnie Raitt
videos.overview: ""The Donald"" talks about a recent boat trip.  Later, Janine Turner promotes ""Leave It To Beaver.""

videos.title: Alicia Silverstone, Bev Tanner, George Miller
videos.overview: Alicia Silverstone promotes her new movie Excess Baggage.

videos.title: Vanessa Williams, Joe Montana
videos.overview: Dave announces that he is starring in the ""Late Show of Passion,"" which is just like the Late Show, except that it's dubbed so it looks like a telenovela.  Later, Dave and Joe Montana throw footballs at a garbage truck.

videos.title: Paul Reiser, Tia Carrera, Echo & the Bunnymen
Laurence Fishburne, Jonathan Katz, Paula Cole
videos.overview: Tonight's Top Ten is interrupted by a phone call from the home office in Wahoo, Nebraska: ""It's not all that funny anymore.""  Meanwhile, Biff wreaks havoc in Martha's Vineyard.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Mehgan Heany-Grear, Dane Cook
videos.overview: Dave complains about the dog days of summer.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Danny Aiello, Radiohead
videos.overview: Warren is run over by a car; during ""Stupid Human Tricks,"" Douglas Pierce plays the ""Jeopardy"" theme on his hands; Dave bids a fond farewell to head writer Bill Scheft.

videos.title: Terry Bradshaw, Carmen Electra, Eddie Brill
videos.overview: Dave shows highlights from the annual Labor Day staff cookout on 53rd Street; Terry Bradshaw and stagehand Corky Ramirez both inexplicably break into song.

videos.title: Steven Seagal, Brittany Starr, Beck
videos.overview: Warren is caught watching tennis on TV; Dave harasses teen talk show host John Hall; Beck performs ""Devil's Haircut.""

videos.title: Joan Lunden, Chris Rock, Fiona Apple
videos.overview: Viewers at home receive the rare opportunity to see the new audience orientation tape (starring Leonard Tepper).  Later, Fiona Apple performs ""Criminal.""

videos.title: Geena Davis, Martha Stewart, Robert Carlyle
Kevin Kline, Jamie Foxx, Sugar Ray
videos.overview: On Warren's last night filling in for Paul, he receives a ""Deputy of Comedy"" badge.  Later, Sugar Ray performs ""Fly.""

videos.title: Danny DeVito, Patrick Rafter, Tim McGraw
videos.overview: Paul returns from filming ""Blues Brothers 2000"" with a shaved head.  Meanwhile, Dave, Biff, Regis, Al Roker, and Bob Barker harass people in Central Park.

videos.title: Salma Hayek, Joan Cusak, Louie Anderson
videos.overview: Dave calls the pay phone island outside so that an unsuspecting tourist could participate in a comedy skit.  When nobody picks up a phone, Dave goes on the street and invites a guy from Vermont to perform a musical number with Tony Randall.

videos.title: Noah Wylie, Damon Wayons, Missy "Misdemeanor" Elliot
videos.overview: Dave is so fascinated by Paul's shaved head (introduced last night) that he has to talk about it at the beginning of the show.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, Cynthia Cooper, Nanci Griffith & Darius Rucker
videos.overview: Paul writes a song for a trucker who participated in ""Know Your Current Events,"" while Dave chats with WNBA MVP Cynthia Cooper.

videos.title: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Starr Jones, Bee Gees
videos.overview: Dave chats with CBS star ""Steve Urkel"" (Gerard), while Star Jones plugs ""The View.""

videos.title: George Clooney, Bill Cosby
videos.overview: Dave listens to the philosophies of second-graders in ""Dave Talks to Kids""; George Clooney promotes ""The Peacemaker.""

videos.title: Nicole Kidman, Gregory Hines, God's Property
videos.overview: Biff delivers a housewarming gift to a Hooters franchise that just opened, and they send back buffalo wings.  Later, an NBC nurse tends to Nicole Kidman's cold.

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Michael Lamonico, Bill Engvall
videos.overview: Dave discusses aerosol cheese with last minute guest Chef Michael Lomonaco who says, ""It's great when you're driving, actually. You get a little squirt when you're driving.""

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Jonathan Lipnicki, Deana Carter
videos.overview: Richard Simmons interupts ""Know Your Current Events""; Drew Carey presents ""Top Ten Signs You Work in a Bad Office""; 7-year-old Jonathan Lipnicki promotes his new sitcom, ""Meego.""

videos.title: Kim Basinger, Ray Ramano, Jackson Browne
videos.overview: In a return to the popular theme nights of yore, the entire LATE SHOW audience consists of freshmen from NYU.  During the show, Candice Bergen presents a special college-themed Top Ten list.

videos.title: Fourth Anniversary Special
videos.overview: Dave shows some of his favorite remotes, segments, and comedy clips from the first four years of ""The Late Show.""

videos.title: Fran Drescher, Ryan Tripp, Brooks & Dunn
videos.overview: Bob Borden finally gets to meet Jaleel ""Urkel"" White, while Paul composes a musical number about pastries that resemble celebrities.

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Sarah O'Hare, Patti Smith
videos.overview: Dave gives a local named Tom Worzall ten seconds of air time, then chats with Wonderbra model Sarah O'Hare.

videos.title: Cameron Diaz, Adam Arkin, Veniamin
videos.overview: Cameron Diaz promotes ""A Life Less Ordinary,"" while the famed contortionist Veniamin does a demonstration.

videos.title: Matt Lauer, Ryan Kurlander, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: Dave comments on the Yankees playoff chances, then chats with new ""Today"" co-host Matt Lauer.

videos.title: Elle MacPherson, Jon Tenney, Elvis Costello & the Fairfield Four
videos.overview: Dave shows (bogus) NASA footage of Mir; the Dutch Mariachis sing ""Happy Birthday"" to Biff.

videos.title: Dan Aykroyd, Jack Hanna, Boyz II Men
videos.overview: Dave and Paul visit the ""International Hair Forum""; Dan Aykroyd promotes ""Soul Man"" and plays the harmonica.

videos.title: Bryant Gumbel, Harland Williams, Everclear
videos.overview: Joe G. stars in the new crime drama ""Joey Ventura,"" and clips from the show are scattered throughout the night; Dave gives Paul crap for bumping into a cameraman; Bryant Gumbel promotes his soon-to-debut news program.

videos.title: John Lithgow, Christy Turlington, Foo Fighters
videos.overview: Dave watches leaves turn and nails dry, and an audience member's receives and smokes his first cigar.

videos.title: James Belushi, Christina Ricci, Oasis
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Leonard plugs his new show, ""Leonard Tepper's Hidden Video.""  Later, Jim Belushi promotes ""Total Security.""

videos.title: Uma Thurman, Mark Wahlberg, Eddie Izzard
videos.overview: ""Dr."" Bill DeLace comments on seasonal allergies; Mark Wahlberg promotes ""Boogie Nights.""

videos.title: David Duchovny, Emily Mae Young, Todd Barry
videos.overview: 1997: Stagehand and accomplished thespian Kenny Sheehan is seen in clips from ""The Today Show,"" ""Guiding Light,"" ""Cosby,"" ""The People's Court,"" and ""Spin City.""

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Stevie Starr, Green Day
videos.overview: After Dave shows clips of past bunny antics, the Late Show presents ""How Many Guys in Bunny Suits Can Get in the Times Square Disney Store?"" The answer: Three.  Later, Stevie Starr shows Dave the magic of forcing yourself to regurgitate.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Chalize Theron, Carly Simon
videos.overview: Paul introduces this year's National League champions, the Atlanta Braves, until Dave tells him that the Florida Marlins actually won.  Later, Carly Simon and Jimmy Webb perform a duet.

videos.title: Mike Wallace, Kelly Montieth, LL Cool J
videos.overview: Dave presents ""The Story Behind the Story: The Rolling Stones,"" which looks at the dramatic and emotionally draining production of a ""Behind the Music""-type show.

videos.title: Robert Pastorelli, Harmony Korine, Smash Mouth
videos.overview: WCBS-TV presents a skit about a pancake that looks like Paul.  Later, Robert Pastorelli promotes his new drama ""Cracker.""

videos.title: Mariah Carey, Anthony Clark
videos.overview: Dave shows (bogus) footage of businessmen jumping out of windows on Wall Street; we take a look at ""What Dave Did with the Extra Hour from Standard Time""; Mariah Carey sings ""Butterfly.""

videos.title: Maria Martiromo, Penn & Teller, Amy Grant
videos.overview: Following yesterday's sell-off on Wall Street, Dave shows footage of deceased stockbrokers ascending back through windows after today's market recovery.  Later, Penn and Teller perform a new trick.

videos.title: Ellen Barkin, Bobby Bonilla, Angelo Massagli
videos.overview: Biff plays ""Let's Scare the Crap Out of Rupert Jee,"" while Dave interviews Bobby Bonilla of the World Series Champion Florida Marlins.

videos.title: Kid Scientists, David Hyde Pierce, Andy Greene
videos.overview: Lee Marek helps Dave out with a sextet of Kid Scientists.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Naomi Campbell, Bobby Brown
videos.overview: In honor of the new movie ""Boogie Nights,"" Dave shows bogus clips of Paul and Nadine Hennelly in 70's-era porno films.  Meanwhile, Tony impresses Dave with his clown costume.

videos.title: John Travolta, Cybill Shepard, Kuznetsov Troupe
videos.overview: Dave shows a picture of production associate Tara Callahan, who ran in the New York Marathon; John Travolta plugs Face-Off; Martin Short appears for exactly thirty seconds.

videos.title: Danny Aiello, Helena Bonham Carter, Mandy & Dora Lee Patinkin
videos.overview: 1997: We go to Joe G.'s in search of a political candidate, and we find an unsuspecting patron named Lee Holt.  Later in the show, Lee becomes the subject of a hastily-produced attack ad.

videos.title: Sarah Ferguson, Kelly McGillis, Leann Rimes
videos.overview: Dave, Paul, Alan, Calvert, and Anton (as ""Buddy"") star in ""Late Show: The Movie.""  Also, Rudy Guiliani (poorly) disguises himself as a audience member in the latest edition of ""Who Asked For It?""

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr., Pamela Lee
videos.overview: Dave shows a fake ad for a PBS documentary about the band KISS.  Later, a lady in the audience who Dave accidentally threw a blue card near is now wearing a cervical collar.

videos.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Heather Matarazzo, B.B. King & Tracy Chapman
videos.overview: Casey Kasem introduces the ""Late Show Chair of Mystery.""  Also, BB King and Tracy Chapman perform a soulful duet.

videos.title: Wesley Snipes, Naomi Judd, Martina Hingis
videos.overview: ""Master Mentalist"" Pat Farmer does a demonstration on Kenny Sheehan; singer-restaurateur Naomi Judd cooks a family recipe for Dave.

videos.title: Claire Danes, Michelle Kwan, Lorrie Morgan
videos.overview: Dave makes a bad phone call for an audience member, then comments on Marv Albert's legal troubles.

videos.title: Marv Albert, Daniel Scribner & Tylin Hall, John Fogerty
videos.overview: The greatest six minutes in Late Show history: When the Top Ten card is missing, Dave runs out of the theater, is hit by a cab, runs into Al Roker, and goes into Flashdancers and takes the card off one of the strippers.  Shortly afterwards, Paul, missing his sheet music for the Top Ten, runs out of the theater, is hit by a tour bus, runs into Regis Philbin, and goes into the NY Stock Exchange, where he finds his sheet music on the floor.  Just as Dave begins the Top Ten, Biff is missing his headset, so he runs out of the theater, is hit by a police horse, runs into Gavin MacLeod, and goes into a Burger King to grab a headset off a sales clerk. When he finally returns, there is no time left for the Top Ten.

videos.title: Bill Murray, Alison Eastwood, Matchbox 20
videos.overview: Live from the Edwards Air Force Base, Bruce Willis and Billy Bob Thornton race to earn the title of ""World's Fastest Movie Star.""  Also, Bill Murray plugs ""The Man Who Knew Too Little.""

videos.title: Don Rickles, Heather Graham, Lou Reed
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Gerard performs a Broadway-style number about the possibility of him getting fired.  Also, Heather Graham plugs ""Boogie Nights.""

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Venus Williams, Wynonna
videos.overview: Dave plugs the new CD ""Live on Letterman,"" then goes door-to-door offering to rake leaves.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Kordell Stewart, Elvis Costello
videos.overview: It's another ""Quarterback Challenge"" as Pittsburgh Steelers field general Kordell Stewart and Dave aim footballs at a water tower across the street from the Ed Sullivan Theater.

videos.title: Sigourney Weaver, David Brenner, Trischa Yearwood
videos.overview: Dave (supposedly) calls the Butterball Turkey Handling Hotline, while two mailmen (Leonard and Gerard) present a U.S. Post Office-sanctioned message about on-the-job safety.

videos.title: Danny DeVito, Sarah Michelle Gellar
videos.overview: Tony Mendez interrupts Dave, pointing out that he's missing a cue card.  It turns out it was with Tony Randall all along.

videos.title: Kirstie Alley, Luke Perry, Shengyang Acrobats
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) ad for a Clinton phone sex hotline, while Kirstie Alley plugs ""Veronica's Closet.""

videos.title: John Cusak, Natalie Portman, Stomp with Bill Irwin
videos.overview: Paul leaves the show to hosts his own spinoff chatfest; comedian Bill Irwin; the cast of ""Stomp"" performs.

videos.title: Kids Tell Jokes, Marisa Tomei, James Taylor
videos.overview: Dave brings in cab driver Carlos Andrede, who becomes the master of ceremonies in the hastily-produced ""Carlos Andrede Thanksgiving Day Parade,"" featuring performances from Miss New York 1998 and the Rutgers University Marching Band.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Anthony Edwards, Joost Elffers
videos.overview: A high school marching band from Memphis storms through the audience after ""Know Your Current Events.""

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Art Donovan, Wallflowers
videos.overview: It's time for another call to Dave's mom to play ""Guess the Pies""; tonight, she's baked coconut butterscotch pecan pie and cherry pie as well as a sculpted head of Dave made of stuffing.  Also, George Clarke starts singing to the new live CD.

videos.title: Jon Stewart, John Witherspoon, Days of the New
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave bags groceries.  Also, in spoof of those high-related FOX specials, Dave and Paul reveal one of the magician's secrets.

videos.title: Courteney Cox, Peyton Manning, Shania Twain
videos.overview: Grover Washington, Jr. sits in; Dave shows a Sing and Snore Ernie that he bought yesterday, and it's head tragically comes off with blood gushing out; Dave and Heisman Trophy candidate Peyton Manning go one-on-one in the latest Late Show QB Challenge.

videos.title: Sir Anthony Hopkins, Eric Lindros, Enya
Nathan Lane, Hazelle Goodman, Mitch Fatel
videos.overview: The outside cam reveals Buddy (Bill Clinton's dog) trying to get inside Hooters.  Also, Nathan Lane sings a brief song about Hanukkah.

videos.title: Alex D Linz, Jerry O'Connell, Bryan Adams
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave and Paul give birth to septuplets.  Also, child actor Alex D. Linz plugs ""Home Alone 3.""

videos.title: Kevin Costner, Tyra Banks, Nina & Nickolai
videos.overview: Dave and Tony go to Giants Stadium so Tony can be a kicker, with a little help from Giants coach Jim Fassel, plus kickers Brad Daluiso and Danny Kanell; a man claiming to be the new president of Iran promotes the ""Live on Letterman"" CD; Tyra Banks shows Dave her $3 million bra.

videos.title: Pam Grier, Tom Everett Scott, James Brown
videos.overview: A plastic Statue of Liberty, a giant meatball, and a pile of bagels are placed on top of the Late Show Christmas Tree.  Later in the show, a preacher in the audience puts sauce on the meatball.

videos.title: Greg Kinnear, Djimon Hounsou, Ben Folds Five
videos.overview: Dave annoys Paul with his impersonation of John Wayne speaking French: ""Bonjour, mon ami.""

videos.title: Leslie Nelson, Michelle Yeoh, Hanson
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) clip of him as a 50's-era child actor, while Biff receives Foster's Lager ® from an Australian audience member.

videos.title: Pierce Brosnan, Lou Holtz
videos.overview: ""James Bond"" (Tom Manino) comes up from the audience at Dave's insistance.  Later in the show, Pierce Bronson and his doppleganger go one-on-one.  Also, Paul wears his christmas present from Dave: a Jerry Springer-style wig.

videos.title: Joan Lunden, Angelo Massaglini, G. Love with Special Sauce & Dr. John
videos.overview: In honor of the week's top-grossing film, Titanic, the stage floods with water.  Also, Rupert introduces ""Rudolph, the Littlest Reindeer.""

videos.title: Terry Bradshaw, Billy Zane, Darlene Love
videos.overview: It's ""Holiday Tradition Night"" on the Late Show: Another Darlene Love/Bette Sussman performance of ""Christmas (Baby Please Come Home),"" along with another Paul Shaffer impression of Cher's ""O Holy Night,"" not to mention another Late Show QB Challenge with Jay Thomas.  Also, Biff goes to Queens to look for Santa.

videos.title: Quentin Tarantino, Anne Heche, Kenny Wayne Shepard Band
videos.overview: During Mailbag, ""The Biff Henderson Celebrity Telephone Interview"" interrogates a man claiming to be Dick Clark.  Later in the show, during Dave's interview with Anne Heche, Ellen Degeneres walks onstage with ""their"" baby (actually Michelle O'Callaghan's).

videos.title: Bridget Fonda, Matt Damon, Allan Harvey
videos.overview: David Sanborn sits in; Ms. Markey's kindergarten kids in Bowie, MD each write an essay titled ""If I Could Have One Wish""; Bridget Fonda promotes ""Jackie Brown.""

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Leila Kenzle, George Miller
videos.overview: Dave talks about his plans for New Year's.

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Howie Long, Louie C.K.
videos.overview: Like he does every year, Dave regales us with another one of his far-fetched New Year's stories.  After Leon Pendarvis brings him down to earth, Dave confesses that he and Biff celebrated by photocopying their face at Kinko's.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw,  Tobey Maquire, Fiona Apple
videos.overview: Leon's still here; a customer from Joe G's stars in the quickie movie ""Titanic: Death Boat â€˜98""; the outside-cam reveals radioactive steam coming out of the Chrysler Building.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Peta Wilson, Streb
videos.overview: Recently deposed ""Weekend Update"" anchorman Norm MacDonald vents his anger to Dave; daredevil dance group Streb performs.

videos.title: Minnie Driver, Paul Simon, Cast of The Capeman
videos.overview: Marc Anthony and the Broadway cast members perform a song from Paul Simon's new musical ""The Capeman.""

videos.title: Penelope Ann Miller, Terry Pledger, Collective Soul
videos.overview: CBS Mailbag: Chris Schmitt of Ottawa, Kansas asks why Biff has a scowl on his face. Biff comes onstage as a lobster is hooked on his backside. Later, Dave explains the formula for comedy success: ""Lobster + Ass = Funny!""

videos.title: Robin Williams, Dave Chappelle, Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham
videos.overview: Mick Fleetwood sits in, and later he plays drums for tonight's musical guests, fellow Fleetwood Mac members Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham.

videos.title: Bill Pullman, Jim Breuer, Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham
videos.overview: Mick Fleetwood sits in again, now joined by pianist Allen Toussaint.  Also, tonight's ""May We See Your Photos, Please?"" is a surprising disappointment, as there was only one customer, and he was dropping off a roll of film.

videos.title: Peter O'Toole, Martin Scorcese
videos.overview: ""Dave Sucks"" is spray-painted onto the World Trade Center, while ""The Masked Magician"" (Pat Farmer) performs a dangerous trick on Kenny Sheehan.

videos.title: Kenneth Branagh, Spice Girls, Jim Nantz
videos.overview: Biff has hot towels for the audience, while the Spice Girls perform ""Stop.""

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Sandra Bernhard, Jars of Clay
videos.overview: Mailbag: Biff stars in the Swedish sitcom knockoff ""Mjørk and Minde.""  Also, famed session keyboardist Chuck Leavell sits in.

videos.title: Michael Isikoff, Sarah Ferguson
videos.overview: Dave finds three girls in the audience that have never slept with President Clinton; Bob Borden covers the Super Bowl, so Dave implies that Sparky Mortimer can actually get some studying done this year; for one night only, the Top Ten Office moves to Worchester, Pennsylvania; Dave chats with the Newsweek reporter that broke the Monica Lewinsky scandal.

videos.title: Robert Duvall, Kennedy, Emmylou Harris
videos.overview: Dave brings out his top intern Duane, who might be a Chippendale dancer on the side.  Also, Dave complains about Late Show knockoffs and shows as an example ""The Simon Harvey Show"" from Australia. The host: Tony Randall.

videos.title: Michael Keaton, Brian Williams, Blues Traveller
videos.overview: John Popper sits in; Dave does the first of his many all-Clinton monologues.

videos.title: David Spade, Justin Miller, Jeff Garlin
videos.overview: Ruth Brown sits in, while Dave makes crepes with child cooking prodigy Justin Miller.

videos.title: Ethan Hawke, Merrill Markoe
videos.overview: Paul performs a song promoting Tom Selleck's appearance next week, while Dave and Merrill Markoe pretend to flirt.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Steve Forbes, Jake Johannsen
videos.overview: Throughout the week, guitarist Mike Campbell fills in for Felicia, who has the flu; Dave mentions that yesterday was the sixteenth anniversary of the debut of Late Night; Tom Arnold promotes his struggling, self-titled WB sitcom.

videos.title: John Goodman, Mitch Hedberg, Jeff Gordon
videos.overview: Anton introduced as Prince Randusi of Senegal; Mike Campbell is still here; ten interns present the Top Ten; John Goodman shows a clip of him jumping into a fountain pool.

videos.title: Dan Akroyd, Naomi Campbell, Duncan Sheik
videos.overview: Dan Aykroyd promotes Blues Brothers 2000, which, might I add, co-stars Paul Shaffer.  Also, Duncan Sheik performs ""Everyone, Everywhere.""

videos.title: Dan Rather, Honeymoon the pig, Cast of Ragtime
videos.overview: Dave chats Pam Amba and ""Honeymoon,"" the pig that saved her life.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Shania Twain
videos.overview: It's the opening of the Winter Olympics, so Dave announces miniature Ski-Jumping Dogs in the backdrop. Also, live via satellite, Dave chats with his mom in Nagano, Japan.

videos.title: Richard Simmons, John Elway
videos.overview: Throughout the night, ski-jumping dogs perform in the backdrop; Felicia returns; Dorothy Letterman makes her first report from Nagano.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Blues Brothers
videos.overview: Remote: Dave goes door-to-door in New Jersey again, this time to ask about the Winter Olympics.  Also, to promote their new film, the reunited Blues Brothers Band (including Paul, Dan Aykroyd, John Goodman, and a twelve-year-old boy) perform ""Sweet Home Chicago.""

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Cindy Crawford, Jonny Moseley
videos.overview: Jonny ""Big Air"" Moseley, Gold-medal winner for Mogul Skiing, shows off the large pieces of whitebread being served to the American Olympians.

videos.title: Adam Sandler, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: While playing ""Know Your Current Events,"" a soon-to-be unemployed stewardess for United Airlines tells Dave, ""Passengers are our worst enemy.""  Also, ten US Olympic hockey players present the Top Ten, while Dorothy interviews Kristi Yamaguchi, Jim Nantz, and K. C. Boutiette.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, LeAnn Rimes & Bryan White
videos.overview: Live via satellite, it's Dave's mom at the Winter Olympics in Nagano, Japan, where she introduces a skiing monkey.  She also presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Heather Locklear, Tom Selleck
videos.overview: Live via satellite in Nagano, Japan: Dorothy's feeling under the weather, Biff and his wife Carolyn chat with Winter Olympic athletes.  Also, Tony shows us a cue card supposedly burned in an office fire that weekend, while Dale Earnhardt, Sr. presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Mike Myers, Paula Cole
videos.overview: Mike Myers chats with (live via satellite) his mother, while Dorothy interrogates Picabo Street.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Bingo Granny
videos.overview: Regis, Paul, Mujibur and Sirajul help Dave learn how to skate a la Kristi Yamiguchi, while Dave and Jerry Foley observe and interview ""Future Olympic Hopefuls.""

videos.title: Bob Dole, Marilyn Manson
videos.overview: Almost halfway into the show, Dave suddenly leaves and gets into a cab that drives to Mexico, then San Francisco. Dave then boats across the Pacific, stops in Japan and sweeps the ice during an Olympic Curling competition in Nagano.  Also in Nagano, Dorothy stumbles upon Bob Dole, while Biff searches for celebrity look-alikes.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Jonny Moseley
videos.overview: In ""Day in New York City with Olympic Judges,"" the one female judge gives Dave's performance in bed a 2.8; during Stupid Pet Tricks, Biff demonstrates a trick he learned in Nagano; throughout the night, Jonny Moseley ski-jumps outside the theater on 53rd Street.

videos.title: Jeff Bridges, Nikki Stone, John Fogerty
videos.overview: Paul Newman drops by to annoy Dave; outtakes from last week's ""Olympic Hopefuls"" piece are shown; Dave persuades a less-than-homesick Dorothy to go back to Indianapolis.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Sarah Tueting & Cammi Granato, Sarah McLachlan
videos.overview: Dave points out that Rob Burnett made a cameo on last night's episode of Cosby; the editors of the Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue reveal that most of the photo shoot was done at the White House; Dave chats with Cammi Granato and Sarah Tueting of the gold medal-winning US women's hockey team.

videos.title: Susan Sarandon, Eric Bergoust, Aretha Franklin
videos.overview: David ""Fathead"" Newman sits in on sax; Bob Borden reports from the Grammys; Dave shows an ad for ""Saddam's Beret Bazaar.""

videos.title: David Schwimmer, Chris Witty, Shawn Colvin
Kate Winslet, Tara Lipinski, Ray Romano
Patrick Stewart, Frank Urbancic, Joan Cusak
videos.overview: As usual, Dave cheats in his annual competition with the World Grocery Bagging Champion. This years' sucker: Frank Urbancic. Also, Dave shows a (bogus) clip of President Clinton skiing, then shows a preview of the upcoming CBS special ""Pat Farmer: Master Escape Artist"" (co-starring Kenny Sheehan).

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Gabriel Byrne, Richie Sambora
videos.overview: In the latest ""Kid Scientists"" segment, Lee Marek and his prodigies demonstrate the concept of heat.  Also, Richie Sambora performs ""All That Really Matters.""

videos.title: Helena Bonham Carter, Peter Fonda, Loreena McKennitt
videos.overview: Biff's latest celebrity interview involves a fat, bald guy claiming to be Leonardo DiCaprio.

videos.title: Siskel & Ebert, Karl Malone, Mark Chesnutt
videos.overview: Gerard hosts ""The Making of the Top Ten,"" a short documentary that reveals more about the writers' animosity towards Dave than the comedy bit that's being profiled.  Also, Mark Chesnutt sings ""Useless.""

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Richie Stachowski
videos.overview: Mailbag: Dave and his bodyguard (Bill DeLace) have a falling out.  Also, Dave chats with 12-year-old inventor/entrepreneur Richie Stachowski, creator of Water Talkies.

videos.title: Emma Thompson, Alex Zanardi, Willie Nelson & Emmylou Harris
videos.overview: Dave wears glasses for the duration of the show (a sign of things to come); Sean Pelton fills in for Anton, whom Dave dubs ""Anton Zippy Stickwork;"" Wilford Brimley sits in ""Paul Shaffer's Chair of Mystery;"" Formula One racing star Alex Zanardi cooks.

videos.title: John Travolta, Jack Johnson, The Chieftains
videos.overview: It looks at first like the studio is being filled with green beer, but it turns out that one of the camera lenses have been tinted; ""Leonardo DiCaprio"" (Gerard) gloats over his newfound stardom; Dave chats with child actor Jack Johnson.

videos.title: Bill Murray, Eddie Izzard, Gheorge Meuresun
Dennis Hopper, Robert Klein, Patricia Heaton
Charles Grodin, Edward Burns, Marcy Playground
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) ad for British Airways that is bursting with disclaimers; Laurie Diamond milks a cow backstage; another edition of ""Please Stop Calling Me Chief"" provides entertainment only to Dave; Charles Grodin acts remarkably hostile during his interview.

videos.title: Dolly Parton, Bob Hoskins
videos.overview: Biff hangs with the New York Yankees during Spring Training, while everybody in the audience gets free tickets to fly on British Airways.

videos.title: Al Franken, Lauren Holly, Ani DiFranco
videos.overview: Paul is introduced as ""Ramone Conde""; Dave introduces Mishi, the world record holder for smallest man alive, and later Mishi holds a kitty to demonstrate his miniscule size on camera; Helen Hunt (live via satellite) presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Evander Holyfield, Joseph Loveland, Michael Moore
videos.overview: Paul is introduced as Al Roker; throughout the night, Pat Farmer throws basketballs from the roof and into a bathtub on 53rd Street; Dave complains that the balls are ""fruity"";   Dave chats with a man who found $70,000 in a garbage can, then returned it to its rightful owner.

videos.title: Don Rickles, Mimi Rogers, Steve Miller
videos.overview: Biff reports on Yankees Spring Training, where he follows/stalks Paul O'Neill.  Also, Steve Miller performs ""Fly Like An Eagle.""

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Heather Graham, Barenaked Ladies
videos.overview: Paul is introduced as Cubby O'Brien; Heather Graham meets The Guy on Fire; Alec Baldwin helps Heather in a weird April Fool's gag in which they sign off and wish everybody a good night a la Saturday Night Live.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Ice Cube, Natalie Imbruglia
videos.overview: Bruce Willis is live via satellite in Idaho from the set of his upcoming film ""Breakfast of Champions."" All night long he's inside a television monitor that bungee jumps off the roof, then gets dropped onto glass, a bathtub of pudding, and finally gets smashed from six stories onto the street.  Also, Tom Brokaw gets annoyed by Dave and in mid-interview walks right back to 30 Rockefeller Center.

videos.title: Tom Hanks, Matt Medenweldt, Scott Weiland
videos.overview: Tom Hanks interrupts the monologue because he and Dave are dressed alike; throughout the night, spelling bee champ Edmund Gillette stands next to Rob's desk and spells words; during Mailbag, Alan Kalter reacts badly to a letter asking if he's a freak by visiting the letter-writer (Jay Johnson) and punching in his face; Tom gets a new suit.

videos.title: Matt LeBlanc, Natasha Henstridge, The Lynns
videos.overview: Dave appears in student films as a side income, while Bob Borden runs throughout the city searching for Leonardo DiCaprio.

videos.title: Quentin Tarantino, Steven Weber, Clint Black
videos.overview: Clint Black sits in; Dave comments on the hot new drug Viagra, then shows a bogus ad for The Teletubbies.

videos.title: James Belushi, Lacey Chabert, Robbie Robertson
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Bob Borden tries to set off car alarms directly outside the theater; Dave announces that The Guy on Fire is willing to perform for $2700 a pop, though the guy will come out sans flames for only $700; Jim Belushi attempts singing a old Perry Como song.

videos.title: Val Kilmer, Jimmie Walker, cast of Cabaret
videos.overview: After mentioning a minor disagreement from earlier today, Dave announces his ""blood feud"" with director Jerry Foley; Mujibur and Sirajul appear on Jerry Springer, and no one's surprise, beat the crap out of each other; Dave starts ostracizing all the people who support Jerry in the ongoing squabble; Alan Cumming and the cast of the Broadway revival of Caberet perform the opening number.

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Hatty Jones, Tori Amos
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, a viewer asks if Dave has any plans to air his show from the space shuttle.  Somehow as a response, astronaut Buzz Aldrin is seen hitting golfballs on the theatre roof.

videos.title: Gwyneth Paltrow, Harmony Korine, Wyclef Jean
videos.overview: Dave announces the birth of Jerry Foley's son; after showing footage from last year of Rob Burnett unwittingly scaring his young daughter in a Easter Bunny suit, he tries on a different outfit with more or less the same results; Harmony Korine almost says something coherent while being interviewed about his new book, which he wouldn't particularly recommend, so Dave tells him to go back to his hotel and take a shower.

videos.title: Claire Danes, George Miller, Matthew Ryan
videos.overview: The Guy Not on Fire announces that he is now available for commercials and endorsements, and later in the show he is seen in an ad for Sizzler.  Also, Danny DeVito comes out onstage twice to protest Dave's jokes about him being a car hood ornament.

videos.title: Jason Alexander, Isabella Rossellini, Steve Earle
videos.overview: The Guy Not on Fire appears in his first paid ad (for Elite Computers); a chat with Jason Alexander is interrupted by another inane special report by Alan Richardson; Steve Earle and the Dukes perform ""I Still Carry You Around.""

videos.title: Ricki Lake, Vaughn Cordle, Rita Wilson
videos.overview: ""Know Your Current Events"" is interrupted so that The Man Not on Fire can pitch the Biore® self-heating mask.  Later in the show, Dave admits that he's on a guilt trip for bumping an audience member for the shameless plug.

videos.title: Jennifer Aniston, Jerry Springer, Al Green
videos.overview: Amongst the festivities of ""Chicago Night"":  Jerry Springer's bouncers stand on opposite sides of the stage; The Man Not on Fire appears in an ad for Gold Coast Drugs; the Top Ten home office is temporarily moved to nearby Schaumberg, Illinois; local blues singer (and frequent guest) Taj Mahal presents the Top Ten; Bob Borden goes on a frantic pursuit through the Windy City attempting to get an interview with Oprah.

videos.title: Marisa Tomei, Ryan Leaf, Alana Davis
videos.overview: Dave persuades an audience member named Gary to shave off his beard; The man who was on fire, then wasn't and is now on fire again promotes Kraus Chiropractic in Iowa; Gary orders a sandwich at Hello Deli; Dave and recent NFL draft pick Ryan Leaf throw footballs at a manhole.

videos.title: Jack Hanna, Ray Allen, Dave Matthews Band
videos.overview: Willie ""Blue Moon"" Watts sits in on pedal guitar; Dave announces that there have been some technical difficulties they may prevent Johnny Depp from appearing on the 1000th show later in the week; The Man on Fire sings the praises of Feline Pine kitty litter.

videos.title: Patrick Swayze, Hugh Hefner
videos.overview: The latest roll call suggests that The Guy on Fire has officially sold out when he runs across the stage (in flames, of course) holding a sign for Highland Metals, Inc.

videos.title: Gena Lee Nolan, Mark Wahlberg, Brian Regan
videos.overview: A monkey assumes power in the control room, while the Top Ten is interrupted by Antoine's Po' Boys and Deli spokesperson The Man on Fire.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Norm MacDonald, Pearl Jam
videos.overview: Tonight's ""Stupid Human Tricks"": Richard Anthony of Ontario reaches back over his shoulder and gives himself a wedgie; John Rites of Nebraska fits three McDonald's burgers into his mouth; and Mike Garcia and Craig Love of Milwaukee do an impression of a helicopter as one spins on the other's head; Gene Siskel makes his first public appearance since undergoing brain surgery that April;  Dave announces Johnny Depp cancelled due to the technical difficulties from earlier in the week, and Paul goes on a tirade about it.

videos.title: Elle MacPherson, Jon Favreau, Usher
videos.overview: Maynard Ferguson sits in again; Paul runs the Kentucky Derby; Dave shows a microphone plaque he got from the staff.

videos.title: Donald Trump, Jayson Williams, Cast of Home Coming, Trisha Yearwood
videos.overview: The cast of the faux musical ""Homecoming"" performs a show-stopping number. Also, Trisha Yearwood performs ""Never Let You Go Again.""

videos.title: Sally Field, Philip Bigler, Lyle Lovett
videos.overview: Biff tries out tobacco juice spin art; Dave shows a clip from last night's show in which he mixed up ""Viagra"" with ""Niagara""; Biff teaches Sally Field how to spit tobacco juice.

videos.title: Matt Lauer, Jada Pinkett Smith, Green Day
videos.overview: Dave promotes his new talk show summer camp, while Green Day performs ""King for a Day.""

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Jim Lovell
