videos.overview: Biff goes to Texas to learn to be a cowboy, and to make tonight's audience (residents of Houston) feel more at home, Lyle Lovett shows up to sing an old Hank Williams song, with Biff riding his horse onstage.

videos.title: Fran Drescher, Bob Berman, Faith Hill
videos.overview: Dave visits a group of sailors on the audience, and one of them does a push-up onstage; Dave shows the audience today's (bogus) edition of The Family Circus; Faith Hill performs ""This Kiss.""

videos.title: Christopher Reeve, Hanson
videos.overview: Dave shows another bogus ""Family Circus"" cartoon; Paul is discovered cheering on Hanson with a small army of teenyboppers outside.

videos.title: Warren Beatty, Wayne Knight, Bonnie Raitt
videos.overview: Dave notices the standby audience really has nothing to do, so makes them do a  jigsaw puzzle.  When they finish it at the end of the show, we see that it's an image of Al Chez.

videos.title: Jim Breuer, Tara Lipinski, Foo Fighters
videos.overview: Dave gripes about the eight-minute late start for the show tonight due to golf coverage.  Rapidly becoming despondent, he picks up a bottle of tequila and tosses back a few at the desk.  Also, Dave mentions that the CBS program Diagnosis Murder had the unfortunate distinction of airing a brand new episode up against the Seinfeld finale, and shows a clip that proves that they were phoning it in.

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Beau Jaques and the Zydeco Highrollers
videos.overview: Continuing a sweeps period trend of having the audience represent a different city, Dave greets 700+ residents of New Orleans, Louisiana.  Keeping up with the theme, Mayor Mark Morial presents Paul with a key to the city, Na'lens native John Goodman presents the Top Ten, and Biff visits Bourbon Street.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, David Wells, Natalie Merchant
videos.overview: The outside cam peers through the window of Dave's office to show the world a very hideous billboard promoting the sitcom Friends.  Matthew Perry drops by to vandalize the advertisement.

videos.title: Sandra Bullock, Jeff Foxworthy, Cast of One Small Step
videos.overview: The outside cam returns to the Friends ad that Matthew Perry wrecked last night, and Dave explains why he shouldn't be sued; Rob Burnett draws another doodle of Dave's lawyers; the Top Ten list is interrupted by the office manager in Wahoo, Nebraska (voice of Charles Grodin).

videos.title: Drew Carey, Scarlett Johannson, Soul Asylum
videos.overview: Biff reports from a Bulls-Pacers playoff game; teen actress Scarlett Johansson promotes The Horse Whisperer; Rob Burnett is dressed to the nines tonight, so Dave asks him to host the last twenty minutes of the show.

videos.title: Ted Danson, Mae Whitman, The Flatlanders
videos.overview: A hairstylist that appeared in tonight's ""Know Your Current Events"" cuts Dave's hair for twenty bucks.   He later gives her a $1000 tip.

videos.title: Harry Connick, Jr., Hank Azaria
videos.overview: A parody of VH-1's ""Behind the Music"" features Paul Shaffer's rise and fall and rise again, with testimonials from Kris Kristofferson, Eddie Vedder, Sting, Erik Estrada (who replaced Paul as bandleader), Lou Reed, and WCBS-TV's local news anchor Dana Tyler (see recap).

videos.title: John Goodman, Esther Canadas, Sarah McLachlan
videos.overview: Dave updates his map of the various locales in which he has received speeding tickets; Dave mentions that the son of Dave Dorsett was selected in today's MLB draft; Biff promotes his new culinary program ""Cookin' Naked with Biff""; Art Garfunkel shoots free throws, and then goes one-on-one with a lookalike staffer named Gary.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Jacques Villeneuve, Randy Travis
videos.overview: All night long, animals lick the camera lens. Included are a pot-bellied pig, lemur, a skunk, a miniature horse, and a guy dressed as a cat (Film Coordinator Rick ""Shecky"" Scheckman).  Also, Dave announces his new catchphrase: ""Holy crap!""

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker, Bill Bradley, Chase Butrell
videos.overview: Sarah Jessica Parker promotes her new HBO comedy Sex and the City, while ""Paul Shaffer's Chair of Mystery"" reveals the uglier side of Julia Roberts (played by Kenny Rogers).

videos.title: Evander Holyfield, Laura Linney, Fastball
videos.overview: After being bumped the last two nights, Late Show intern Jeremy Weiner finally gets his moment in the sun in ""Dave Hangs with Interns,"" a segment that lasts around five seconds.

videos.title: George Carlin, Bob Saget, Emmylou Harris, Indigo Girls, Luscious Jackson, Rebekah
videos.overview: Live via satellite at the Beverly Hills Hotel in sunny Southern California, Walter Matthau gets a haircut. Also, Luscious Jackson, Emmylou Harris, and the Indigo Girls perfrom together to promote Lilith Fair '98.

videos.title: Whoopi Goldberg, Janeane Garofalo
videos.overview: Tonight's remote: Delivery guys deliver stuff to Dave's ""apartment"" in Flushing Meadows; items include a tree, a clown, beer, a sofa, a TV, and a singing telegram.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Andy Dick
videos.overview: Dave tries to call Merv Griffin, but ends up chatting with his clueless receptionist; Dave shows a subpoena caddy he claims Martha Stewart made for President Clinton; Bill Cosby performs stand-up in a chair.

videos.title: Bob Newhart, Nicole Sullivan, Wendy Liebman
Harrison Ford, Dane Cook
videos.overview: A Starbucks is opened inside the band section, while actor-comedian Dane Cook makes his television stand-up debut.

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Paul Rodriguez
videos.overview: Dave obsesses over some new words in the Merriam Webster Dictionary, and then reads definitions from an advance copy to the audience.

videos.title: Naomi Campbell, Luke Buchheit, Sinead O'Connor
videos.overview: Live from the Beverly Hills Hilton, Casey Kasem arm wrestles bellhops; Dave and Tony look for the best steak restaurant in NYC; Dave chats with a boy from Jersey who had seven prom dates.

videos.title: David Duchovny, Stevie Nicks
videos.overview: The outside cam reveals the long line of people waiting with anticipation to see the next ""Charts and Graphs"" segment on June 30.  Also, Dave is started to find that tonight's Top Ten has no title, but counts down anyway.

videos.title: Ellen Barkin, Jeff Altman, Sonic Youth
videos.overview: An audience member walks out in disgust when Dave reminds everyone that the next ""Charts & Graphs"" segment in not for another two weeks.  Also, Tony forgets a cue card and Dave gives him considerable grief.

videos.title: Sam Donaldson, Gloria Reuben, Babyface & Des'ree
videos.overview: Dave promotes the overhauled Late Show site, while Tony Randall brags about having a baby (his second) at age 78 with his own Top Ten list.

videos.title: Anthony Edwards, George Miller, Sean Lennon
videos.overview: Overexcited soccer commentator Andres Cantor presents the Top Ten; Sean Lennon performs ""Home.""

videos.title: Piedmont Bird Callers, George Clooney, Steve Yzerman
videos.overview: The Piedmont Bird Callers, once a favored act on Johnny Carson's show, make their third-ever appearance on Letterman.  Also, Dave chats with Steve Yzerman, captain of the back-to-back Stanley Cup champion Detroit Red Wings.

videos.title: John McEnroe, The Pretenders
videos.overview: Al Norwood stirs Dave's coffee with the boom mike; Biff attempts to play the sax; Dave shows a clip of his supposed cameo in the ""X-Files"" movie.

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Chris Eigeman, Largo
videos.overview: Tony gives Dave the finger, while up-and-coming singer/actress Jennifer Lopez promotes Out of Sight.

videos.title: Dennis Quaid, Chloe Sevigny, Grant Lee Buffalo
videos.overview: Inspired by watching an episode of Wall Street Week where the panelists sit at a coffee table, Dave asks Biff to ""host"" the guests in the green room.

videos.title: Mary Tyler Moore, Ron Eldard
videos.overview: Mailbag: Paul goes to desperate measures in order to get a raise, while Mujibur and Sirajul go on a wild goose chase for one of Dave's blue cards.

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow, Mike Piazza, Billy Bragg & Wilco
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Pat and Kenny throw stuff off the roof, including two 5-gallon water jugs, a pinball machine, twenty gallons of paint, and a TV/VCR set playing a Jerry Springer tape.

videos.title: Martha Anne Godwin, Kristen Johnston, Lucinda Williams
videos.overview: After several weeks of hype, hoopla, and anticipation, Dave finally does a ""Charts and Graphs"" segment; Dave claims that there's a webcam of him on the CBS site; child hollerin' champion Martha Anne Goodwin attempts to shatter Dave's eardrums.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Steve Zahn, The Hummingbirds with Stevie Wonder & Paul Simon
videos.overview: Thinking that it's robbing him of half of his audience, Dave shows phony clips of the X-Games competition being aired on cable; The Dixie Hummingbirds (featuring Stevie Wonder and Paul Simon) perform ""Loves Me like a Rock.""

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Hatty Jones, Spice Girls
videos.overview: In honor of Independence Day, Biff does a report from Colonial Williamsburg; Ben Stiller promotes There's Something About Mary; The Spice Girls make their first television appearance since the departure of Geri ""Ginger"" Halliwell.

videos.title: The Beltway Bunch, Stupid Pet Tricks, Bob Dole
videos.overview: During Mailbag, various staffers show the audience their baby pictures; Dave introduces a musical comedy troupe called ""The Beltway Bunch"" (a rip-off of The Capital Steps), and Tony runs them offstage; just before introducing tonight's ""Stupid Pet Tricks,"" Dave thanks Merrill Markoe (who underwent surgery earlier in the day) for giving him the idea to do this segment.

videos.title: Don Rickles, Matt Drudge, Cherry Poppin' Daddies
videos.overview: Dave points out an audience member that resembles Rupert; Dave gives a little league baseball team a pep talk; Cherry Poppin' Daddies perform ""Here Comes the Snake.""

videos.title: Matt Dillon, Daniel Boulud, Arj Barker
videos.overview: Soul singer Chuck Jackson sits in; Dave shows the audience what a laugh track looks like; the audience is forced to sit through another edition of ""Please Stop Calling Me Chief.""

videos.title: Antonio Banderas, Chris Elliot
videos.overview: Some guy in a kimono sits in with the band; in honor of Antonio Banderas' new movie, Rob doodles on a legal pad to show what Dave would look like if he was Zorro; Chris Elliott and Gerard Mulligan do a taste test.

videos.title: Anthony Hopkins, Cowboy Junkies
videos.overview: Know Your Current Events: the husband of one of tonight's contestants volunteers to be put to sleep by hypnotist Dr. Neil Cavey.  Feeling anxious due to all the attention, he never falls asleep.

videos.title: Gabriel Byrne, John Witherspoon, Tricky & P.J. Harvey
videos.overview: The ""Top Ten Cool Ways the Government Could Spend $63 Billion"" is followed by an investigation by WCBS reporter David Diaz, who scrutinizes the lack of effort put into the long-running comedy piece.  Interviews with Gerard, Biff, Richard Jewell and FBI Agent Fox Mulder (David Duchovny) leave the mystery unsolved.

videos.title: James Caan, Buck O'Neil, Lenny Kravitz
videos.overview: Live out on the street, we see the traffic ""congestion"" created by New York hosting the Goodwill Games; Dave changes his tie midway through the show; James Caan shaves his mustache.

videos.title: Janet Jackson, Scott Farrell, Nanci Griffith
videos.overview: In the latest roll call, Dave signs ""Zorro"" (Anton), an audience member with an enormous cold sore, and ""Lynette the Late Show Opera Singer"" off the checklist.

videos.title: Tony Danza, Peter Farrelly, Brian Wilson
videos.overview: Biff stands on the sidewalk in 95 degree heat as he tries to determine once again whether a Popsicle® or a Fudgesicle® will melt faster; around the corner from the theater, Dave hoses down passerby; The Farrelly Brothers promote the sleeper hit of 1998, There's Something About Mary, while they strut their ""knowledge"" of sumo wrestling.

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Gloria Estefan
videos.overview: Biff visits Branson, Missouri, while Marilu Henner unsuccessfully tries to persuade Dave into doing some calisthenics.

videos.title: Pauly Shore, Pam Grier, Natalie Imbruglia
videos.overview: A new feature debuts, as Dave announces #3 on the Top Ten List at the start of the show; Mujibur and Sirajul lose their virginity on an internet webcam, and later they hop in bed with Pauly Shore; Natalie Imbruglia performs ""Smoke.""

videos.title: Jenny McCarthy, Adam Arkin, Tori Amos
videos.overview: Dave has a lengthy discourse on an article he read in Martha Stewart Living; ""Late Show Meteorologist"" Skip Hopson reports from 53rd Street; Tori Amos performs ""Spark.""

videos.title: Kids with animals, Gary Sinise, Goo Goo Dolls
videos.overview: A softball game between Late Show staffers and the cast of Miss Saigon is rigged by Dave; Anton goes into ""Buddy Rich, Jr."" mode and performs drums solos throughout the night; The Goo Goo Dolls perform ""Iris.""

videos.title: Yasmine Bleeth, David Brenner, Barenaked Ladies
videos.overview: Dave shows a personal ad from the Washington Post that looks like it was written by President Clinton; Alan fantasizes about waffles; Paul serenades Yasmine Bleeth.

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Jenni, Smashing Pumpkins
videos.overview: Dave chats with Jennifer Ringley, the Seattle-based college student best known for operating the voyeuristic website JenniCAM.

videos.title: Jamie Lee Curtis, George Freestone
videos.overview: Dave points out an audience member who looks like Kenny Rogers; during ""Late Show en espanol,"" Tony walks out in a suit and bad wig and does a Letterman-type monologue; Dave chats with George Firestone, America's oldest living Boy Scout.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Dee Dee Meyers, The Verve
videos.overview: During a segment in which he shows real and doctored Clinton and Gore news articles, Dave announces that his pants are too tight.

videos.title: Noyz Boyz, Nathan Lane, Boy George & Culture Club
videos.overview: Paul and Anton Fig participate in a game called ""Average Television Viewer vs. Late Show Television Viewer.""

videos.title: Penn & Teller, French Stewart, Wynton Marsalis
videos.overview: During the annual ""New for Summer"" segment, Mujibur and Sirajul are declared ""Late Show Prom King and Queen.""  Later, Penn and Teller perform their new magic act.

videos.title: Jerry Seinfeld, Hunter Scott
videos.overview: Dave feels highly suspect of the audience's intelligence during ""Know Your Current Events""; John Popper sits in with the band; Dave chats with Hunter Scott, a 13-year-old WW II history buff.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Doris Roberts, Blues Traveler
videos.overview: John Popper is still sitting in with the band, while Doris Roberts promotes ""Everybody Loves Raymond.""

videos.title: Leslie Nielsen, David Roth, Teresa Witherspoon
videos.overview: Biff goes outside to annoy people with a bullhorn.  Later, Dave meets David Roth, a noted coin magician.

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Bobby Rahal, Harvey Danger
videos.overview: Throughout the show, stockbrokers jump out of a fifth-story window.

videos.title: Ray Liotta, Sela Ward, Liz Phair
videos.overview: ""Riverdance"" performs live via telephone from Cincinnati.  Later, Liz Phair promotes her new album, ""WhiteChocolateSpaceEgg.""

videos.title: Angela Basset, Pete Townshend
videos.overview: Paul and somebody named ""Mary Beth"" host a spoof of ""Regis & Kathie Lee"" with Inky Mendez playing Gelman.  Regis suddenly pops out of the audience, heckles them, and gets thrown out of the theater.

videos.title: Wesley Snipes, Robert Klein
videos.overview: Wesley Snipes promotes the movie ""Spawn.""

videos.title: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Darryl Strawberry, Joe Cocker
videos.overview: During a segment comparing President Clinton's vacation to Dave's, a stockbroker comes in for a hug.

videos.title: Beau Bridges, Terrell Davis, Squirrel Nut Zippers
videos.overview: Dave points out that the show has undergone budget cuts, which might explain the tiny cue cards Tony's holding.  Later, Beau Bridges promotes his new series, ""Maximum Bob.""

videos.title: Terry Bradshaw, Jesse Jackson
videos.overview: Dave makes a lenghty rant about ""The Late Shift"" after an audience member asks him for an autograph; Martin Short sings the Top Ten List; Terry Bradshaw makes his predictions for the football season.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Chris Cardone, Tom Agna
videos.overview: Alan Kalter comments on home run record that is being chased by Mark McGwire; Dave announces that CBS ""just don't care 'bout"" the new fall lineup; Ray Romano talks about his family.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Jason Patric, Eve 6
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Dave and the band play ""Let's Screw with Paul Shaffer's Mind.""

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Luisa Conlon
videos.overview: Junior Brown sits in with the band, while Biff reports from Busch Stadium in St. Louis.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, Willie Nelson
videos.overview: Biff makes another report from Busch Stadium, while Dave flirts with Andie MacDowell.

videos.title: Tim Forneris, Stephen Dorff, Wynonna
videos.overview: Dave goes on a tirade about the CBS watermark on the lower right hand side of the screen.  Later, Dave chats with the guy who caught Mark McGwire's 62nd Home Run ball.

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Paul Hopkins
videos.overview: Dave stuggles to grow a beard; Charles Grodin promotes his talk show; Dave chats with the former Washington Senators pitcher who gave up Babe Ruth's 59th home run in 1927 (in his MLB debut, no less).

videos.title: Jack Hanna, Gretchen Mol, Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Paul, Tony, Biff and Sid announce that they're going to tour the country as a CSNY-type guitar band.

videos.title: Cindy Crawford, Jeff Greenfield, Hootie & The Blowfish
videos.overview: Dave congratulates the staff on the big Emmy win the previous night, then grills Rob Burnett for not kissing his wife just before he accepted the award.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Jackie Chan, Vince Gill
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) Mastercard ad starring Ken Starr; Biff goes to Chicago for another Home Run Report; Jackie Chan does an great Elvis impression.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, George Hamilton
videos.overview: Biff brings in scissors for a tie trim; Calvert impersonates Hank Williams, Jr.; Bill Cosby plays sax under the alias ""Philly Billy Be Bop.""

videos.title: Denis Leary, George Hamilton
videos.overview: Dave apologizes for his affair with Angela Lansbury, while Biff apologizes for his affair with Dave's wife.  Shortly afterwards, Dorothy calls and insults Dave.

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Brian Benben, Brian Setzer Orchestra
videos.overview: Dave makes another rant pertaining to the CBS Watermark; kid Geography whiz Jonathan Estrada helps out during CBS Mailbag; Brian Benben promotes his new, self-titled (and quickly cancelled) sitcom.

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Evander Holyfield, Dixie Chicks
videos.overview: Dave talks about a Steak House Onion Machine, while Michael J. Fox promotes his sitcom ""Spin City.""

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Meredith Viera, Lyle Lovett
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) ad for ESPN2's ""Xtreme Presidental Perjury,"" while J.Lo promotes ""Antz.""

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Marv Albert, Kevin James
videos.overview: A gag promo for the TV series ""Biffy, The Umpire Layer"" is declared the worst joke ever seen on the show; an ""Audience Vote"" determines Rip Taylor as tonight's guest instead of an absentee Cindy Crawford; Kevin James does some stand-up to promote ""The King of Queens.""

videos.title: Howard Stern, Katie Holmes
videos.overview: Dave makes fun of Inky's summer camp outfit.  Later, Howard Stern plays with his gut and strips to his underwear in order to show off his legs.

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Jean Reno, Rob Zombie
videos.overview: A fawn walks onstage during CBS Mailbag; comedian Jon Stewart promotes ""The Daily Show.""

videos.title: Fran Drescher, Chris Kattan, Elvis Costello & Burt Bacharach
videos.overview: Musical guests Elvis Costello and Burt Bacharach perform ""I Just Don't Know What To Do With Myself."" Also, ""newly elected chancellor of Germany Gerhardt Schroeder"" sits in with the band ""all night long"" on alto sax.

videos.title: Chris Tucker, Faith Ford, Eagle Eye Cherry
videos.overview: Dave lets Inky go on a ""gum break;"" George Clarke is introduced as operator of the Late Show hedge fund; Biff demands more scandals involving President Clinton; Chris Tucker promotes Rush Hour.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Nick Mason, Tony Bennett
videos.overview: Warren fills in for Paul (out for Yom Kippur); Kelsey Grammer brings out his dog during his interview.

videos.title: Drew Carey, Billy Connolly, Hedwig & The Angry Inch
videos.overview: Dennis, a baseball-bunting pig, waits throughout the show to shag some balls on 53rd Street.  He ends up getting bumped after the ""Hedwig"" performance goes on too long.

videos.title: Steve Martin, Cokie Roberts
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Alan promotes ""Alan Kalter's Music To Make Love By,"" which includes two TV theme songs and a doorbell.  Later, Steve Martin's lengthy absence from appearing on the show is explained in a little film called ""Dave and Steve's Gay Vacation.""

videos.title: Kelly Preston, Peter Boyle, Semisonic
videos.overview: Dave experiments with how he can give the finger without being censored; Kelly Preston promotes ""Holy Man.""

videos.title: Elizabeth & Bob Dole, Joaquin Phoenix
videos.overview: Tony Mendez does a ""card trick""; Tito Puente contributes drumrolls to the Top Ten list; Dave shows a (bogus) new, improved $20 bill.

videos.title: Jeff Goldblum, John Mellencamp
videos.overview: A new segment called ""This Day in Late Show History"" reveals that October 7 was a Saturday in 1994.  Biff corrects Dave, telling him it was a Friday.  Later, Jeff Goldblum promotes ""Holy Man.""

videos.title: Isabella Rossellini, Stephen Baldwin, George Miller
videos.overview: Dave takes a look at Tony's hands, which have marker ink all over them.  Later, George Miller comments on the Clinton/Lewinsky scandal.

videos.title: Joan Lunden, Jeff Altman, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Tony bares his ass again, and The Foul-Mouthed Scenic Designer (Kathleen Ankers) lives up to her title.

videos.title: Mark McGwire, Robert Benigni, Bruce Hornsby
videos.overview: The calvacade of mediocre crops continues as ""Joe Whitworth"" from Oregon walks onstage with a ""gigantic"" pumpkin; Biff presents a World Series Report despite a sore throat; Roberto Benigni plugs ""Life is Beautiful""; Mark McGwire does a little hitting practice on 53rd Street with Dave Dorsett's son Chris.

videos.title: State Fair Champions, Ringo Starr
videos.overview: It's Dave's 3000th show in late night, so he celebrates by bringing Charles Grodin onstage to break the monotony of chatting with Paul.  Later, Dave introduces some State Fair winners, including a 530-pound pumpkin and a middle-aged champion hog caller.

videos.title: Jeff Daniels, David Cross, Mitch Hedberg
videos.overview: Dave and George Clarke go to Yankee Stadium, where the building engineer hits a home run.

videos.title: Danny Glover, Cal Ripken Jr., R.E.M.
videos.overview: Biff participates in more interviews in part two of his World Series report, while Danny Glover plugs ""Lethal Weapon 4.""

videos.title: Naomi Campbell, David Wells, R.E.M.
videos.overview: Tony's eye itches, and Dave gives him a hard time for potentially screwing up the cue cards; during CBS Mailbag, Dave interrogates TV star ""Calista Flockhart"" (Gerard), who magically transforms into the dancing baby from her hit show ""Ally McBeal""; Dave welcomes World Series hero David Wells.

videos.title: Danny DeVito, Joe Torre, Eddie Brill
videos.overview: Four shirtless guys (spelling ""YANKS"") bring out the Top Ten; Danny DeVito tries to sing.

videos.title: Martin Short, Eddie Izzard, Phish
videos.overview: Dave cons a Joe G's customer into appearing in a bogus campaign ad; Eddie Izzard does stand-up.

videos.title: Daniel Baldwin, Todd Solondz, Phil Collins
videos.overview: Biff shows outtakes from last week's World Series reports, while director Todd Solondz promotes ""Happiness.""

videos.title: Holly Hunter, Hunter S. Thompson, Garbage
videos.overview: Dave makes several jokes at the expense of septuagenarian spaceman John Glenn; Holly Hunter plugs Living Out Loud.

videos.title: Ted Danson, Denny Brauer, Black Sabbath
videos.overview: Dave announces the names of staff members who will run in the New York City Marathon; Biff gives out candy to the audience; Dave shows a box of Snoop Doggy Dogg dog biscuits, so David Diaz does an investigation of Dave plagiarizing the daytime talk show ""Donny and Marie.""

videos.title: Anthony Hopkins, Buzz Aldrin, Depeche Mode
videos.overview: New York Marathon winner John Kagwe runs through during the monologue, and is later followed by women's winner Franca Faicconi.  Later, Dave spills coffee on his tie and suffers a nervous breakdown, which is followed by a safety message from Paul.

videos.title: Queen Latifah, Ellie Lammer, Darrell Hammond
videos.overview: Dave gives bogus election results; the outside cam goes to Joe G's for another round of ""Please Stop Calling Me Debbie""; Dave chats with Ellie Lammer, a 12-year-old who examined parking meters for a school project.

videos.title: Adam Sandler, Jayson Williams, Soul Coughing
videos.overview: Dave shows a clip of new Minnesota governor Jesse ""The Body"" Ventura in the movie ""The Running Man""; Senator Chuck Schumer presents the Top Ten; basketball star (and future alleged murderer) Jayson Williams lifts weights with one hand.

videos.title: Denzel Washington, Father Mike Berner
videos.overview: Tony gets scolded for chewing gum; shortly after appearing on ""Know Your Current Events,"" an audience member starts singing; Dave interviews a Catholic priest that won the Publisher's Clearinghouse sweepstakes.

videos.title: George Pataki, Evan Metropoulis, P.J. Harvey
videos.overview: Dave chats with Evan Metropoulos, the 17-year-old CEO of the Bumble Bee Tuna Corp.

videos.title: George Michael, Col. Gail Halverson, Hanson
videos.overview: Dave mentions that Meryl Streep, tonight's scheduled guest and star of the movie ""One True Thing,"" had to cancel at the last minute.  In place of the Oscar-winner is Retired Col. Gail Halvorsen, who dropped candy on East German children during the airlift in 1949.

videos.title: Luke Perry, Tom Wolfe, Jay-Z
videos.overview: Tom Wolfe promotes his first novel in 11 years, ""The Man In Full.""

videos.title: Melanie Griffith, Walter Cronkite, Travis Tritt
Roma Downey, Kenneth Branagh, Goo Goo Dolls
videos.overview: Dave accuses Tony Mendez of goosing someone with a cue card; Roma Downey and Kenneth Branagh meet for the first time; Pat and Kenny sing the theme song to ""Pat and Kenny Read Oprah Transcripts.""

videos.title: Donald Trump, Doug Flutie, Sarah Silverman
Kid Scientists, Cameron Diaz, Mariah Carey
videos.overview: Jayson Williams of the New Jersey Nets operates one of the cameras; a ""Kid Scientist"" from Naperville, Illinois cracks eggs; Cameron Diaz plugs ""Very Bad Things.""

videos.title: Will Smith, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Dave once again takes away Tony's gum, while Paul tries to flirt with Monica Lewinsky and Linda Tripp.

videos.title: Christian Slater, Celine Dion & Bryan Adams
videos.overview: Drew Barrymore plugs ""Home Fries,"" while Celine Dion and Bryan Adams perform a duet.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Siskel & Ebert
videos.overview: Todd Rundgren sits in, while Drew Barrymore walks onstage so that she can show what her new dog looks like.

videos.title: Helen Hunt, Ray Romano
videos.overview: James Cotton sits in; Dave discusses Dr. Kevorkian and the safest handling of a Thanksgiving turkey; the 5th anniversary special (which aired that night) is spoofed.

videos.title: Geena Davis, Martha Stewart, Roger Daltrey
videos.overview: As he does almost every Thankgiving, Kreskin plays for pride in a little game called ""White Meat / Dark Meat.""  Tonight, he correctly guesses that Dennis Franz (live via telephone) will have white meat for his holiday dinner.

videos.title: Gwyneth Paltrow, Peter Berg, Bonnie Raitt
videos.overview: Jayson Williams of the Nets comments on the NBA lockout, then drops phony turkeys out the 4th floor window.  Later, Gwyneth Paltrow plugs â€˜Shakespeare In Love.""

videos.title: Michael Caine, Jewel
videos.overview: Dave warns pedestrians (via his PA system) that the turkey is bad; a guy in the balcony talks to Dave about turning flips onstage; Paul correctly guesses that Dorothy baked a rhubarb pie.

videos.title: Salma Hayek, Marilyn Manson, Caroline Rhea
videos.overview: Dave fusses over his hair, then messes around with it.  Later, Salma Hayek plugs ""Dogma.""

videos.title: Patrick Stewart, Jon Stewart, Faith Hill
videos.overview: It's ""Stewart Night,"" as all the guests share the same last name despite not being related.  French Stewart chats with Dave via telephone, Calvert does his famous Rod Stewart impression, Martha Stewart hangs out in the green room, and Patrick Stewart and Jon Stewart plug their most recent projects.  Oh yeah, and Faith Hill (not a Stewart) sings.

videos.title: Greg Kinnear, Jane Horrocks, Reggie McFadden
videos.overview: Live from Times Square, it's ""Dick Clark's Rockin' December 9 Countdown.""  At the stroke of midnight, Greg Kinnear commutes from the theater to give Dick a kiss.

videos.title: Tom Hanks, Brooklyn Philharmonic
videos.overview: Gerard plays an openly gay man in ""Who Asked For It?""; The Brooklyn Philharmonic plays the ""William Tell Overture.""

videos.title: Meg Ryan, Whitney Houston
videos.overview: Dave compares an electrician that played ""KYCE"" to John Elway.  Also, Meg Ryan plugs ""You've Got Mail.""

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Famke Janssen, Emmylou Harris
videos.overview: Tom Brokaw drops by sporting a turtleneck sweater in lieu of his usual two-piece suit, and pretty soon Biff is handing out turtlenecks to the audience.  By the end of the show, even Dave is wearing one.

videos.title: Robin Williams, Natalie Merchant
videos.overview: Dave explains the impeachment process; Robin Williams hosts the PBS special ""The Shaffer Campaign: A Look Back,"" which details Paul's futile attempt to run for congress.

videos.title: Val Kilmer, Ricky Williams, Billy Bragg & Natalie Merchant
videos.overview: In lieu of a giant meatball, a pastrami sandwich is placed on top of the Late Show Christmas Tree; Kreskin guesses if Tom Arnold (via telephone) will correctly spell ""Hanukkah.""

videos.title: Susan Sarandon, Marc Weinberg, Vienna Choir Boys
videos.overview: While Paul and the Orchestra perform ""Songs for Pedestrians,"" Dave trims his tie.  Also, a ""Welcome Communists"" banner hangs onstage.

videos.title: Jeff Goldblum, Angelina Jolie, Third Eye Blind
videos.overview: Live from sunny Los Angeles, it's ""Dick Clark's Rockin' Countdown to December 18,"" followed by ""Casey Kasem's Countdown to Dick Clark's Rockin' Countdown to December 18.""  When it strikes midnight, Casey is nearly drowned in a sea of confetti.

videos.title: Julia Roberts, David Kelly
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Alan gives the audience an unusual egg nog recipe, while Dave answers the question, ""Where did Hanukkah come from?"" by stating it that was named after a nice man named Steve Hanukkah.

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Josh Hartnett, Cyndi Lauper
videos.overview: The latest roll call mentions ""Gus, who guy who owns property onstage"" and ""Tony Randall as Ricky, the stagehand who looks like Regis Philbin.""

videos.title: Charles Grodin, John Witherspoon, Jessye Norman
videos.overview: Dave refunds $50 to an audience lady with a Late Show sweatshirt; a Joe G's customer appears in the hastily-produced film trailer for the faux movie ""Badge of Honor III""; ten department store Santas present the Top Ten; Jessye Norman featuring Harry Huff sing ""Go Tell It To The Mountain.""

videos.title: John Travolta, Darlene Love
videos.overview: Soon-to-be-traded Yankees pitcher David Wells sits in the audience; the first of tonight's two Top Ten Lists is interrupted by a claymation segment with Dave and Santa; Cissy Houston and Roberta Flack join Darlene Love and Bette Sussman for their annual presentation of ""Christmas (Baby, Please Come Home).""

videos.title: Chazz Palminteri, Ann Curry, Rufus Wainwright
videos.overview: Dave talks about the recent successes of the New York Jets, so Harold Larkin goes outside to alter the ""Jets Suck"" graffiti on the wall; Biff keeps changing sweatshirts; ten beautiful women present the Top Ten.

videos.title: James Woods, David Brenner, Cast of But Boy Could He Sing
videos.overview: Bisbee, North Dakota is investigated in the latest edition of ""Biff Henderson's America.""

videos.title: Jay Thomas, Vinny Testaverde, Patti Smith
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Chicago announcer ""Ray Clay"" fills in for Alan, making inane announcements and usurping the Top Ten from Dave.  Also, a Late Show tradition is born when Jay Thomas shows Jets QB Vinny Testaverde how to throw a football at the top of the Christmas tree.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Nathan Lane, St. Luke's Bottle Band
videos.overview: Kamarr the Discount Magician makes one last appearance.

videos.title: Jon Voight, Jena Malone, Louie C.K.
videos.overview: Jon Voight promotes two films, ""Enemy of the State"" and ""Varsity Blues.""

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker, David Remnick, Bryan Callan
videos.overview: Biff pretends to stand in Times Square again, this time reporting about the weather. Also, Sarah Jessica Parker promotes the second season of ""Sex & The City.""

videos.title: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Liam Aiken, Greg Behrendt
videos.overview: Biff just can't get enough of the green screen in the hallway; tonight's participant in ""Please Stop Calling Me Monty"" jams with the band; Dave chats with child actor Liam Aiken.

videos.title: Mira Sorvino, Terry Bradshaw
videos.overview: It's time for ""How Many Guys in Mouse Suits Can Fit into a Dunkin' Donuts?""  We never find out the exact number, though they do bring back doughnuts.

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow, Terry Bradshaw, Jason Kuller
videos.overview: Dave announces the new name of the show will be ""David Letterman's Countdown to the Millennium.""  Also, the show profiles audience member ""Spencer Alderson"" (Leonard) of Sweden.

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Marv Albert, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: ""David Letterman's Countdown to the Millennium,"" Day 2: Paul declares that he will mention a millennium-related fun fact every day for the rest of the year.  Also, Jon Stewart promotes the recently overhauled talk show ""The Daily Show.""

videos.title: Gillian Anderson, Charlie Rose, Black Crowes
videos.overview: Sitting in with the CBS Orchestra tonight: the shirtless guy who was the ""T"" in ""Jets"" at last night's game.  Also, The Black Crowes performs ""By Your Side.""

videos.title: Robert Duvall, Al Franken, B.B. King
videos.overview: During ""Small Town News,"" Dave sports a paper mustache.

videos.title: Conan O'Brian, Alanis Morrisette
videos.overview: Tonight's ""Paul Shaffer Millennium Prediction"": health spas will not charge deposits.  Upon hearing this, Dave wishes people would stop using the phrase ""happy camper.""  Also, Dave goes a somewhat lengthy discourse about the Late Night show before introducing Conan O'Brien, while the latest episode of ""Next Time Bring Your Sister, You Hump"" goes on location to The Candy Store.

videos.title: William Baldwin, Trisha Yearwood, Scott Ferrall
videos.overview: William Baldwin promotes ""Virus,"" while Biff rescues Dave's coffee mug after it falls over.

videos.title: Jack Hanna, Patricia Arquette
videos.overview: Mailbag: Tony mentions he's taken up acting, then shows two remarkably similar clips from Patch Adams and Shakespeare In Love.  Also, NBA head honcho David Stern presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Yasmine Bleeth, Adam Carolla, James Brown
Alicia Silverstone, D.L. Hughley, Second Hand
videos.overview: Dave says a focus group doesn't like his ""Countdown to the Millennium"" segment, so Paul gives one last fact: ""Danny Aiello will get another series.""  Rather than bow down in defeat, Dave introduces a segment called ""Shark Week,"" which actually started the previous night.  The premise is that Dave and Paul try to talk about sharks, but quickly come to realize that they know almost nothing about them, and change the topic.

videos.title: Sophia Loren, The Mavericks
videos.overview: Dave and Paul discuss William Wood Lee Shaffer's diapers.  Later, Paul interrupts the ""Shark Week"" segment with another Millennium prediction: ""The new blackâ€¦ will be black.""

videos.title: Bill Murray, Shania Twain
videos.overview: Biff shows up with a tie for a ""Know Your Current Events"" contestant; Bill Murray promotes Rushmore and serenades Dave.

videos.title: Cate Blanchett, Jason Schwartzman, Brandy
videos.overview: Dave announces he and Paul are trying to establish a video nexus; during Mailibag, Anton falls down an elevator shaft, while Paul and Dave shoot Regis with paintballs; ten firefighters present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Brendon Fraser, Ricky Scruggs & Vince Gill
videos.overview: It's the seventeenth anniversary of Dave's debut in late night, and what is he going to do to celebrate the milestone?  ""Absolutely nothing.""  Also, Tony Randall reports from yesterday's Super Bowl XXXIII, while Dave offers to sing the national anthem at next year's game.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, David Brenner, Catherine Bell
videos.overview: Dave mentions that through the wonders of science, Paul Shaffer had another baby over the weekend, and then introduces Bernard Shaffer in the green room; during ""Who Asked For It?"", an audience member demands to see something related to Groundhog Day, so ""a groundhog"" (Gerard) walks onstage and harasses Dave; Catherine Bell promotes J.A.G.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Sean Patrick Flanery, Creed
videos.overview: Dave and Paul spend ten minutes discussing the new and improved ""Late Show"" home site; Dave chats with ""John Elway"" (Gerard) after the star quarterback is last minute no-show; Creed performs a garbled rendition of their hit ""Take Me Higher.""

videos.title: Mel Gibson, Laetitia Casta, Fresh Step
videos.overview: Dave reads about Bucknell University for a ""KYCE"" participant; Laetitia Casta is interviewed twice.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Martha Stewart, Mitch Hedberg
videos.overview: Nile Rogers fills in for both Felicia and Will Lee, who are both sick; Martha Stewart has some fun with a batch of pinecones.

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Rev. John & Ellena Cobb, Willie Nelson
videos.overview: ""Biff Henderson's America"" makes a quick stop in Baker, Nevada.  Also, Dave chats with the Reverend and Mrs. John Cobb, who tell their incredible story of how they met after a mailed marriage proposal never came through.

videos.title: Jeff Daniels, Fernanda Montenegro, Monica
videos.overview: Dave chats with (live via satellite) Al at Prestige Luggage Company in Dallas.  Dave is so fascinated by him that the segment runs for almost fifteen minutes, and later Al presents #1 on the Top Ten list.

videos.title: Robin Wright Penn, Richard Kind, Chris Isaak
videos.overview: Dave rants about the internet, while Bob Borden literally searches for a valentine.

videos.title: Sandra Bullock, James Carville, Hootie & The Blowfish
videos.overview: Orlando Antigua of the Harlem Globetrotters helps out during ""Know Your Current Events,"" while Sandra Bullock promotes Forces of Nature.

videos.title: Richard Simmons, Sarah O'Hare, Ondar
videos.overview: Dave discusses signature sign-offs and announces his new one will be ""Keep a light coat of oil on it""; during Mailbag, Gerard discusses nudity in film and gets distracted by his speech very easily; Richard Simmons flies around a la Cupid before his interview, but storms off after Dave kisses Nadine and the Mailbag Girl.

videos.title: Bette Midler, David Hyde Pierce
videos.overview: Tonight marks the debut of ""Alan Kalter's Secret Word.""  Tonight's utterance: ""gristle.""  Also, racing star Jeff Gordon presents the Top Ten, while Dave gives the blue cards for the ""What They'll Be Doing Next"" segment to Corky Ramirez to send to the comedy museum.

videos.title: Andy Garcia, Tara Lipinksi, Wendy Liebman
videos.overview: Lou Soloff of Blood, Sweat and Tears sits in with the horn section; Alan's secret word is ""magnesium""; Dave chats with champion figure skater Tara Lipinski.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, Mike Judge, Julian Lennon
videos.overview: The secret word is ""mongoose""; ten West Point cadet presents the Top Ten; Julian Lennon performs The Beatles' ""Don't Let Me Down.""

videos.title: Magic Johnson, Jake Gyllenhaal, Jewel
videos.overview: The secret word is ""hydraulic""; Dave gives a photographer in the audience a Polaroid to shoot pictures during the show; Jake Gyllenhaal plugs October Sky.

videos.title: Lauren Bacall, Greg Smith, Sugar Ray
videos.overview: The secret word is ""buttress""; during Mailbag, Dave and Linda Tripp appear on $25,000 Pyramid; ten hot dog vendors present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: Dave takes five minutes to comment on the sudden death of Gene Siskel, then shows a clip from his last appearance on the show; Alan interrupts to show everybody his gritty new 10-10-346 ad; Dave claims that if you want to hear #1 of the ""Top Ten Mike Tyson Complaints About TV,"" you have to go to his web site.

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Jesse Ventura
videos.overview: Alan's secret word is ""bobcat,"" and the jackpot now stands at ""seven hundred damn dollars!""  Also, Kreskin participates in a new game called ""North Dakota/South Dakota,"" where he must correctly guess which state a mystery person is calling from.

videos.title: Uma Thurman, Tom Green, De La Guarda
videos.overview: The secret word is ""barnacle;"" Dave answers a phone call from Sweden; in a segment about the hype surrounding Star Wars Episode One, George Clarke impersonates Mark Hamill.

videos.title: Eriq La Salle, Homer Hickman, Blondie
videos.overview: The secret word is ""corpuscular."" Meanwhile, Dave chats with Homer Hickam, the NASA shuttle instructor whose life inspired the recent film October Sky.

videos.title: James Coburn, Will Ferrall, Marvelous Three
videos.overview: The secret word is ""combustible,"" and the stakes have been raised to an even thousand; during Mailbag, Harold Larkin starts bleeding from the neck, which happens to be a common side effect of using Head & Shoulders shampoo; Will Ferrell sings about things at random.

videos.title: Ian McKellen, Reese Witherspoon, The Roots & Erykah Badu
videos.overview: The secret word is ""saluki""; live via satellite, the employees of the Unclaimed Baggage Center in Scottsboro, Alabama opens up suitcases; The Roots (featuring Erykah Badu) performs ""You Got Me.""

videos.title: Kid Turkey Callers, Mark Wahlberg, Fresh Step
videos.overview: Dave rants about tonight's Barbara Walters/Monica Lewinsky interview; the secret word is ""luggage,"" with the grand prize reaching $1300; the latest roll call singles out Tom Cruise's manicurist, Tom Cruise's dressmaker, and ""Tom Cruise"" (Calvert) himself; Dave and Paul comment on the death of Dusty Springfield.

videos.title: Billy Crystal, George Miller
videos.overview: The secret word is ""viscous,"" while George Miller rants about the media.

videos.title: Chazz Palminteri, Jeff Altman, Everclear
videos.overview: The secret word is ""melancholia,"" while ""Oprah"" (Pat Farmer) flirts with ""John Travolta"" (Kenny Sheehan).

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Jeff Beck
videos.overview: The secret word is ""lederhosen""; the second-ever ""Alan Kalter's Where Are They Now?"" reveals that Alan Hale, Jr. has been dead for several years now; Don King helps Norm MacDonald promote his new show.

videos.title: Elizabeth Hurley, Katie Holmes, Cake
videos.overview: The secret word is ""Ionosphere,"" with the prize now standing at ""$1700 damn dollars!""  Meanwhile, Gaines awkwardly interrupts Dave's interview with Elizabeth Hurley to answer a question Dave asked Rob Burnett at the start of the show.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Craig Kilborn, Emmylou Harris, Linda Rondstadt, and Dolly Parton
videos.overview: The secret word is ""shipjack""; Dave shows a meat identification kit, complete with photographs of each form of meat; Craig Kilborn promotes his new talk show; Emmylou Harris and a rotund Linda Ronstadt perform Leonard Cohen's ""Sisters of Mercy.""

videos.title: Elton John, Henry Kissinger, LeAnn Rimes
videos.overview: The secret word is ""bilious,"" which is coincidental because Dave feels under the weather.  Also, Elton John and Leann Rimes perform ""Written in the Stars.""

videos.title: Ron Howard, Charlotte Church
videos.overview: Dave bids farewell to Tom Snyder (his last show aired that night), then says get well to Johnny Carson (who had major surgery).  Also, the secret word is ""elliptical.""

videos.title: Marv Albert, Diane Lane, Blur
videos.overview: Dave hollers about 60 Minutes, then claims that somebody won the Secret Word ""contest"" on Friday; tonight's Secret Word is ""meniscus,"" with the jackpot reduced to a hundred dollars; Blur (featuring the Boys Choir of Harlem) performs ""Coffee & TV.""

videos.title: Laurence Fishburne, Sister Carol Anne Corley, Wilco
videos.overview: The opening sequence is altered; the secret word is ""taconite""; Dave chats with Sister Carol Anne Corley, a nun who's also a master of fly-fishing.

videos.title: Steve Martin & Goldie Hawn, Jim Calhoun, Joe Henry
videos.overview: The secret word is ""sociopathic,"" while Steve Martin and Goldie Hawn promote the upcoming remake of The Out-of-Towners.

videos.title: Dennis Hopper, Jason Nastke, The Corrs
videos.overview: The secret word is ""nemonurwingy,"" but Dave accuses Alan of making it up (which he did), so he changes it to ""balloon.""  Also, after The Corrs perform, Dave decides that ""Corrs"" must be Irish for ""babes.""

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Master P, Greg Fitzsimmons
videos.overview: Charlie Daniels sits in on fiddle; the secret word is ""mahagony""; comedian/commentator Greg Fitzsimmons remarks on domestic life.

videos.title: Charles Grodin, David Arquette, Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett, and Kris Kristofferson
videos.overview: The secret word is ""flange""; Dave holds up a certificate that makes Late Show  the ""Official Late Night Talk Show of the Millennium""; Biff annoys Yankees players during his 2nd annual trip to their Spring Training camp in Florida; Lyle Lovett and Willie Nelson, with a little help from Kris Kristofferson, perform a memorable duet.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Scott Wolf, Barenaked Ladies
videos.overview: The secret word is ""millipede""; right after the second-ever edition of ""Know Your Cuts of Meat,"" Dave calls one of the previous owners of his Meat Identification Kit.

videos.title: Lennox Lewis, Dr. Bertrand Piccard & Brian Jones
videos.overview: Throughout the night, local teens with learner's permits parallel park on 53rd Street.  At the end of the show, Dave attempts parallel parking and nearly embarrasses himself.

videos.title: George Stephanopoulos, Molly Shannon, Andrea Bocelli
videos.overview: The secret word is ""ischemia,"" while SNL star Molly Shannon promotes Never Been Kissed.

videos.title: Bill Maher, Khalid El-Amin, Marc Maron
videos.overview: Paul makes his second ""Countdown to the Millennium"" prediction since the designation: ""Everybody's going to take out a lot of cash. Forget about the cash.""  Also, Dave calls Jay Leno ""a hump,"" then ponders what it would be like if Jesus was a guest on the show.

videos.title: Elle Macpherson, Don Zimmer, John Mellencamp
videos.overview: Paul announces celebrities will come by all evening to wish Dave a happy birthday, and for some strange reason Martha Stewart drops by three times; the secret word is ""diplopia""; to settle an argument, Dave shows the audience a map of the Panama Canal.

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers
videos.overview: The secret word is ""hegemony,"" and Dave doubles the current jackpot from $1100 to $2200; Kathie Lee Gifford sings Dave a late happy birthday song, and later he shows a clip of her left buttock mysteriously sagging as she walked offstage; Kevin Spacey enters the stage on an electric scooter.

videos.title: Kate Winslet, Darrell Hammond, Mandy Barnett
videos.overview: The secret word is ""quadricentennial,"" and after doubling the stakes on last night's show, Dave ""raises"" them to an even hundred million; on a variation of a recurring bit, Biff goes out in traffic, harassing people with a bullhorn; Dave increases the jackpot again to $150,000,000; Darrell Hammond does his trademark Clinton impression.

videos.title: David Spade, Tim Couch, Eagle-Eye Cherry
videos.overview: Dave mentions the sudden and untimely death of Bill Wendell; the secret word is ""Melon""; with no clip available, Biff and David Spade reenact a scene from his new movie Lost & Found; Tim Couch of the Kentucky Wildcats (and later the Cleveland Browns) and Dave throw a football into a exact same taxi window; Dave mistakenly refers to the show as ""Late Night.""

videos.title: John Cusack, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: A technical difficulty turns Dave's face and tie blue during the monologue; the secret word is ""tubular""; during Mailbag, Dave shows us the video guide ""Biff Henderson's How to Become a Chick Magnet.""

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Ben Stein, The Cranberries
videos.overview: Dave discusses the various bars and/or grills that have been next door to the theater, and wishes the best of luck to its current incarnation, The Manhattan Chili Company; the secret word is ""kitty""; Paul gets spun off into his own talk show, during which he has a (bogus) heart-to-heart with Monica Lewinsky; Dave has a sample of the chili.

videos.title: Martin Lawrence, Michelle Williams, Eddie Brill
videos.overview: Dave claims there was a secret word winner last night, then brings out Connecticut housewife ""Marlene DiBenedetto""; the secret word is ""hat,"" with the jackpot going back down to a hundred damn dollars; Dave makes another shout-out to the Manhattan Chili Company.

videos.title: Dustin Hoffman, Mary Steenburgen, Ben Folds Five
videos.overview: The secret word is ""boat""; Paul, Felecia, Will, and Sid perform ""Songs for Pedestrians""; Ted Danson lurks in the backdrop during Dave's chat with Mary Steenburgen.

videos.title: Ted Danson, Sarah Ferguson, Madness
videos.overview: The secret word is ""carrot,"" and Dave introduces another supposed winner (writer and Boston native Jay Johnson); to prove a point, Dave quizzes Paul on a cut of meat; during a new segment called ""Alan's Celebrity Birthday,"" a caption reading ""jackass"" with an arrow pointing at Alan appears on the screen, so Big Red storms off to the control room and punches Jerry.

videos.title: Glenn Close, George Hamilton, Elvis Crespo
videos.overview: In honor of tonight's audience, the backdrop is altered to show the skyline of Miami, Florida; Biff visits a retirement community in Coral Gables; ten Florida residents present the Top Ten, with Dave counting down in Spanish; Dave eats suntan lotion.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Robbie Williams
videos.overview: Dave claims he's filed a $100 million lawsuit against the surgeon general; Dave pays an attractive audience member $200 for saying tonight's secret word (""thimble""); Robbie Williams performs ""Millennium.""

videos.title: Earvin Magic Johnson, Sara Gentile, Silverchair
videos.overview: The secret word is ""incinerate""; Paul Fiore tries to parallel-park outside; Dave chats with a twelve-year-old girl who wants to save the dying art of ice cream trucks.

videos.title: Denny Brauer, Kelly Willis, Jesse Jackson
videos.overview: The secret word is ""undershirt""; Dave shows (bogus) footage of Roberto Benigni making an ass of himself at the Country Music Awards; World Bass fishing champ Denny Brauer is bumped up after Jesse Jackson's limo arrives late.

videos.title: Brendan Fraser, Jesse Jackson, Bonnie Raitt
videos.overview: Cold opening: Jesse Jackson makes an insincere apology to Dave for his tardiness in last night's show.  Also, ""Marlene DiBenedetto"" (Jude Brennan) wins the secret word again, and the Hi-Ho girls present the $200 check.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Steve Earle and the Del McCoury Band
videos.overview: In honor of tonight's travel-weary audience (everybody's from Nashville), Biff hangs out at the Grand Ole Opry while Nashville Predators captain Tom Fitzgerald presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Janeane Garofalo, Brian Regan
videos.overview: The secret word is ""ball""; an audience member is stifled by a barbershop quartet in the latest edition of ""Who Asked For It?""; a dog gets injured during ""Stupid Pet Tricks,"" prompting Dave to keep on eye on him in the green room.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Camryn Manheim, Eve 6
videos.overview: Thirteen-year-old blues phenomenon Ben Robinson sits in; the secret word is ""stick""; Bob Borden walks onstage to hype his new catchphrase: ""Next time bring your sister, you hump.""

videos.title: Kathie Lee Gifford, Deana Carter
videos.overview: Dave makes a nonsense rant about Barry Manilow; the secret word is ""winky""; during ""Dave's Record Collection,"" Tony goes berserk over a comment made by Dave, and he gets thrown out by Bill DeLace.

videos.title: Kevin Kline, Leelee Sobieski, Beth Orton
videos.overview: Dave bring out the seven supposed winners of last night's secret word contest (including Mike McIntee and the Stangel brothers); tonight's secret word is ""scooter""; an audience member from Florida plays Paul's piano is lieu of ""Know Your Current Events""; teen actress Leelee Sobieski promotes the CBS miniseries Joan of Arc.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Jon Favreau
videos.overview: With tonight's audience being from the City of Brotherly Love, Biff heads to Philly to get in training a la Rocky.  For his efforts, he is given a medal by Philadelphia Mayor Edward Rendell and Sylvester Stallone's brother Frank.

videos.title: Julia Roberts, Alice Cooper
videos.overview: The secret word is ""molar,"" while Dave measures Julia Roberts' waist.

videos.title: Keri Russell, Aretha Franklin
videos.overview: Dave calls Aloha Meats in Honolulu to see if they answer the phone by saying ""aloha""; the secret word is ""polymer""; Dave and Shecky hang out with a Star Wars fan; Aretha Franklin attempts to sing ""Nessun Dorma.""

videos.title: Tom Selleck, Bob Barker, Leon Russell
videos.overview: The secret word is ""turf""; various members of the staff appear in a series of film promos, including Biff in Eyes Wide Shut; a recently clean-shaven Tom Selleck is treated to a video tribute to his facial hair.

videos.title: Helen Hunt, Courtney Love, Hole
videos.overview: The secret word is ""Alan""; Dave shows a one dollar bill folded so it would be shaped like a ring, courtesy of a ""Know Your Current Events"" participant; Helen Hunt promotes the final episode of Mad About You.

videos.title: Natalie Portman, Tom Everett Scott, J. Geils Band
videos.overview: Tonight's audience hails from Boston, Massachusetts.  The backdrop, as always, is altered to resemble the Beantown skyline; Dave shows various great moments in Red Sox history, showing Carlton Fisk's 1975 World Series homer three times; Bill DeLace impersonates a hot dog vendor a remote Top Ten; Nomar Garciaparra walks across the stage to a Standing O; Natalie Portman promotes Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace.

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr., Damon Wayans
videos.overview: Dave goes on a fury as to what constitutes the dinners given as prizes during ""Know Your Current Events""; the secret word is ""announcer""; Dave Dorsett doodles on a camera; Tony ruins the ending of the new ""Star Wars"" prequel in Spanish.

videos.title: Kate Capshaw, Britney Spears
videos.overview: Dave tries calling Hawaii again; the secret word is ""asparagus""; Kate Capshaw tries to call her vacationing husband (Steven Spielberg) in Hawaii but she gets a busy signal; Britney Spears performs ""â€¦Baby One More Time.""

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Sarah Jessica Parker, Mary Chapin Carpenter
videos.overview: Anton is again introduced as Buddy Rich, Jr.; Paul pays $102,000,000 for a ticket to see the new ""Star Wars"" prequel; Dave shows Sarah Jessica Parker a recent clip of Matthew Broderick chatting on the show with his fly open.

videos.title: Bill Murray, Everlast
videos.overview: Jay Johnson wins the secret word ""contest"" again; throughout the night, Lou Rawls sits in the green room; tonight's secret word is ""litmus""; Everlast performs ""Ends.""

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Ira Glass
videos.overview: The secret word is ""bituminous""; Lou Rawls continues to lounge in the green room; during Mailbag, ""Billy Blanks"" (Gerard) gives a rather half-hearted demonstration of Tae-Bo.

videos.title: Dan Rather, Nancy Mace, Randy Newman
videos.overview: Tonight's secret word (""emetic"") is now sponsored by a lawn-watering device called ""Hosie Cow""; Biff stands outside holding a popsicle in one hand and a Creamsicle® in the other, determining which will melt first (the popsicle); Dave chats with Nancy Mace, the first female graduate of The Citadel.

videos.title: Jeff Foxworthy, Kristin Davis, Snoop Dogg
videos.overview: The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""escarpment""; Dave plays a new game at Joe G's where a contestant must start a conversation and brings up the weather within sixty seconds (he won); Snoop Dogg plugs his new album.

videos.title: Timothy Hutton, Christine Lahti, Cast of It Ain't Nothing But the Blues
videos.overview: The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""whippy""; last night's winner ""Barbara Sanchez"" (Jude Brennan) is presented with $400 and a fully functional Hosie Cow; Alan imagines what effect Y2K will have on the country.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Jewel
videos.overview: After appearing in an ad for Hosie Cow, Alan announces that the secret word is ""inflammation.""  Also, Tony nominee Brian Dennehy presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Heather Graham, David Wells
videos.overview: Edgar Winter sits in; the Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""dick""; Heather Graham promotes Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me.

videos.title: Tim Robbins, Oscar De La Hoya, Dane Cook
videos.overview: The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""amputation""; the latest roll call introduces Biff's pint-size clone ""Mini-Biff"" and Calvert dressed up as a Hosie Cow; Tim Robbins promotes Arlington Road.

videos.title: Roseanne, Susan Tedeschi
videos.overview: The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""dick"" again, but it's eventually changed to ""bunny.""  Also, Dave has another one of his long-winded chats (via satellite) with the Preston Luggage Company in Dallas, where he lets a customer set his own price (five dollars) for a snazzy carry-on bag.

videos.title: David Schwimmer, Brandi Chastain, Seth Green
videos.overview: The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""pigment,"" while Dave chats (and becomes infatuated) with Brandi Chastain of the US Women's World Cup Soccer Team.

videos.title: Mike Myers, Ben Lee
videos.overview: Al Gore appears on ""The Paul Shaffer Show""; The Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""tourniquet""; Mike Myers promotes Austin Powers 2.

videos.title: Julianna Margulies, Jon Stewart
videos.overview: Anton is introduced as Buddy Rich Jr., the ""bastard son"" of the legendary jazz drummer; Hosie Cow makes a cameo in the new Austin Powers movie; the Hosie Cow Secret Word is ""whipknockvonwhipknocky,"" but Dave forces Alan to change it to ""newt.""

videos.title: Felicity Huffman, Andy Dick, Elvis Costello
videos.overview: The secret word (""rodeo"") is now sponsored by Larry King, whom according to Alan ""looks like an owl""; ""Rita Buttgas"" (Jude Brennan) is introduced as the latest winner of the faux contest; Pat Farmer comments on the NBA Finals from backstage; Andy Dick starts cutting his hair in mid-interview, and afterwards a very annoyed Kenny Sheehan breaks out the dust-buster.

videos.title: Adam Sandler, Missy Elliot
videos.overview: The Larry King Secret Word is ""gabardine,"" and is followed by stock footage of four baby owls devouring a rat.  Also, Dave shows the audience an autographed photo of the US Women's World Cup Soccer Team in Late Show, and stops the show several times to ogle the ladies.

videos.title: Geri Halliwell, Richard Belzer
videos.overview: Jimmy Vaughan sits in; the Larry King Secret Word is ""entropic""; after an unusually aimless edition of ""New for Summer,"" Dave asks Paul, ""What is happening to this show?""

videos.title: Rudolph Giuliani, Leslie Mann, The Pretenders
videos.overview: The Larry King Secret Word is ""linguine.""  Also, to counteract with Hillary Clinton's recent decision to run for the US Senate in New York, Mayor Giuliani announces that he's running for the same office in Arkansas.

videos.title: Joey Lauren Adams, Spike Lee, Santana
videos.overview: The Larry King Secret Word is ""peptide""; Carlos Santana and Rob Thomas of Matchbox Twenty perform ""Smooth.""

videos.title: Colin Powell, Maurice Green
videos.overview: Tonight's Secret Word (""bird"") is brought to you by David Letterman's Women's World Cup Soccer Team, in honor of his latest celebrity crush.  Quote Alan: ""They're hotter than a dancing bobcat with its ass on fire!""  Also, during a slideshow bit called ""Celebrity Summer Plans,"" Vinnie Magliulo reports live via satellite from Caesar's Palace giving the odds on the audience response to the jokes.

videos.title: Mira Sorvino, Lyle Lovett
videos.overview: The World Cup Soccer Team Secret Word is ""oozing""; Montana park ranger (and past winner) ""Rita Buttgas"" (Jude Brennan) is announced as the winner of the Secret Word Tournament of Champions; Dave picks a fly out of his coffee.

videos.title: Piedmont Bird Callers, Avery Johnson, June Carter Cash
videos.overview: The Larry King/Women's Soccer Secret Word is ""peripatetic""; a bird caller from Piedmont, California does a drumroll for Dave; after a brief discussion over the difference between a mesa and a butte, Rob Burnett makes a quirky legal pad doodle that settles the issue once and for all.

videos.title: Calista Flockhart, Jack Hannah
videos.overview: The Larry King/Women's Soccer Secret Word is ""highoeyazmuhoodhee""; Calista Flockhart's chat with Dave is interrupted by visions of the dancing baby from Ally McBeal busting a move with George Clarke; Bill DeLace poses as a Little League umpire for a remote Top Ten list.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, John Leguizamo, Ziggy Marley & The Melody Makers
videos.overview: The Larry King/Women's Soccer Secret Word is ""pony""; during Mailbag, Biff, Kenny, and Dave Dorsett brag about their latest female conquests; John Leguizamo promotes Summer of Sam.

videos.title: John McEnroe, George Jones
videos.overview: Dave shows footage of a taxi literally crashing the staff cookout out on 53rd Street; with temperatures hovering over 100 degrees, Biff dares to go outside and fry an egg on the sidewalk; Dan Quayle joins Larry King and the Women's Soccer Team as a sponsor of Alan's Secret Word (""one hot mother****er""); Tony Randall drops by to eat the egg.

videos.title: Chris Rock, Sixpence None the Richer
videos.overview: An audience member attempts to button Dave's jacket; the Dan Quayle/Larry King/Women's Soccer Secret Word is ""neoprene""; throughout the night, Biff stands next to a 45-pound block of ice on the sidewalk, giving Dave updates on its melting status; Sixpence None the Richer performs ""Kiss Me.""

videos.title: Lindsay Davenport, Oliver Platt, Jeffrey Ross
videos.overview: Dave replies to a Zagat's survey; the Women's Soccer Secret Word is ""pestilence,"" with the Dan Quayle/Larry King Secret Word Jackpot standing at ""Thirteen hundred damn dollars!""; Oliver Platt promotes Lake Placid.

videos.title: Jay Thomas, Jason Briggs
videos.overview: The Secret Word is ""prick,"" with the stock footage of the baby owls eating the rat joining an already crowded group of sponsors; John Mayall sits in; Jason Biggs promotes American Pie.

videos.title: Naomi Campbell, Jimmie Walker, Lucinda Williams
videos.overview: Dave points out that Paul is dressed from head to toe in white tonight, including a snazzy top hat; during Mailbag, The Guy on Fire is profiled on ""Biff Henderson's Where Are They Now?""; Lucinda Williams performs ""Concrete on Barbed Wire.""

videos.title: Don Rickles, Dave Mirra, Patty Griffin
videos.overview: The Larry King/Dan Quayle Secret Word is ""sphygmomanometer""; Dave briefly comments on the passing of JFK Jr.; Dave Mirra does bicycle stunts on 53rd Street, but after he has to cut it short due to rain, he pops wheelies inside the theater.

videos.title: U.S. 1999 World Cup Women's Soccer Team, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: The Dan Quayle/Larry King Secret Word is ""pie""; Dave finally meets the entire U.S. Women's World Cup champion soccer team, though Mia Hamm and Brandi Chastain do most of the talking; ""Rita Buttgas"" is introduced as the first Secret Word three-time winner; Dave asks Paul if they can trade the horn section for the soccer team.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Dennis Regan
videos.overview: The Hillary Clinton/Larry King Secret Word is ""mommy""; Dave asks a question to Einstein's Brain (voice of Alan Kalter); perfect game winner David Cone presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Buzz Aldrin, Jamiroquai
videos.overview: The Hillary Clinton/Larry King Secret Word is ""meehnkee""; Dave ""performs"" at Woodstock '99, then declares that Limp Bizkit kicks ass; Buzz Aldrin drops by to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the moon landing.

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Alanis Morrisette
videos.overview: Paul asks what the point of the Secret Word is, and after it's revealed (""throb""), Dave replies with ""I'm tired of being held hostage by your psychotic delusions.""  Also, Mujibur and Sirajul preview the new Alan Kalter dart board, and Alan punches them.

videos.title: Ted Koppel, Isabella Rossellini, Macy Gray
videos.overview: Paul complains about the heat at Woodstock '99; Dave brags about Max Pappas and Team Rahal (a sign of things to come); Ted Koppel's evil twin Kenny is caught hosting Nightline in lieu of his more well-known brother.

videos.title: National Hollerin' Champions, Garry Marshall, Los Lobos
videos.overview: Buckwheat Zydeco (nee Stanley Durrell) sits in on accordion; throughout the night, Shark the border collie chases Frisbees on 53rd Street; film director Garry Marshall plugs Runaway Bride.

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Rita Wilson, Pete Townshend & Eddie Vedder
videos.overview: Biff helps out pedestrians walking on 53rd Street; Dave asks Paul about project identification; Pete Townshend and Eddie Vedder perform ""Behind Blue Eyes.""

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Heidi Klum
videos.overview: ""Paul Shaffer's Countdown to the Millennium"" makes its triumphant return to the Late Show, and is now sponsered by Hillary Clinton and Larry King.  Tonight's forecast: ""In the new millennium, people will freak out.""

videos.title: Lance Armstrong, Barry White
videos.overview: Dave chats with Tour de France winner and cancer survivor Lance Armstrong; Paul's latest prediction: ""No more lox and bagels"";  Sheryl Crow performs ""The Difficult Kind.""

videos.title: Pierce Brosnan, Saffron Burrows, Jim Jeter
videos.overview: It's a very special night as Jim Jeter is about to log his one millionth mile on his 1982 Toyota Starlet.  After reaching the milestone, Dave buys him a new used car.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Q-Tip & Busta Rhymes
videos.overview: Dave takes the outside cam to Joe G's for another round of ""Stop Calling Me Kitty.""

videos.title: Dave Foley, Jonathan Witherspoon, Old 97's
videos.overview: Dave shows the audience some stuff he bought on his recent vacation in a segment called ""Travel Souvenirs.""  Later, ""Newsradio"" star Dave Foley promotes the movie ""Dick.""

videos.title: William H. Macy, George Miller, The Pretenders
videos.overview: Dave repeatedly shows footage of the Taco Bell chihuahua saying ""funkalicious.""  Later, Dave and William H. Macy drink Tang spiked with Jack Daniels.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Jeff Altman
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Alan punches Dave.  Later, Dave's former ""Starland Vocal Band Hour"" co-star Jeff Altman looks back at his tumultous television career.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Dave Attell
videos.overview: Paul refers to Regis as a bastard, only for the ""Millionaire"" host to retaliate.

videos.title: Claire Danes, Smash Mouth
videos.overview: Kreskin's knowledge of 70's backup singers is tested in a segment called ""Commodore or Pip?""  Later, Smash Mouth performs their smash hit ""All-Star.""

videos.title: Hugh Grant, The Mavericks
videos.overview: Dave announces that a crack in the building next door caused a temporary evacuation of the theater.  Later, The Mavericks perform ""There Goes My Heart.""

videos.title: Rene Russo, Tori Amos
videos.overview: Dave takes up an offering for a preacher who played ""Who Your Deer Repellants.""

videos.title: Shaquille O'Neal, Helen Mirren
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Inky Mendez announces his candidacy for the US Senate, while Dave chats with ""Hillary Clinton"" (Gerard).

videos.title: Tony Danza, Katie Holmes, Robert Palmer
videos.overview: A shirtless Vince DeMentri interviews people on the street, asking them what they think of Hillary Clinton.  Later, Katie Holmes promotes ""Dawson's Creek.""

videos.title: Lara Flynn Boyle, David Brenner, Everclear
videos.overview: Dave announces that tonight, ""We're going to have good old-fashioned fun"": all night, Richard Egan stands on 53rd St. guessing the weight of passersby.

videos.title: Andie MacDowell, French Stewart, Tom Dreesen
videos.overview: Terence Blanchard sits in with the band, while Olympic diver Kathy Pesek does a demonstration for the audience (via telephone).

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Dwight Yoakam
videos.overview: Dave announces that tonight is the premiere of ""Late Show Who Wants to be a Billionaire?""  Tonight's first question: ""Who took over for the 'Brady Bunch' father after the original actor was arrested and imprisoned for the grisly kidnap and murder of the show's wardrobe designer?""  The answer: Dennis Weaver.

videos.title: Albert Brooks, Omar Epps
videos.overview: Dave announces that after 6 years and 1,278 shows on CBS, he now wants to be called ""Daddy""; Alan beats up Regis during CBS Mailbag; Albert Brooks makes a phone call to his pet parrot.

videos.title: Kevin James, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: Dave rants about the CBS/Viacom merger; Kevin James promotes a new comedy special.

videos.title: Ricki Lake, Kid Rock
videos.overview: Dave tries to call Sumner Redstone's office, then persuades Ricki Lake to make a crank call to Oprah.

videos.title: Craig Kilborn, Louise Smith, The Umbilical Brothers
videos.overview: Craig Kilborn promotes some talk show that comes on after Dave's.

videos.title: Queen Latifah, John Popper
videos.overview: John Popper sits in with the band, while Alan punches Sumner Redstone during CBS Mailbag.

videos.title: John McEnroe, Sharon Lawrence, Nanci Griffith
videos.overview: George Clarke dances in a diaper; Dave shows a ""highlight"" from last night's Emmy win: a clip of Rob Burnett kissing his wife at the ceremony (he forgot last year).

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Edie Falco, Dixie Chicks
videos.overview: Andrea Sande and Nadine Hennelly help Joe G's with a Y2K Inspection.  They pass, of course.

videos.title: John Leguizamo, Meat Loaf
videos.overview: Throughout the night, staffer Brian Donahue falls down staircases.  Later, Meatloaf promotes ""Crazy in Alabama.""

videos.title: Jenna Elfman, Chris Kattan, Christine Aguilera
videos.overview: With the possibility of a rare hurricane hitting New York City, Paul checks for ""talk show closings"" and Dave comes on stage in a poncho and galoshes.  Meanwhile, Jenna Elfman hijacks Anton's drumset, and Christina Aguilera performs ""What a Girl Wants.""

videos.title: Heather Locklear, Keyshawn Johnson
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Alan threatens to beat up Secretary of the Treasury Lawrence Summers, but he goes to his anger management counselor instead.

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Heather French
videos.overview: Joe Haden fills in for Alan; Warren Zevon fills in for Paul; Rupert walks over to the CBS Store and reviews the new fall shows on CBS.

videos.title: Robin Williams, Norm MacDonald
videos.overview: Paul and a local high schooler try their best to learn how to parallel park, while Robin Williams promotes ""Bicentennial Man.""

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Ashley Judd, Randy Travis
videos.overview: Alan, Regis, Bill Delace, and Mike McIntee portray members of the audience during ""Who Asked For It?""; Ashley Judd promotes ""Double Jeopardy.""

videos.title: Mark Wahlberg, Adam Sandler, Roger Ebert
videos.overview: Dave announces that next year, the show will be rechristened ""Late Show 2000,"" while Roger Ebert promotes his revamped talk show.

videos.title: Kelly Preston, Stirling Moss, Sugar Ray
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Harold Larkin comments on body piercing, while Dave ""appears"" in a Gap commercial.

videos.title: Kevin Pollak, Tom Waits
videos.overview: Biff gives a blanket to a cold audience girl; Chewy the Dog looks for truffles; Tom Waits sings with a bullhorn.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Emmylou Harris & Linda Rondstadt
videos.overview: Nadine, Andrea, Sirajul (but not Mujibur) and Joe G. play ""Who Wants to Win a Giant Phony Check for $1,000,000?""  Later, Alan promotes a film he just produced called ""For the Ladies"" (which turns out to be weightlifting porn flick).

videos.title: Mia Farrow, Russell Crowe, Paula Cole Band
videos.overview: Dave tells another dentist-related horror story; in ""New for Fall,"" Mujibur and Sirajul star in the Bollywood musical ""Basanta Gan Gaibay""; Evander Holyfield presents the Top Ten, but Lennox Lewis interupts to introduce #1.

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Eurythmics
videos.overview: Kevin Spacey promotes ""American Beauty,"" then gives Dave a bag of Presidential M&M's.  Later, Harold Larkin tells one of the ""True Stories of the Late Show Stagehands"": He walks into a mysterious closet backstage, falls into a black hole, then walks out in a nonchalant fashion.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Rebecca Gayheart
videos.overview: Alan's angry because he's not allowed to punch anybody; Dave goes berzerk adjusting his tie; Alan beats up writer Joe Toplyn under Mujibur and Sirajul's supervision.

videos.title: Harrison Ford, David Bowie
videos.overview: ""Biff Henderson's America"" spends four days in Turkey, Texas; David Bowie performs ""Thursday's Child.""

videos.title: Dan Quayle, Melissa Ethridge
videos.overview: Mujibur and Sirajul sample food at Hello Deli; an ad for ""Late Show on Tour,"" with Jackie Mason playing Dave; In honor of tonight's guest, Dave announces that he will no longer make any more jokes relating to Dan Quayle.

videos.title: Lili Tomlin, Leah Remini, Beth Hart
videos.overview: Tonight's edition of ""True Stories of the Late Show Stagehands"" finds Pat and Kenny in a plane crash over the Andes, where they're reduced to cannibalism.

videos.title: Jesse Ventura, Amy Brennamen, ZZ Top
videos.overview: A 100-year-old man presents the Top Ten; Biff waits on the fire escape by 53rd street and yells to President Clinton's motorcade that he has snacks.

videos.title: Jack Hanna, Peter Fonda, Sting
videos.overview: 1999: During CBS Mailbag, Pat Farmer presents ""Great Pats throughout History.""  Later, Sting performs ""Brand New Day.""

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Will Ferrell
videos.overview: Carole King sits in with Paul, then sings a duet with Bruce Willis.

videos.title: Chazz Palminteri, Billy Blanks, Wilson Pickett
videos.overview: Joe G. joins Mujibur and Sirajul to play ""Where Can I Get a Decent Meal in This Town?""  Later, Billy Blanks does a Tae-bo demonstration.

videos.title: Farrah Fawcett
videos.overview: The outside cam presents Paul Fiore's driver's test in New Jersey, with commentary by Biff and pictures from the WCBS-TV helicopter.  When he finishes the test, a babe presents him flowers and Gov. Christine Todd Whitman presents Paul's license.

videos.title: John Malkovich, Harland Williams
videos.overview: Warren Zevon fills in for Paul yet again; Dave wants to say the s-word ""because they did on â€˜Chicago Hope,'"" tries it, and gets beeped; Biff gives Yankees tickets to an audience member.

videos.title: Austin Payne, Patricia Arquette, Moby
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Alan Kalter promotes his Millenium Party, which looks like a disaster in the making.  Later, Dave presents ""Top Ten Things That Sound Creepy When Said by John Malkovich.""

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Jimmie Walker, Buena Vista Social Club
videos.overview: Paul and Dave talk about the band's weekend gig at the White House; for his latest World Series report, Biff interviews, amongst others, Evander Holyfield and John Rocker; the octogenarian stars of the hit documentary ""The Buena Vista Social Club"" perform.

videos.title: John Cusack, Bob Sarlatte, LeAnn Rimes
videos.overview: Dave shows a clip from the recently cancelled CBS sitcom Work With Me.  Later, David Diaz of WCBS-TV beats up a punk during an on-the-street report.

videos.title: Martha Stewart, Martin Scorcese, Ricky Martin
videos.overview: Martha Stewart makes Halloween treats; Jets QB Vinny Testaverde helps with the annual ""Halloween Costumes"" segment.

videos.title: Joe Torre, Denzel Washington
videos.overview: Security boss Bill DeLace disrupts last night's Gore-Bradley debate; your 1999 World Champion New York Yankees present the Top Ten; Denzel Washington plugs ""The Bone Collector.""

videos.title: Meryl Streep, Natalie Merchant
videos.overview: Dave shows a dumb picture of him outside, then gets marksman Armando Aiello to shoot paint balls at it; Dave disses Harmony Korine, who made some choice comments after getting bumped the other night; Mike McIntee and Bill DeLace guard the world's largest pumpkin (1131 pounds).

videos.title: Luke Perry, Jimmy Kimmel, Garbage
videos.overview: Dave tells a lengthy Halloween candy story, then incorporates his voice into the talking dog from those ""Taco Bell"" commercials.

videos.title: Lauren Holly, Jimmy Fallon, Rage Against the Machine
videos.overview: Dave says hello to all the folks in King's Height Rest Home in New York; Rage Against the Machine performs ""War Within a Breath"" on the roof in pouring rain.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Milla Jovovich
videos.overview: 14-year-old music prodigy Shannon Kerman sits in; Paul's most vivid memory of this year's World Series is reinterpreted by Martin Scorsese and Ricky Martin; after Mujibur and Sirajul play ""Where Can I Get a Decent Meal in This Town?"" at the trendy Ranch 1 restuarant, Biff brings in fried chicken, an item that they claimed they didn't have.
