videos.overview: Dave mentions the Kentucky Derby, then whines about not getting to hear Dave Johnson saying "â€¦and down the stretch they come!" Luckily, the other Dave does it for Daddy by phone.  Later, Dave (the host) chats with Survivor: Outback champion Tina Wesson.

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Juliette Lewis
videos.overview: In her first appearance on the show, intuitive Deborah Lynn attempts to get George Clooney's phone number.  She gives Dave a random number, but it's invalid.  After the first commercial break, Dave asks her to find Pamela Anderson's number, but he ends up chatting with the owner of a trucking company in Idaho.

videos.title: Jenna Elfman, Destiny's Child
videos.overview: Dave rants about last night's Country Music Awards, claiming it's not "real country" anymore; Harold Larkin addresses an important labor issue until the whistle blows and he has to go back to work; Jenna Elfman tells a funny (albeit lengthy) story about donating bone marrow.

videos.title: Heath Ledger, Lewis Black
videos.overview: Mailbag: "I'm going to see a movie this weekend. Which one should I see?" Dave introduces a segment called "Kenny Sheehan's Movie Review," during which the stagehand watches a movie, and then hates it so much he destroys the projector.  Also, Dave wishes his mom (live via satellite) a Happy Mother's Day, so a stand-in for Dave gives Dorothy a hug, and later they chug a few Heinekens.

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Missy Elliot
videos.overview: Dave calls Art Kelly (the theater receptionist) about a possibly offensive joke from last Fridays' monologue involving Miss Columbia and having smuggling heroin as her talent.  Dave apologizes (sort of) to a Columbian consulate, then goes on with the rest of show.  Also, "Biff Henderson's America" takes a look at the hamlet of Whiting, Maine.

videos.title: John Travolta, R.E.M.
videos.overview: Returning to last night's controversy, Dave announces Miss Columbia 2001 will be a guest on Thursday's show, then profusely apologizes for the heroin-smuggling remark; Dave shows an ad for CNN's season-ending cliffhanger; R.E.M. performs "All the Way to Reno (You're Going To Be a Star").

videos.title: Mike Myers, David Byrne
videos.overview: Dave tells a string of "It's so dryâ€¦" jokes during the monologue; David Byrne performs "Like Humans Do."

videos.title: Andrea Noceti, Jack Hannah, Ricky Martin
videos.overview: A technical issue near Paul's keyboards is repaired in the middle of the first act; Dave mentions that a cover of The Weathergirls' "It's Raining Men" (written by Paul in 1983) is the #1 hit in the UK for the second week in a row; Dave apologizes in person to Miss Columbia Andrea Noceli, then almost forgets to give her flowers.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammar, Smothers Brothers
videos.overview: Mailbag: harp player Gloria Agostini plays live accompaniment for the chin-rubbing flashbacks, Anton feeds his goldfish chips and salsa, and Tony ruins the season finale of The Sopranos by dropping the bombshell en espanol.

videos.title: Ray Romano, Dennis Tito
videos.overview: Buddy Guy sits in on guitar; Dave congratulates Regis on his much-deserved Daytime Emmy win; Steph/Monty tells an amusing story about her incontinent Doberman; Alan Kalter has a special message for the five wives of a recently convicted polygamist in Colorado City, Utah.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Ellen DeGeneres
videos.overview: Dave shows the audience his favorite (bogus) moment from last night's show: astronaut/billionaire Dennis Tito vaporizing Dave's head with his laser eyes.  Also, Ellen Degeneres promotes an upcoming cable special, while a Stupid Human Trick is performed twice.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Yogi Berra
videos.overview: Ray Benson sits in; "NYPD Chief of Police" William DeLace gives tips to college grads; baseball great Lawrence "Yogi" Berra promotes his autobiography.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Badly Drawn Boy
videos.overview: Dave celebrates Bob Dylan's 60th birthday with concert footage of a very old man struggling to play the guitar; Tony Orlando interrupts Dave to sing an original number about Memorial Day; Badly Drawn Boy (aka Damon Gough) performs "Once Around the Block."

videos.title: Danny DeVito, Larry Miller
videos.overview: Mailbag: "Have you ever seen the Monkey Man?"  Dave introduces the Monkey Man, who as any keen-eyed viewer can attest, is actually Gerard Mulligan in disguise.  Monkey Man shows us a clip what is supposed to be his footage of him wrecking havoc, but instead it's him superimposed on Shecky's "monkey washing the cat" stock footage.  Afterward, Dave observes, "That's it. That's the lowest we've sunk... ever."

videos.title: Helio Castroneves, Tom Dreesen, Lucinda Williams
videos.overview: Dave presents the new studio floor, which is now dark blue after several years of being crimson red; Dave admits he's having problems with his computer; Biff mentions that he's lost twenty pounds in the last month, then introduces yet another "Fun with a Bullhorn" segment.

videos.title: David Duchovny, Trisha Yearwood
videos.overview: Paul accidentally interrupts the monologue by getting attacked by a bee during the monologue, and Dave gives him grief for the remainder of the show.

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon, The Black Crowes
videos.overview: It's time for a segment called "For the Kids." George Clarke hogs the attention of an ice cream vendor, a Toys r Us employee takes a bow, Tony attempts to teach basic phrases in Spanish before going on another one of his rants, and Alan gives birth.

videos.title: Dan Rather, Elvis Costello & Anne Sofie von Otter
videos.overview: Dave drones on and on about a buzzkill staffer who declined Dave's offer of a free apple; in honor of this unknown staffer, Paul reprises his hit song "Lumpy Colon"; Dave repeats Rupert's very first "bothering people" bit from 1994.

videos.title: Andy Dick, Brian Regan
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave is repelled by President Bush's daughter "Debbie" (Gerard); ten CBS affiliate weathermen present the Top Ten; Andy Dick promotes Go Fish.

videos.title: Marv Albert, Sugar Ray
videos.overview: Dave criticizes the Los Angeles Lakers' "pixie" jerseys; Dave shows news footage of a bear in somebody's swimming pool, and then claims it's his backyard; Paul introduces some dweeb bouncing on a giant red beach ball.

videos.title: Luke Perry, Jim White
videos.overview: Paul wins the latest round of "Late Show Pay Phone Trifecta"; Dave chats with Steph/Monty via telephone to discuss a blind date that never happened; the "Top Ten Other Television Shows Produced by Saddam Hussein" is sponsored by Altoids.

videos.title: Kim Cattrell, Mary Chapin Carpenter
videos.overview: Dave helps Paul with some computer problems; in honor of the coming demise of Bozo the Clown, Dave shows (bogus) footage of the kiddie show star; Tony Mendez tries to help NYC's reputation by going out and giving a tourist some help, only to end up shoplifting a VCR at a electronics store.

videos.title: Star Jones, blink-182
videos.overview: Dave continues to discuss the retirement of Bozo the Clown, but his remarks about big, red, ugly hair results in an inevitable hissy fit from Alan.  Also, Dave honors the passing of Leonard Tepper with old clips of "Leonard Tepper's Hidden Video" and Dave directing him and Rupert on how to annoy people.

videos.title: Jon Stewart, David Brenner
videos.overview: Mailbag: "Can I host the show for a few minutes?" Sure enough, viewer Jason Lynch is hosting the show, while Dave sits in the green room watching Leno.  Also, Paul admits that he just can't get the hang of one of Dave's favorite phrases: "â€¦and down the stretch they come!"

videos.title: Dikenbe Mutombo, David Bowley, Cesaria Evora
videos.overview: After Paul admits that he doesn't recall what he looks like, Dave calls receptionist Art Kelly to ask if he's ever been formally introduced to the bandleader.  Art doesn't give Dave a straight answer.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, David Sedaris
videos.overview: Team Rahal racer Kenny Brack inexpicably sits in on guitar, while David Sedaris reads a selection from his new book.

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, PJ Harvey
videos.overview: A remarkably slim and trim Biff introduces footage of him hanging out at the Grand Prix in Detroit.  Also, Dave and Paul (of all people) talk about hair care, which proceeds into a new segment called "Hairpiece- Not a Hairpiece."

videos.title: Ewan McGregor, Moby
videos.overview: Paul sits in the guest chair for five minutes so he can promote Cover Wars, a new game show he's hosting on VH1.  Also, Alan announces that Epil stop n' spray is the new official sponsor of the Top Ten list, then shows video footage of it's hair "restoration" abilities.

videos.title: Chris Elliot, Harry Hill
videos.overview: Mailbag: "What would you do if the world was coming to an end?"  Dave admits he doesn't know much about this topic, so he introduces astrophysicist "Dr. Saul PerlmÃ¼tter" (Gerard), who announces that the world will end somewhat earlier than was previously thought; around Labor Day 2001, an eerie prediction.

videos.title: John McCain, Shawn Wayans
videos.overview: Dave has another rant about his computer problems, claiming that Late Show techno-guru Walter Kim keeps coming to his house on weekends to try to help, but he steers clear of insulting IBM because of an advertising agreement with CBS.  Also, Dave brags out Max Papis' (of Team Rahal) victory in last weekend's Portland 200.

videos.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Depeche Mode
videos.overview: Dave continues to steam over his technological issues; Catherine Zeta-Jones calls Dave "Jay" and profusely apologizes; Depeche Mode performs "I Feel Loved."

videos.title: Marlon Wayans, Alan Webb, Coldplay
videos.overview: Dave's computer problems only get worse, as he couldn't name a certain part he needed, causing IBM to send him the wrong part.  Also, Dave chats with prep athlete Alan Webb, the new national high school mile record holder.

videos.title: Sean Hayes, Brian Wilson, Darrius Rucker, Matthew Sweet
videos.overview: Dave goes on a spiel about the traffic on the interstate this morning; an "Incredible Dog Challenge" is held outside, with the winning dog jumping over a giant phony check for a million dollars; Brian Wilson, Darius Rucker, and Matthew Sweet perform The Beach Boys' "Sail On Sailor."

videos.title: Tony Danza, Nick DiPaolo
videos.overview: Mailbag: all of tonight's letters are read by James Earl Jones, George Clarke's flashback to a night of sex and gambling is sponsored by Donald Trump's Taj Mahal hotel, and an alleged Late Show writer is attacked by a bear.

videos.title: Reese Witherspoon, Jonatha Brooke
videos.overview: Dave announces that he may have parasites crawling around head, prompting Paul to call him a "maggot brain"; Dave and Steph/Monty go over vacation pictures; Dave confirms that he has parasites by taking a sentence on a blue card too literally; a guy bouncing a giant tether ball to his head makes an appearance on "Is This Anything?"

videos.title: Julia Roberts, Travis
videos.overview: Dave announces that Jude Brennan's cousin (a parasite expert) has told him that there's nothing to worry about.  Also, on a remarkably star-studded night, Puff Daddy appears for a special Top Ten list, while Dave sees through Julia Robert's blouse and asks her if she's getting laid.

videos.title: Edward Norton, Dido
videos.overview: Dave grumbles about the lack of quality guests appearing on the show, during which Paul comments on his inappropriate question towards Julia Roberts ("Are you getting laid these days?") last night.  Dave replies with "exclusive" footage of Paul asking Barbara Bush the same question.  Also, Pat, Kenny, and Harold Larkin star in the new HBO series "Sexy Guys, Sexy City," while a renegade blue card knocks out Tommy Lasorda.

videos.title: Juliana Marguiles, George Miller
videos.overview: Dave theorizes on the show's four Emmy nominations (announced earlier that day)- either no one's watching or the voters don't care anymore; for the second night in a row, Alan is beaten up by a guy twice his size; a comedy bit from Show #499 about Steve Martin's preparations for appearing as a guest is repeated.

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Elayne Boosler
videos.overview: Dave introduces "live satellite feed" of President Bush staring of into space; during Mailbag, Alan throws one of tonight's letter writers (played by Jay Johnson) out of a fourth-story window; ten chefs present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Piedmont Bird Callers, Hank Azaria, Maria McKee
videos.overview: Rather than come out of nowhere, Dave orders the muscle guy to pummel Alan; during a segment called "Summertime Leftovers," Dave once again shows footage of his "look-alike" (himself, circa his morning show) playing "Camptown Races" on the fiddle; Simpsons star Hank Azaria plugs America's Sweethearts.

videos.title: Kelly Ripa, Bob Sarlotte
videos.overview: Alan is caught nibbling on a pizza, but surprisingly doesn't get beaten up; Dave makes a snarky comment about Jay Leno's chin; former David Letterman Show announcer Bob Sarlette talks football with Dave over the closing credits.

videos.title: John McEnroe, Youssou N'Dour
videos.overview: Alan orders a pizza, and the delivery guy beats him up; live via satellite from the Indianapolis suburbs, Dorothy celebrates her 80th birthday with a Dave impersonator and a fridge full of Colt 45®; John McEnroe is interviewed twice after Dave gets curious as to which fellow tennis players he's dated.

videos.title: Jon Favreau, The Holmes Brothers
videos.overview: Another pizza for Alan results in another beating for Alan; Dave shows a photo of the FBI Building with the "I" missing; Joan Osbourne and The Holmes Brothers perform "Can't No Grave Hold My Body Down."

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Al Lubel
videos.overview: Dave brags about his mom's 80th birthday "whoop-tee-doo and grabass" this weekend; during Mailbag, Dave rescues Paul from The Man on Fire; Billy Crystal clobbers the guy who regularly beats up Alan.

videos.title: Jeff Meyer, Christopher Walken, Widespread Panic
videos.overview: A celebration for Calvert's 80th birthday turns into an excuse for Dave to ignore him and flirt with the Hi-Ho girls; Dave chats with Jeff Meyer, who named a poplar tree after Daddy; Christopher Walken talks about his recent appearance in the Fatboy Slim video "Weapon of Choice."

videos.title: Tom Selleck, David Rakoff
videos.overview: Delbert McClinton sits in; Steph/Monty (live via telephone from the 12th floor) discusses in length her plans from last weekend; Tom Selleck introduces an old movie clip of him, and then plays the ukulele.

videos.title: Mark Wahlberg, Michael Lomonaco, Tegan & Sara
videos.overview: Dave proudly announces that he's wearing orange socks tonight, but only so he can shove Steph's face into a birthday cake after the show; Alan gets beat up yet again, and remains bruised and bloodied for the rest of the show; Mark Wahlberg promotes the remake of Planet of the Apes.

videos.title: Greg Kinnear, Afro Celt Sound System & Peter Gabriel
videos.overview: The tambourine player sitting in with the band beats up Alan; Dave shows another old comedy clip to kill time (Show #818, Dave's harassment of delivery people); Greg Kinnear tells Dave what it's like to pilot a single-engine airplane.

videos.title: Marilu Henner, Hugh Fink
videos.overview: Mailbag: "How long has Paul been bald?"  Dave fears that this might be a sensitive question, but Paul rubs his chin anyway.  A flashback reveals that Paul used to have a long, wavy mane before an accident with Dave's chemistry set turned him into a bald, hideous freak.  Vowing revenge, Paul turns into a superhero and eggs Dave's car.

videos.title: Kristin Davis, Nanci Griffith, Mark Borschardt
videos.overview: Some guy dressed up as "Lance Armstrong" comes onstage on a bicycle and beats up Alan, then runs over to Hello Deli to pummel Rupert.  Later, Dave shows photos of him stuffing Steph/Monty's face into a birthday cake, while filmmakers Mark Borchardt and Mike Shank go to Comic-Con.

videos.title: Sean Combs
videos.overview: Dave makes Rupert play a deli-themed version of "Beat the Clock."  Later, after his conversation with Sean Combs goes longer than expected, Dave is forced to chat with newsanchor Daljit Dhaliwal for only a few seconds.

videos.title: Lance Armstrong, Thora Birch, Jamie O'Neal
Will Ferrell, Tom Dreesen
videos.overview: Dave announces that instead of "whatever," from now on he will be saying "wherever"; during a segment called "While We Were Out," the male staff members commemorate a minor design change on the stage by sitting in Dave's chair buck naked; Will Ferrell makes a threating message in song to Barbra Streisand.

videos.title: National Hollerin' Champions, Julia Stiles, Habib Koite & Bamada
Brooke Shields, John McEnroe, Joe Henry
Connie Chung
videos.overview: Dave points out that Tony Mendez is mentioned in this week's "Talk of the Town" column in The New Yorker.  Later, Jude Brennan makes her last appearance as the bitchy "Mrs. Letterman."

videos.title: Jason Biggs, Daniel Tosh, Etta James
Sarah Jessica Parker, John Witherspoon
videos.overview: Mayor Guiliani interrupts Dave's monologue; Sarah Jessica Parker promotes "Sex & the City."

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Brandi Chastain, Ralph Stanley & The Whites
Tim Robbins, Amy Sedaris, Jimmy Eat World
Dan Rather, Regis Philbin
videos.overview: In the first show following the terrorist destruction of the World Trade Center, Dave welcomes CBS anchorman Dan Rather and Regis Philbin.

videos.title: Bryant Gumbel, Denis Leary, Tori Amos
Matthew Broderick, John Miller, Odetta & The Boys Choir of Harlem
Merideth Viera, Stephen Ambrose, Sheryl Crow, Emmylou Harris, and Gillian Welch
Rudolph Giuliani, Katie Harmon
videos.overview: Dave welcomes national hero Rudy Guiliani to the show for the first time since the WTC disaster.

videos.title: Marcia Gay Harden, Doris Kearns Goodwin, Pete Yorn
Thomas Von Essen, Ben Stiller, Tenacious D
Jason Alexander, Don Zimmer, Wyclef Jean
Kate Beckinsale, Chris Kattan, Sarah Harmer
John Cusack, Grant Paulsen, Joe Strummer
videos.overview: During "What's the Deal With Old Guys and Enormous Glasses?" Dave wears a 70's-era pair of specs; John Cusack promotes Serendipity.

videos.title: Owen Wilson, Lisa Ling, Ryan Adams
videos.overview: Paul composes a song about people that look like Burt Reynolds; Owen Wilson plugs Zoolander.

videos.title: Joshua Jackson, Tiki Barber, Emo Phillips
videos.overview: Alan gives dating tips; Joshua Jackson promotes the upcoming season premiere of "Dawson's Creek;" Emo Philips does a stand-up routine on Dave's show for the first time since 1989.

videos.title: Tom Cavanagh, Steve Hartman, Leona Naess
Bruce Willis, Cody Arens, Alicia Keys
videos.overview: Out of the blue, Dave compliments the New York State Police, but Paul smells a rat.  Dave claims he wasn't pulled over again.  Meanwhile, Bruce Willis plays "drums" with his head and 7-year-old child actor Cody Arens plugs Riding in Cars with Boys.

videos.title: Rose McGowen, Sarah Vowell, Jim Gaffigan
Steve Kroft, Bruce McCall, John Mellencamp
Jack Hannah, Justin Long, Daniel Rodriguez
Ethan Hawke, Judith Miller, Quincy Jones
John McCain, Brittany Murphy, Macy Gray
Kevin Kline, Richard Holbrooke, Caroline Rhea
David Spade, Marv Albert, Laurie Anderson
Marge Helgenberger, Gil de Ferran, Lyle Lovett
Stupid Pet Tricks, Vince Vaughn, Faith Evans
Barbara Walters, David Radcliffe, Natalie Merchant
Noah Wyle, George Miller, Carole King
Ellen DeGeneres, Dave Gorman, Kelly Goldsmith
Kevin Spacey, Jerome Bettis, Jane Monheit
Jamie Foxx, Rhys Ifans, Darlene Love
Jennifer Connelly, Colin Soloway
videos.overview: What's "New for the Office" in 2002?  The items Dave introduces include a Jack Daniels water cooler and a color printer that makes flapjacks.  Also, throughout the night, various people walk onstage and gripe about Dave in French, Turkish, Russian and Japanese.

videos.title: Ethan Zohn, Josh Hartnett, Remy Zero
Cynthia Nixon, Mario Andretti, Willie Nelson & Rob Thomas
Darrell Hammond, Elayne Boosler, Willie Nelson & Lyle Lovett
Amy Brenneman, Martin Rees, Shakira
videos.overview: Disgraced Enron CEO "Kenneth Lay" sits in with the band, and is later seen shredding songsheets.

videos.title: Mariska Harkitay, George Divoky, Alan Jackson
Janet Jackson, Enrique Iglesias
videos.overview: Stephanie makes her first report from Salt Lake City, in which she shows Dave a photo of her watching the opening ceremonies on TV; Dave can't stop staring at Janet Jackson's revealing outfit; Enrique Iglesias sings "Escape."

videos.title: Jill Bakken and Vonnetta Flowers, Kelsey Grammer, Alanis Morissette
Stupid Human Tricks, Cher
videos.overview: In honor of his recent nomination, Paul and the gang participate in a Grammy-themed edition of "Stump the Band;" during "Stupid Human Tricks," a fourteen-year-old girl performs "Feliz Navidad" with her nose; Cher sings "Song for the Lonely."

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Andie MacDowell, Evelyn Glennie
Rene Russo, Bob Sarlatte, The Chieftains
John McCain, The White Stripes
videos.overview: Dave mentions that Paul has been keeping himself busy, as he performed not only at this year's Rock n' Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremonies, but also at the much-ballyhooed Liza Minelli-David Gest wedding; Dave continues to gloat over his Aftonbladet award, which he nonchalantly drinks from Stanley Cup-style; The White Stripes perform "Fell In Love With a Girl."

videos.title: Jon Stewart, Kit Armstrong
videos.overview: Dave asks Paul to play some Gene Pitney; the "Late Show Psychic Test Drive" finds Rupert driving Deborah Lynn around the city in a 2001 Chevy Malibu; Dave chats with boy genius Kit Armstrong.

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, N.E.R.D.
videos.overview: Dave and Paul discuss the vernal equinox and the old wives tale that you're supposed to be able to stand an egg on its end at the moment of the equinox; Dave mentions that "Will It Float" is quickly becoming a fan favorite, then correctly predicts that a half-gallon of strawberry ice cream will float; N.E.R.D. performs "Rock Star."

videos.title: Adam Arkin, Amy Sedaris, Midnight Oil
videos.overview: Alan reports on what everybody was wearing at last night's Oscars (all the men wore tuxedos), while Adam Arkin promotes the critically-disdained sitcom Baby Bob.

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Shannon McNally
videos.overview: Dave shows a (bogus) clip of the upcoming Baby Bob spin-off "Baby Jacques," which is just like the original show except everybody speaks in a French accent; a proud tradition continues as a Hello Deli customer goes on a Easter meatball hunt; Alan apologizes for his comments toward Gwyneth Paltrow on last night's show, then inadvertently insults Uma Thurman.

videos.title: Peter Krause, Doris Kearns Goodwin
videos.overview: Eric Burdon of The Animals sits in; during the "Odd Catalogs" segment, Dave displays an ad for a "Government-seized and repossessed hairpiece blowout"; the Hi-Ho girls deliver a birthday cake to Tony; Doris Kearns Goodwin addresses rumors of plagiarism.

videos.title: Robin Williams, Sevendust
videos.overview: Biff shows footage of him harassing New Yorkers with a bullhorn; the New York National Guard presents the Top Ten; Sevendust (featuring Paul) performs "Angel's Son."

videos.title: Andy Dick, Mike Britt
videos.overview: Mailbag: Tony's apparent sexiness forces George Clarke to drown his sorrows in a bucket of chicken at KFC; Dave shows off a tattoo on his leg that he wishes he didn't have (the ABC logo); after learning that Alan makes more money than him, Tony meets George at KFC.

videos.title: Marv Albert, Charlotte Ross
videos.overview: Acid jazz legend Herbie Hancock sits in on keyboards; Dave orders Steph/Monty to buy French fries; Marv Albert shows off another one of his blooper reels.

videos.title: Tim Robbins, Jimmie Walker, Cast of Oklahoma
videos.overview: During the latest Celebrity X-Ray Challenge, Dave persuades Rupert to lip sync a song from Oklahoma!

videos.title: Michael J. Fox, Patti Smith
videos.overview: After Dave notices that Alan bears a slight resemblance to Fred MacMurray, the announcer and a Barbara Stanwyck stand-in recreate a scene from Double Indemnity.  Also, Patti Smith sings "Dancing Barefoot."

videos.title: Selma Blair, Dick Enberg
videos.overview: Biff introduces footage from his latest trip to Yankees Spring Training in Florida, while a fully-packed suitcase is subjected to "Will It Float?"

videos.title: Bob Newhart, Demetri Martin
videos.overview: Will Lee stands in for Biff on pin duty, and for his troubles he receives the tradition gift of Samsonite® luggage; during Mailbag, two "girl scouts" (Harold Larkin and Mike McIntee) destroy Paul's office for being behind on his cookie payments; ten members of the Coast Guard present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Rosie Perez, George Miller
videos.overview: In honor of his departure from The Early Show; Dave shows footage of moving men with cardboard boxes superimposed over Bryant Gumbel talking in mid-broadcast; "Survivor: Marquesas" also-ran Gina Crews demonstrates her talent for spitting watermelon seeds; George Miller brags that his grandfather invented the handshake.

videos.title: John Ashcroft
videos.overview: Dave models a hideous pair of glasses he found in his house; a woman from Portland, Oregon rides around in Al Norwood's 2001 Honda S2000; Dave tries to get Attorney General John Ashcroft to sing, but only does so during the commercial breaks.

videos.title: Sandra Bullock, Billy Norris, Sheryl Crow
videos.overview: After his reluctance to sing on last night's show, Dave is appalled to find US Attorney General John Ashcroft crooning "When The Eagles Soars" on TRL; Alan impersonates Fred MacMurray again; Sheryl Crow sings "Soak Up The Sun."

videos.title: Dee Dee Davis, Cameron Diaz, The Strokes
videos.overview: Dave receives another comedy class project from Miss Markey's Kindergarten class, while The Strokes perform "Take It or Leave It."

videos.title: Matthew Conaughey, John Witherspoon
videos.overview: Dave receives an unexpected birthday greeting from Osama Bin Laden; CBS Mailbag is interrupted to that the Hi-Ho girls can bring out Daddy's cake; ten Air Force pilots present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher, Oliver Atukudzi
videos.overview: Dave mentions that he bumped his head over the weekend, then comments on the recent drought in NYC.

videos.title: Landon Shuffett, Seth Green, Elvis Costello
videos.overview: Dave mentions that Saddam Hussein's novel Zabibah and the King was been turned into a musical, and then shows a (bogus) promo for it's upcoming debut in Baghdad; seven-year-old billiards trick shot artist Landon Shuffett blows Dave away by shooting a row of thirteen balls into the corner pocket; Elvis Costello performs "Tear Off Your Own Head (It's A Doll Revolution)."

videos.title: Tiffani Thiessen, Bill Walton, Bonnie Raitt
videos.overview: Dave mentions Paul's appearance on tonight's episode of Ed, and shortly afterwards Paul wears the fake mustache he had to wear for the role; Alan and the Barbara Stanwyck look-alike perform another scene from Double Indemnity; Bonnie Raitt sings "I Can't Help You Now."

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Paul Westerberg
videos.overview: Another "Incredible Dog Challenge" is postponed by rain; Dave wears his ugly red glasses again; Cee-Lo sings "Closet Freak."

videos.title: The Rock, Dwayne Kennedy
videos.overview: Dave and Paul talk about wrestling in preparation of his interview with Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.  During CBS Mailbag, "Mayor Bloomberg" (Gerard) offers Dave some pot, and Alan Kalter promotes the video "Osama Gone Wild."

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Paul Westerberg
videos.overview: Dave shows various clips of Ted Danson looked scared/shocked from his recent miniseries Living With the Dead; Dave points out that the Late Show was chosen as the seventh greatest television program of all time; Paul Westerberg performs "Silent Film Star."

videos.title: Incredible Dog Challenge, Debra Messing, Wilco
videos.overview: The Incredible Dog Challenge is finally held out on 53rd Street, and throughout the night three dogs compete through a series of hurdles and tubes.

videos.title: Kirsten Dunst, Steve Nash, Angie Stone & The O'Jays
videos.overview: An "Incredible Cat Challenge" is thwarted when George Clarke's cat won't go through the obstacle course; Kirsten Dunst promotes Spider-Man; after Angie Stone and the O'Jays perform "Wish I Didn't Miss You," the house band closes the show by performing "Love Train."

videos.title: Tobey Maquire, Trey Anastasio
videos.overview: "Biff Henderson's America" visits the hamlet of Denver, Indiana; Dave comments on rumors that Bill Clinton may host a daytime talk show; Tobey Maguire does a really bad Rodney Dangerfield impression.

videos.title: Jennifer Garner, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: Mailbag: a letter about having your name mentioned on TV is somehow morphed into a request to see Alan getting the crap beat out of him.  Later on in the segment, a letter about tornados has the same result, as an already bloodied Alan is further laid to waste.  Also, Michael McIntee does a remote Top Ten from Central Park, while Jim Gaffigan discusses food and cleanliness.

videos.title: Mary Tyler Moore, Norah Jones
videos.overview: The outside cam catches Spider-Man jacking a car; Dave and Mary Tyler Moore play catch; Norah Jones performs "Don't Know Why."

videos.title: Richard Gere, Reggie Miller
videos.overview: Dave moans and groans over his latest dental work; Dave shows (obviously phony) footage of Peter Jennings doing World News Tonight in a Spider-Man costume; Richard Gere makes first appearance on the show since 1983.

videos.title: Will Ferrell, Tom Waits
videos.overview: Dave and Paul take apart wedding announcements in the New York Times; a staffer in a Spider-Man outfit successfully hails a taxi; Will Ferrell tells Dave what it's like to run the NYC marathon.

videos.title: Hugh Grant, Tony Hawk
videos.overview: Skateboarding great Tony Hawk demonstrates his wares out on 53rd Street.

videos.title: Gillian Andersen, Jonathan Katz
videos.overview: With Biff on vacation, Steph/Monty handles the pushpins live via telephone; during Mailbag, Paul demonstrates a hidden talent for cartwheels, and then mysteriously disappears; a Mother's Day tradition is started when the moms of ten celebrities present the Top Ten list; Dave and Gillian Anderson make out.

videos.title: Liza Minnelli
videos.overview: Dave chats with the latest Survivor loser Robert "The General" DeCanio, while Liza Minnelli performs "Some People" from the musical Gypsy.

videos.title: Kid Scientists, Allison Janney, Al Green
videos.overview: Nine guys in Spider-Man outfits, not to mention Dracula, Superman, and a cowboy cram themselves into a Subway restaurant; Tony Orlando dresses down Dave even though he interrupted him, then leaps into a chorus of "Knock Three Times"; when one of Lee Marek's kid scientists starts a very flammable demonstration, Dave demands that the band and everyone else onstage take for cover behind his desk.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Ted Nugent
videos.overview: Tony Mendez goes home with an audience member (see recap), while Dave and rocker/sportsman Ted Nugent cook rabbit.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Natalie Portman, X-ecutioners, Xzhibit, Biohazard
videos.overview: Dave shows footage from rehearsal of Kenny McGowan tripping over the "Will It Float" tank; Biff visits the Indianapolis Motor Speedway for the Indy 500 time trials; a participant in tonight's "Stupid Human Tricks" that can maneuver a tennis racquet all over his body flirts with Natalie Portman in the green room.

videos.title: Kathie Lee Gifford, Brian Regan
videos.overview: Mailbag: Martha Stewart fills in for Biff on the pushpin board, Harold Larkin goes hitchhiking, and Tony is humiliated on Blind Date.  Also, Brian Regan comments on his inability to spell names correctly.

videos.title: Vecepia Towerey, Hilary Swank, The Firecrackers
videos.overview: Steph/Monty is mentioned in the latest issue of Entertainment Weekly; Dave calls New York Highway Superintendent Drew Outhouse to resolve an awkward social situation; The Kalter Twins perform "I've Got You Babe"; The Firecrackers, a synchronized jump rope team, demonstrate their wares on-stage.

videos.title: Diane Sawyer, Jesse Martin
videos.overview: Dave shows real footage of a woman being questioned on the news wearing a Late Show t-shirt; Diane Sawyer brags about her recent weight loss; Dave chats with Australian teen Jesse Martin, the youngest person ever to sail around the world solo.

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, April Kleinschmidt, Patty Loveless
videos.overview: Trumpter Terence Blanchard sits in; in honor of David Blaine's recent stunt in which he stands on a eighty-foot platform for several days, George Clarke attempts to stand on a folding chair for the duration of the show; Dave chats with April Kleinschmidt, the sole graduate of the Class of 2002 at Harrold High School in South Dakota.

videos.title: Jon Favreau, David Rakoff, Anton Figg
videos.overview: Alan asks passerby for their reaction to the new Star Wars prequel and ends up making a scene.  Also, Anton Fig and Ivan Neville perform "Inside Out" from the CBS Orchestra drummer's new album, Figments.

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Wendy Liebman
videos.overview: Dave announces that Paul will be called Pablo this summer, which will go into effect immediately; Dave promises tonight's show will be "smooth and suave"; during Mailbag, an audience member asks Dave what his most embarrassing moment was, and we watch a (phony) clip of Dave performing with The Firecrackers last week.

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, Tom Dreesen, Goo Goo Dolls
videos.overview: While showing photos from her trip to the Indianapolis 500, Dave calls Steph/Monty "Dutch"; the snake lady performs again on "Is This Anything?"; Tom Dreesen tells various tales of Hollywood hobnobbing.

videos.title: Celine Dion, Helio Castroneves
videos.overview: Dave accuses Rupert of product placement on "May We See Your Photos, Please"; Alan addresses the Queen of England in a rather inappropriate way; Celine Dion performs "I'm Alive" and jumps into the audience.

videos.title: Chris Rock, Jack Johnson
videos.overview: Dave and Paul try to figure out a strange gesture that Celine Dion made during her TV concert earlier that week.  Later, Chris Rock talks about Don King and Bucky Dent.

videos.title: Nicolas Cage, Abi Thomas, Jimmy Eat World
videos.overview: An audience member explains to Dave how to pronounce the name of her hometown: "You're saying Morristown. It's not Morristown. It's Morristown."  Also, Dave chats with Abi Thomas, a jogger who was attacked by a bear at Yellowstone National Park.

videos.title: Zach Braff, Kathleen Madigan
videos.overview: Mailbag: "Is This Anything?" fave Kiva "Grinder Girl" Kahl stands next to Biff while he puts the pushpins in the map; twelth floor receptionist Art Garfunkel provides his own on-hold music; Alan beats the crap out of an Amish guy, then when Dave explains that the Amish are pacifists, Alan heads back to Lancaster, Pennsylvania, accuses the Amish guy of being brainwashed by Dave, and beats him up again.

videos.title: Christian Slater, David Bowie
videos.overview: Dave comments on the Nets' playoff run; Alan performs another scene from Double Indemnity, this time with a Edward G. Robinson stand-in; David Bowie performs "Slow Burn."

videos.title: Sarah Michelle Gellar, John McEnroe
videos.overview: Sarah Michelle Geller promotes Scooby-Doo while John McEnroe tells Dave a funny story about getting thrown out of the Australian Open back in his playing days.

videos.title: Freddie Prinze, Jr., Alicia Keys
videos.overview: Dave and Paul talk about their cholesterol levels; Freddie Prinze, Jr. promotes Scooby-Doo; Alicia Keys sings "How Come You Don't Call Me?"

videos.title: Matt Damon, Marc Maron
videos.overview: Biff does his pushpin schtick live from the Grand Canyon, and Dave persuades him to yell "Hey, Mommy!" just to see if there's an echo.  Also, Paul does a somewhat convincing James Brown impression, suffers a nervous breakdown onstage, and Dave comes by to bring him his cape.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Tom Cruise, The Flatlanders
videos.overview: Dave takes inventory of all his favorite clips (the "wild dingo," the baby owl eating the mouse, Dubya looking confused, etc.); Tom Cruise shows off his braces; during a segment called "Don't Try This At Home," Mike McIntee sprays Windex into his mouth.

videos.title: Ellen DeGeneres, Al Franken
videos.overview: George Clarke stands on the roof of the Studio 54 building to hit golf balls, hoping to go over the Ed Sullivan Theater and break glass on the WPI building on its far side.  After successfully breaking one window, Steph/Monty, Alan, and Al Franken each take a few swings at the windows.

videos.title: Piedmont Birdcallers, Lauren Ambrose, Moby
videos.overview: The bird callers of Piedmont High School demonstrate their wares once more; Moby sings "We Are Made of Stars."

videos.title: Harrison Ford, ...And You Will Know Us By The Trail of Dead
videos.overview: The U.S. National Team presents "Top Ten Ways to Get Americans Excited About Soccer;" Dave brags about buying his first car at Harrison Ford; The Trail of Dead performs "Relative Ways."

videos.title: Connie Chung, Gary Mule Deer
videos.overview: Biff and Bruce Willis push pins in Hawaii during CBS Mailbag, while Dave lands on the cover of "Martha Stewart Living."

videos.title: Will Smith, Landon Donovan, Yo Yo Ma & The Silk Road Project
videos.overview: Will Smith promotes "Men In Black 2," while the US Men's World Cup Soccer Team holds an exhibition on the roof of the theater.

videos.title: National Hollering Champions, Adam Sandler, Trik Turner
videos.overview: Dave makes several enlightening remarks about the National Hollerin' Champions from North Carolina, who later perform their winning hollers; Adam Sandler plugs Mr. Deeds.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Bow Wow
videos.overview: Dave reads from random wedding announcements in the New York Times in a segment called "Will It Last?"

videos.title: Michelle Williams, Barry Sonnenfeld
videos.overview: The audience is victorious once more when they play "Stump the Band."  Later, Dave shows a very obnoxious commerical for the upcoming G-8 Summit.

videos.title: Christina Ricci, Daniel Tosh, Ben Kweller
videos.overview: The "Late Show CBS Mailbag Biff Henderson Map Across America Summer Tour" lands at the Statue of Liberty.  Later, Ben Kweller performs "Wasted and Ready."

videos.title: Tom Hanks, Dolly Parton
videos.overview: Biff goes out in van, annoying people with a bullhorn.  Later, Steph/Monty asks "Road to Perdition" star Tom Hanks, "During the filming, did the crew see or touch any monkeys?"

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Jude Law, rubyhorse
videos.overview: Zeke, the "Rabid Dingo" that bit Dave in June 2000, makes a return appearance on "Stupid Pet Tricks."  Later, rubyhorse sings "Sparkle."

videos.title: Robin Williams, Pat Green
videos.overview: Dave talks about a snake in his house; Alan Kalter seduces a CPR dummy during a segment called "What's New for Summer;" Pat and Kenny read a transcript of Oprah's interview with Jennifer Lopez; Robin Williams promotes a movie and a broadway show.

videos.title: Paul Newman, Counting Crows
videos.overview: Dave plays "Know Your Current Events" with the audience.  Later, Paul Newman talks about auto racing while promoting "Road to Perdition."

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Hugh Fink
videos.overview: Biff's Summer Tour stops at Niagara Falls.  Meanwhile, during CBS Mailbag, George Clarke talks about his plans for the Fourth of July; Alan Kalter struts his "mastery" of the French language.

videos.title: Serena Williams, Tom Arnold, Dave Matthews Band
videos.overview: Dave admits to being in a disproportionatly good mood during a segment called "Late Show Newsmakers;" the Dave Matthews Band becomes the second band ever to perform on the roof of the Ed Sullivan Theater.

videos.title: Catherine Keener, Mario Batali, Solomon Burke
videos.overview: Steph/Monty and Dave play another round of "Psychic Sandwich."  Later, Dave wrecks havoc during a cooking segment with New York restaurant owner Mario Batali.

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker, Etta James
videos.overview: Sarah Jessica Parker talks about her unborn child; Alan appears to be on the brink of sanity; Dave stumps the audience with a "Beach Quiz."

videos.title: Geena Davis, Robert Plant
videos.overview: Just for the hell of it, the annual "Late Show Holiday Quarterback Challenge" is held in the middle of July; Dave quizzes the audience with "Know Your Current Events;" Robert Plant sings "Darkness, Darkness."

videos.title: Ted Koppel, Wendy Liebman
videos.overview: Biff's latest stop on his tour is Washington, DC; Dave chats with "Martha Stewart" (Gerard) and her lawyer made of pine cones during CBS Mailbag; Ted Koppel shows off his impeccable comic timing, then delivers a cape to Paul for his Friday night breakdown.

videos.title: Haley Joel Osment, Bill Scheft, Dashboard Confessional
videos.overview: George Clarke flies a kite from a taxi; Haley Joel Osment promotes his movie, "The Country Bears;" Dashboard Confessional performs "Saints and Sailors."

videos.title: Kristen Johnson, Kinky
videos.overview: Rupert goes golfing; Calvert DeForest turns 81; Kristen Johnston promotes her appearance in Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" in Central Park.

videos.title: Dana Carvey, Ben Kilham
videos.overview: Dave chats with a "bear rehabilitator;" Dana Carvey promotes his movie "Master of Disguise;" the "Charts and Graphs" segment reveals that the contents of Ding Dongs are 50% Dings and 50% Dongs.

videos.title: Amy Sedaris, Chazz Palminteri, Weezer
videos.overview: During "Know Your Current Events," Dave seems to fixate on attractive women.  Later, Weezer plays "Keep Fishin'."

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Tift Merritt
videos.overview: During "CBS Mailbag," Paul exaggarates some of the many great tourist destinations of his hometown in Ontario.  Later, Bill Cosby talks about his Congressional Medal of Honor.

videos.title: Julia Stiles, Mike Daisey, Wyclef Jean
videos.overview: It's the dog days of summer, which might explain why Biff is sitting on a block of ice.  Later, Julia Stiles talks about her hair.

videos.title: Joan Rivers, Zooey Deschanel
videos.overview: Dave and Rupert play "The Late Show Celebrity X-Ray Challenge."  Tonight's celebrity is James Caan.

videos.title: Blaine Mayhugh, Joaquin Phoenix, Little Richard
videos.overview: Dave reads articles from obscure newspapers in a segment called "Small Town News."  Later, Little Richard sings "Good Golly, Miss Molly."

videos.title: Mike Myers, Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band
videos.overview: Mike Myers promotes "Austin Powers in Goldmember" and Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band performs "The Rising."

videos.title: Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band, Mitch Hedberg
videos.overview: Biff's Summer Tour continues as Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band perform "Lonesome Day."

videos.title: Matthew Perry, The Vines
videos.overview: Dave welcomes "Friends" star Matthew Perry, who is promoting a new movie.  Meanwhile, a performance by the Aussie rock group The Vines blows the audience (and Dave) away.

videos.title: Robin Williams, James Taylor
videos.overview: Sitting in with the band tonight is an unknown winner from the previous night's Teen Choice Awards.  Later, Robin Williams plugs "One Hour Photo."

videos.title: Al Pacino, Roger Clemens
videos.overview: Dave shows a timeline of President Bush's vacation, while Al Pacino promotes the movie "Simone."

videos.title: Elizabeth Hurley, Tom Ryan
videos.overview: Biff pushes pins into a map right in front of the famous Hollywood sign in L.A.; Alan and his twin brother Rick appear on "American Idol"; upon hearing of a proposed talk show hosted by Bill Clinton on CBS, Dave shows a promo for NBC's "The Saddam Hussein Show."

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Jimmy Fallon, Dirty Vegas
videos.overview: "SNL" star Jimmy Fallon promotes the MTV Video Music Awards, which he's hosting.

videos.title: Chris Elliot, Eliza Dushku, Dixie Chicks
videos.overview: Dave announces that tomorrow night Paul will be inducted into the National Black Sports and Entertainment Hall of Fame.  Later, Chris Elliott and Dave reminiscense.

videos.title: John Travolta, Nelly
videos.overview: Dave forces Steph/Monty to ask John Travolta, "How can I get in touch with the other Sweathogs?"

videos.title: Caroline Rhea, Jake Gyllenhall
videos.overview: Joe Perry of Aerosmith sits in with the band; Osama congratulates Dave for nine years at CBS; Jake Gyllenhall promotes "Moonlight Mile."

videos.title: Martin Short, Lewis Black
videos.overview: Biff Henderson ends his tour of the US during the "CBS Mailbag" segment (final stop: Mt. Rushmore) as Dave chats with "Dr. Steven Hatfill" (Gerard).  Later, Dave welcomes "Jiminy Glick" star Martin Short.

videos.title: Amanda Peet, Tom Dreesen
videos.overview: Dave mentions that a street is being named after Paul in his hometown of Thunder Bay, Ontario.  Later, Dave plays ""How Many Guys in Alien Suits Can Fit Into a Coffee Shop?""

videos.title: Jeff Goldblum, George Miller
videos.overview: Dave shows a promo for Al Jazzera's new show ""Afghani Idol;"" Dave calls Paul a half-wit, then apologizes several times; George Miller comments on frozen cryogenics and asks, ""What if the person froze to death?""

videos.title: Drea de Matteo, Sarah Vowell, The Doves
videos.overview: Steph/Monty is on the roof with binoculars, looking for Bon Jovi performing in Times Square.  Later, another one of Dave's assistants applies sunscreen on our weary voyeur.

videos.title: Peter Jennings, John Witherspoon
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, a viewer asks how Biff chose where to go during his summer tour.  Biff responds by thanking ""Rand"" and ""McNally,"" who turn out to be a couple of much younger women that he's sleeping with.

videos.title: John McEnroe, Piper Perabo, Queens of the Stone Age
videos.overview: Dave shows a (supposed) clip from the hit movie ""SwimFan,"" then chats with Stephanie about the US Open.

videos.title: Jennifer Esposito, Marianne Faithful
videos.overview: Dave introduces the man that supposedly punched David Wells; Rupert's Paul Shaffer sandwich beats Europa Cafe's basil chicken sandwich in a taste contest; ""Dr."" Bill DeLace addresses the West Nile Virus.

videos.title: Bill Clinton, Nanci Griffith
videos.overview: Dave reflects on a certain one-year anniversary, then chats with his former monologue punching bag, President Bill Clinton.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Linda Thompson
videos.overview: Dave announces the show can no longer be seen in Mexico City; Dave introduces Network Time Killers such as ""Korean Soap Opera Clip of the Night"" and ""Anton Fig's Beret of Mystery""; a dry wall joint sealer is tonight's mystery gadget on ""What the Hell Is It?""

videos.title: Megan Mullally, Rich Hall
videos.overview: Dave announces that any cell phones that go off during the taping will be smashed with a hammer; ""Dr. Phil"" (Gerard) tells Dave that he's deeply insane; Rich Hall comments on ""Hollywood's Nicest Couple.""

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Eve
videos.overview: After watching Oprah win the Bob Hope Award at last night's Emmys; Dave demands to win it in 2003; Dave gives Barbara Gaines a kiss for her heartfelt speech at last night's ceremony (five-peat!); Biff visits the set of ""CSI: Miami.""

videos.title: Jack Hanna, Tom Cavanagh, Civil War Reenactment
videos.overview: In observance of an incedent that occured at a White Sox-Royals game the previous week, two shirtless drunks beat the crap out of Alan.  Later, a Civil War battle is awkwardly recreated on 53rd Street.

videos.title: Reese Witherspoon, Juan Pablo Montoya, India.Arie
videos.overview: During the annual ""New for Fall"" segment, Alan's hair changes color.  Later in the same segment, he is beaten up by Harvey Keitel.

videos.title: Rose McGowan, Phillipe Petit
videos.overview: Artiste Phillipe Petit walks on a metal cable 12 stories up and 120 feet long across Broadway.

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Colin Quinn
videos.overview: Dave announces that he has ""nitrogen narcosis.""  Later, during CBS Mailbag, Harold Larkin recalls his harrowing experience of being stuck in an elevator for three hours... with Regis!

videos.title: Patricia Heaton, Murray Walker
videos.overview: Dave hollers about being the only person in the entire building who wasn't invited to a staff fondue party for Mary Barclay; billards champ Jeanette ""Black Widow"" Lee does a few trick shots; Patricia Heaton and Murray Walker promote their autobiographies.

videos.title: David Schwimmer, Avril Lavigne
videos.overview: Dave reminds the nation that he still definitely wants I-465 (the interstate around Indianapolis) named David Letterman Expressway, then announces that tomorrow he plans to offer the mayor of Indianapolis an enormous bribe to get the wheels turning.  Later, Avril Lavigne sings ""SK8ER BOI.""

videos.title: Anthony LaPaglia, Effie Nielson, Clinic
videos.overview: Biff celebrates his 56th birthday in grand style; Dave kills a bug on his desk; Dave chats with a nonogenarian weightlifter.

videos.title: Edward Norton, John Mayer
videos.overview: Dave contacts Indianapolis mayor Bart Peterson's office via telephone, and his assistant tells him that renaming the I-465 is a possibility.  Later, John Mayer sang ""Your Body is a Wonderland.""

videos.title: David Arquette, Todd Lynn
videos.overview: Dave says he is feeling ""bilious,"" and that he will be going to an anger management course in Pennsylvania this weekend; during CBS Mailbag, Kenny professes his love to Pat on an episode of ""Trading Spaces""; Jimmy Fallon offers Paul a cape for his weekly breakdown.

videos.title: Jennifer Love Hewitt, Tom Petty and The Heartbreakers
videos.overview: 53rd Street is the stage for the Purina® Dog Chow diving competition; Dave has choice words for Don Hewitt, who disliked a ""60 Minutes"" joke from last friday's show; Dave shows ""Rejected FDA Items"" such as Elmer's® glue with ten essential vitamins and minerals, ""Goat-umms®,"" and Tums® Spicy JalapeÃ±o; Steph/Monty takes a plunge into the doggie water.

videos.title: John McCain, David Sedaris
videos.overview: A recurring joke for the night (which involved an ice ball called Quaoar) is botched when Harold Larkin disappears; Senator John McCain plugs his new book ""Worth the Fighting For""; David Sedaris stands at a little podium and reads one of his hilarious essays.

videos.title: Charles Barkley, Franco Zeffirelli, Nitty Gritty Dirt Band
videos.overview: Tonight's desk time begins with trouble. A housefly is buzzing Dave, then lands on a guest chair.  Dave takes a swat at it and declares ""Late Show"" a no-fly zone.   Later, George Clarke is caught consuming glue.

videos.title: Michelle Pfeiffer, Bon Jovi
videos.overview: America's fastest-growing whoop-tee-do, ""Stump the Band,"" has the CBS Orchestra so excited that Paul is doing his horrible Carnac impression again.  Later, Michelle Pheiffer promotes ""White Oleander.""

videos.title: Johnny Knoxville, Ron White
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, someone asks ""Who is the smartest person on the Late Show staff?""  Dave points out that Late Show Film Coordinator Rick ""Shecky"" Scheckman is very well-read. George Clarke interrupts to make his case, but Dave isn't buying it.  Shortly afterwards, George picks up an armload of library books, then drops them from a window onto Shecky on the street.  Shecky kicks the bucket.

videos.title: Debra Messing, Pink
videos.overview: Dave shows a newspaper ad from Indy for the Dancers Showclub, instructing guests to take 12B off the ""Dave Letterman Expressway.""  He thanks them by promoting the nudie club near the end of the show.  Also, Pink sings ""Family Portrait.""

videos.title: Thandie Newton, Faith Hill
videos.overview: Dave announces he's been named the 17th-most-powerful person in show business; Don Rickles' torso is the supposed mystery scan on the ""Late Show Celebrity X-Ray Challenge""; Faith Hill discusses her five-year-old daughter's love of Aerosmith.

videos.title: Rudolph Giuliani, Naomi Watts
videos.overview: Dave walks around during the monologue; Sam Moore (of Sam & Dave fame) sits in; a giant rat flies over New York City; Naomi Watts promotes â€˜The Ring.""

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Santana & Michelle Branch
videos.overview: According to Dave, scientists have discovered a massive black hole at the center of our Milky Way galaxy. Head carpenter Harold Larkin is good enough to open the side stage door so we can have a look.  The black hole sucks Harold's pants off.  Later, Alan professes his love for the Anaheim Angels' Rally Monkey.

videos.title: P. Diddy, Eddie Brill
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, George Clarke receives a mint-flavored flu shot, and we learn where the blue index cards go after each show (the furnace).  Later, Late Show warm-up comedian Eddie Brill does standup.

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, Christina Aquilera
videos.overview: Steph/Monty asks ""Survivor 5"" loser Robb Zbacnik two very interrogating questions: 1. ""How did you find the weather in Thailand?"" 2. ""Did you see or touch any monkeys?""  Also, Anaheim Angels pitcher Scott Spiezio presents the Top Ten via satellite, Bonnie Hunt surprises Dave by wearing glasses during her interview; Christina Aguilera sings ""Beautiful.""

videos.title: Salma Hayek, Tori Amos
videos.overview: Intuitive Deborah Lynn ready for another dismal failure in ""Psychic Sandwich""; Dave looks at a Cooking Light magazine for some unexplained reason; Salma Hayek promotes ""Frida.""

videos.title: Warren Zevon
videos.overview: It's a somber and bittersweet night as Dave brings out longtime friend Warren Zevon as his only guest.  Zevon was recently diagnosed with terminal cancer, and the second half of the episode is just him performing. -- heystu

videos.title: Jerry Seinfeld, Foo Fighters
videos.overview: Amongst this year's ""New Halloween Costumes:"" Dr. Phil, a ""Marlboro Grocery Check-Out order divider,"" and a trio of Saddam Hussein doubles.  Plus, ten drill instructors present the Top Ten, Jerry Seinfeld comments on terrorism, and Foo Fighters perform ""All My Life.""

videos.title: Don Rickles, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, George Clarke explains why breakfast is the most important meal of the day, while Dave has an exclusive interview with ""Lizzie Grubman"" (actually Gerard Mulligan).  Later, Dave welcomes his old buddy Don Rickles.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Sean Hayes, Willie Nelson & Ryan Adams
videos.overview: During ""Stupid Human Tricks,"" a couple from Chicago switches underwear with each other without taking off their clothes; former Mets manager Bobby Valentine presents the Top Ten; Sean Hayes of ""Will & Grace"" fame plugs the TV biopic ""Martin & Lewis.""

videos.title: Julianne Moore, Grant Paulsen, Blind Boys of Alabama
videos.overview: Dave shows (bogus) footage of Bill Clinton accepting the nomination for a third term in office; Julianne Moore plugs ""Far From Heaven""; 14-year-old sports journalist Grant Paulson gives his two cents about current events.

videos.title: Kid Inventors, Tom Brokaw, The Wallflowers
videos.overview: Dave accuses Indianapolis mayor Bart Peterson of letting the expressway thing go through, and then makes an ultimatum.  Later, a ""Kid Inventor"" from Tampa demonstrates her ""Easy Fill Garbage Bag System.""

videos.title: Brittany Murphy, Al Lubel
videos.overview: During Mailbag, James Jackson ""Biff"" Henderson ""answers"" a question about his name by standing around with the Hi-Ho girls; Dave points out that this his 1900th episode on CBS, give or take a special; legendary TV director and fashion model Hal Gurnee brings Paul his cape.

videos.title: Robin Williams, Emily Proctor
videos.overview: Steph/Monty analyzes the recent election; Robin Williams promotes his ""Live on Broadway"" CD; ten astronauts present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Kelly Ripa, Emmitt Smith, Missy Elliott
videos.overview: Dave apologizes to his Broadway neighbors for setting off fireworks the previous night; Dave points out that in Europe, the name of Eminem's new movie is ""12.875 Kilometer""; Missy Elliott performs ""Work It.""

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Joe Pantoliano
videos.overview: Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits sits in; Joe Pantoliano plugs his new book; amongst the potential bestsellers coming out this Christmas: More Advice I Pulled Out of My Ass by Dr. Phil.

videos.title: Maggie Gyllenhaal, Pearl Jam
videos.overview: During a timeline of a day in the life of Saddam Hussein, we learn that Iraqi People Weekly has named him ""Sexiest Man Alive"" for the tenth straight year.  Also, Pat and Kenny read another Oprah transcript, this time with Kenny playing an overexcited Goldie Hawn.

videos.title: Al Gore, Pearl Jam
videos.overview: CBS Mailbag: A viewer asks, ""How would New York City be different if you were mayor?""  We then go outside to where two police officers are cracking down on a parking violator.  His punishment?  He has to sit in the Late Show audience.

videos.title: Kevin James, matchbox 20
videos.overview: The entire audience for tonight's show is from Schoharie, New York.  In honor of his generosity, the street that goes to the local sewer plant has been renamed ""David Letterman Lane.""  Also, ""Biff Henderson's America"" visits Schoharie, the mayor of the village presents the Top Ten, and matchbox twenty performs ""Disease.""

videos.title: Shania Twain, Cristiano da Matta
videos.overview: Dave asks Harold Larkin if he watched the Lenoid Meteor Shower last night.  He then opens the exit next to the stage, where, with the magic of green-screen, the moon explodes.  Also, Shania Twain sings ""I'm Gonna Getcha Good!""

videos.title: Adam Sandler, Pussycat Dolls
videos.overview: Adam Sandler expresses a desire to hang out with Dave.  Also, the Pussycat Dolls burlesque troupe performs with special guest Carmen Electra.

videos.title: Ice Cube, Cast of Hairspray
videos.overview: Dave points out that a doctor in England recently did an autopsy for a paying audience.  Cut to George Clarke, in the boiler room, who by coincidence is also conducting an autopsy... on a chicken. George is unable to determine the cause of death, but the corpse sure is tasty!

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr., Larry Miller
videos.overview: During Mailbag, a viewer asks if Biff ever takes off his headset.  Dave spins the query by asking what he listens to on those things.  Biff then removes the headset and puts it up to the boom microphone.  We can hear the opening theme and intro of Jay Leno's show.  Biff quickly adds, ""I only listen to the monologue.""

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Lisa Kudrow, Audioslave
videos.overview: Lisa Kudrow promotes ""Analyze That"" while Audioslave brings the house down (almost literally) with a scorching rendition of ""Cochise.""

videos.title: George Clooney, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Production staff member Eddie Valk tries to answer the question, ""Can a Guy in a Turkey Suit Hail a Cab?""  Apparently not.  Later, Steph/Monty grills George Clooney about his nude scene in the film ""Solaris.""

videos.title: Ray Romano, Jurassic 5
videos.overview: Dave rants about a false alarm on a New York City blizzard; amongst the potential bestselling gifts for Christmas is a futuristic clock that tells the time one hour in the future; Bill DeLace presents ""Top Ten Things You Don't Want to Hear in a Supermarket.""

videos.title: Amy Sedaris, The Strokes
videos.overview: For Thanksgiving, Marv Albert sits at Dorothy's kitchen table, eagerly anticipating one of her world-famous pies.  Also, The Strokes perform ""Someday.""

videos.title: Liza Minnelli, Jann Karam
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave mentions that he's been a very good boy this year and that he wants a John Deere riding mower for Christmas.  Also, comedian Jann Karam talks about her boyfriend.

videos.title: Jennifer Lopez, Sum 41
videos.overview: A giant rat knocks over the Christmas tree in Rockefeller Center; during ""Stephanie Birkett, Official Pollster,"" Dave's assistant asks a man on the street if Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer is gay; Sum 41 performs ""Still Waiting.""

videos.title: Nia Vardalos, Barry Sonnenfeld
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Biff attempts to build an IKEA bookshelf in the theater lobby.  Despite using only the Swedish instructions and claiming ""I can't build s***,"" the bookshelf is completed by the end of the show.

videos.title: Allison Janney, Martin Scorsese
videos.overview: During ""KYCE,"" a cop attempts to punch Dave; Allison Janney plugs ""The Hours.""

videos.title: Natasha Richardson, Mike Birbiglia, David Gray
videos.overview: Dave waxes philosophy: ""I believe there isn't a man, woman, or child who doesn't enjoy a lovely beverage.""  Also, comedian Mike Birbiglia makes his network television debut.

videos.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Coldplay
videos.overview: Dave repeatedly shows a ""60 Minutes"" clip showcasing Lesley Stahl's unique facial movements; as they do every year, Rupert, Joe G, Mujibur, and Sirajul decorate the Late Show Christmas Tree; Coldplay performs ""In My Place""; the giant meatball on the tree falls apart.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Rod Stewart
videos.overview: Osama and his half-awake sidekick sing ""We Wish You a Merry Christmas."" Also, Dave ponders, ""How Many Guys In Santa Suits Can Fit Into a Coffee Shop?""  By the end of the show, there are 19 Santas with beards, 5 without facial hair, and one guy dressed up as Superman standing in the shop.

videos.title: Denzel Washington, Daniel Bouloud
videos.overview: Greg Adams of The Tower of Power horn section sits in; Osama and his sidekick sing Christmas carols; Dave reads Daniel Boloud's cookbook.

videos.title: Tom Hanks, Phish
videos.overview: George Clarke takes a bath in the ""Will It Float?"" tank; the sixteen stars of ""Survivor: Thailand"" present the Top Ten; Phish performs ""All of These Dreams.""

videos.title: Liv Tyler, Jay Thomas, Darlene Love
videos.overview: Osama Bin Laden wishes Dave a merry christmas via video greeting card; Gerard Mulligan has something to say to Al Gore during ""CBS Mailbag;"" an annual tradition continues as Jay Thomas tries to knock the meatball of the Late Show Christmas Tree.

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher, Jason Kidd
videos.overview: During ""Is This Anything?,"" a man swallows a neon light sword.  Dave and Paul agree that this is something, but only because of the danger involved.

videos.title: Michael Caine, George Foreman
videos.overview: Dave shows a copy of George Foreman's new book, followed by a ""Michael Caine Grill""; Stephanie dances like her unnamed ex-boyfriend to the band playing Rod Stewart's ""Do You Think I'm Sexy?""; Michael Caine promotes The Quiet American.

videos.title: Richard Gere, Chris Elliott
videos.overview: Dave discusses his experiences with shampooing over the years, and announces that earlier today he inadvertently conditioned before shampooing.  Lo and behold, there's absolutely no difference!  Also, Chris Elliott makes his twentieth-odd triumphant return to the Late Show.

videos.title: Merv Griffin, Interpol
videos.overview: The shirtless father and son from that White Sox-Royals game in 2002 are elected into the Baseball Hall of Fame; Merv Griffin promotes his autobiography; Interpol performs ""PDA.""

videos.title: Renee Zellweger, Chuck Barris
videos.overview: Ten members of the 82nd Airborne Division based in Afghanistan present the Top Ten.  The soldier who presents #6 proposes to his girlfriend, who accepts via telephone. Also, today's ""Late Show Fun Fact"" reveals that Wink Martindale once beat a ""Tic-Tac-Dough"" contestant with his bare hands.

videos.title: Andy Richter, Rich Hall
videos.overview: Mailbag: Dave shows an ad for the mother of all reality shows, ""Bachelorette Millionaire Boat Survivor Race Factor Idol."" He also tries to make sense out of ""Rael"" (Gerard), a Quebecois cult leader who supposedly cloned the first human earlier this week.  After revealing the first cloned baby is really a dog, he rebounds with ""Rael's Pigskin Pick of the Week.""

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, Simon Baker
videos.overview: Dave talks football, while Jimmy Kimmel promotes his upcoming talk show on ABC.

videos.title: Claire Danes, Bob Sarlatte
videos.overview: Dave announces that today is the 3rd anniversary of his quintuple bypass, and upon mentioning this, Regis interrupts the jokes to give Dave a quick check-up.  ""You're screwed,"" Regis proclaims.  Throughout the night, Dave reflects on the bypass, claiming he ran five miles six weeks after the bypass.  Near the end of the show, Dave tells former announcer Bob Sarlette that his cholesterol is a healthy 46.

videos.title: Sandra Bullock, Marv Albert
videos.overview: Dave shows a bogus eulogy by the network commemorating yesterday's big anniversary; Sandra Bullock promotes Two Weeks Notice; Dave asks Biff to check the weather outside, and watches as several penguins waddle through Broadway.

videos.title: George Clooney, Soundtrack of Our Lives
videos.overview: CBS won't stop airing their 30-second eulogy to the ""late, great"" Dave; Dave shows a promo for the upcoming Survivor: Jihad, then wishes a happy birthday to an audience member.

videos.title: Joan Rivers, Kathleen Edwards
videos.overview: Mailbag: ""Who do you consider to be your best friend from the Late Show?"" Paul responds to this question by performing an original song dedicated to his best friend in the whole wide world, the man who changed his life for the better for the last twenty-one years, boom operator Al Norwood.

videos.title: Simon Cowell, Topher Grace, Vienna Teng
videos.overview: Osama praises ""Kangaroo Jack"" for his contempt for the infidels; Steph/Monty reviews the aforementioned movie, then makes a daring Super Bowl prediction (Bucs by 26!); ""Dwight the Troubled Teen"" (an Asian woman) vividly expresses his hatred of Alan.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, John C. Reilly
videos.overview: It's so cold outside, Alan's hair has turned a light shade of blue, but it turns out to be a Clairol® mishap. Also, Dave bids farewell to longtime comic foils Mujibur and Sirajul by giving them a Hoover Steamvac vacuum cleaner, and Regis talks football.

videos.title: Tina Fey, Jonathan Ames, Johnny Marr & The Healers
videos.overview: Alan's hair has now turned green; Paul tries to spin a ball on a parasol like the lady who appeared in tonight's ""Is This Anything?"", but fails miserably; Tina Fey promotes the Saturday Night Live (Super Bowl) Halftime Special.

videos.title: Ellen DeGeneres, Zwan
videos.overview: In a new, experimental segment, reporter Penny Crone contributes a ""Local News Update of the Night""; Dave admits that his friends are getting sick of ""Is This Anything?"", but he keeps on doing it anyway; Zwan performs ""Honestly.""

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, John Witherspoon
videos.overview: Mailbag: George Clarke has learned to speak Italian: ""Imgana cuccia nutsoff.""  Also, fertile make-up maven Michele O'Callaghan provides a cape for Paul's Friday night breakdown.

videos.title: Show #1944Kate Hudson, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Dave congratulates Frank Comito upon the birth of his daughter; Biff reports from Super Bowl XXXVII; a capybara (a large rat) sits on Kate Hudson's head and eats a banana, with due thanks to Jack Hanna.

videos.title: Matthew McConaughey, John Gruden, The Roots
Kelsey Grammer, Michael Tong, B.B. King and Shemeika Copeland
videos.overview: Upon showing off a fake invitation to Colin Powell's address to the United Nations, Dave starts singing a Paul Anka song; Alan hits on the wife of Hans Blix, and then later learns that he has just been fired and replaced.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Tom Brokaw, The Pretenders
Brendan Fraser, Kids in The Hall, Bonnie Raitt, Keb' Mo, Kim Wilson
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave shows a clip from the upcoming CBS drama ""CSI: Lancaster, PA""; the Kids in the Hall comedy troupe performs a skit about women's problems; Paul's Friday-night homage to James Brown is returned as the Godfather of Soul delivers his cape.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Tony Bennett & k.d. Lang
videos.overview: Alan is dressed as Saddam Hussein, claiming he's just trying to do his part; throughout the night, show dogs from the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show walk around the theater; Pat Farmer drinks paint; at the end of the show, Kenny Sheehan sneaks in disguised as a beagle.

videos.title: Amy Brennamen, Nate Erwin, Vince Gill
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Steph/Monty shops at 21 on 52nd Street.

videos.title: Queen Latifah, Colin Quinn, Lou Reed
Kid Scientists, Kurt Russell
videos.overview: Steph/Monty is dressed in a kimono for ""Know Your Current Events""; Dave mentions that Dr. Phil will be on Monday, and he plans to open up a serious can of whoop-ass; Homer Simpson (voiced by Dan Castellaneta) presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Kate Winslet, Dennis Regan, Rufus Wainwright
videos.overview: Dave talks to ""Michael Jackson"" (actually Gerard) during CBS Mailbag.  Later, comedian Dennis Regan rants about marriage.

videos.title: Dr. Phil, Beck
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Steph/Monty measures the accumulated snowfall on the roof of the theater; Daytona 500 champion Michael Waltrip presents the Top Ten; Dr. Phil makes his first-ever appearance on the Late Show, and it appears that he can take a joke; Beck performs ""Lost Cause.""

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Sarah Vowel, Beck
videos.overview: A guy whose flight from LaGuardia to Atlanta was delayed by snow sits in with the band; Mayor Bloomberg presents the Top Ten; Alan wants Dwight the Troubled Teen to shovel snow.

videos.title: Kevin Spacey, Reggie Miller
videos.overview: Amongst the ""New Catalogs"": Crate & Barrel (with new barrel-sized crates), Starbucks Coffee by Mail, and something called ""International Monkey.""  Also, Kevin Spacey does impressions of Elton John and Johnny Carson, while Alan threatens the sound engineer after a (supposed) gaffe on last night's show.

videos.title: Champion Turkey Callers, Marg Helgenberger, The Flaming Lips
videos.overview: In honor of tonight's Turkey Calling Champions, Dave has a swig of Wild Turkey bourbon; ""Biff Henderson's America"" makes a stop in Palomar Mountain, California, where he stands out on a ledge yelling out names of 50's-era wrestlers for an echo; The Flaming Lips perform ""Do You Realize?""

videos.title: Jeff Daniels, Lynne Cox, Steven Wright
videos.overview: Solomon Burke sits in; during Mailbag, Dave points out that a nudist-friendly Kinko's has opened nearby, while ""police chief"" Bill DeLace complains that Dave and Harold Larkin have run the bleeding-neck gag into the ground; Dave chats with Lynne Cox, who swam a mile to Antarctica in near-freezing water.

videos.title: Steve Martin, Foo Fighters
videos.overview: Dave mentions that Paul and Alan were involved with last night's Grammy Awards; Rupert asks ""non-surviving Survivor"" Janet Koth if there was any hanky-panky in the Amazon (but of course); Steve Martin shows (bogus) clips of some of his less memorable appearances on the Late Show, including dangling a baby off a third-floor balcony.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Sharon Osborne, Norah Jones
videos.overview: Dave mentions that he woke up this morning with a swollen eye, then hypothesizes that it's either an irritation, infection or inflammation; during ""Stupid Human Tricks,"" a man juggles and removes his shirt at the same time; Norah Jones is presented with a Grammy© made out of lunch meat.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Dan Rather, Carmen Electra, Brian Kiley
videos.overview: Dave's worsening eye infection puts him on the bench indefinitely, so scheduled guest Bruce Willis fills in for Daddy.  Amongst tonight's highlights: Bruno and George Clarke duct tape plastic sheets on the backdrop; the ""Lean Mean EZ CD Opening Machine"" (a sledge hammer) is demonstrated; Paul interviews Bruce, then Bruce sits in with the band on harmonica; John Mayer performs ""Why Georgia.""

videos.title: John McEnroe, Tom Arnold, Eric Ripert, Todd Barry, Jason Mras
videos.overview: Tennis great John McEnroe fills in for Dave, whose condition has not improved; Fred Schnieder of The B-52's fills in for Paul, whom, according to Bones Malone, has an appointment with Dr. Phil; John and Tom Arnold help Eric Ripert make Black Pepper and Cognac Shrimp.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Charles Grodin, Susan Lucci, Greg Giraldo, Kathleen Edwards
videos.overview: Regis fills in for Dave, who has now been diagnosed with shingles; Greg Giraldo does stand-up; Kathleen Edwards sings ""Hockey Skates.""

videos.title: Whoopi Goldberg, Jessica Lange, Dave Chappelle, Andy Vistola, Ben Harper
videos.overview: Whoopi Goldberg (a former talk-show host in her own right) is the latest to fill in for Dave during his extended bout with shingles.  She starts the monologue by announcing that ""tonight's show is in color,"" and then points out that the CBS Orchestra was once again the house band of last weekend's Rock n' Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony.  Also, comedian Andy Vastola makes his network television debut.

videos.title: Vince Vaughn, Rosie Perez, Geri Halliwell, Dwayne Kennedy, Paul Simon
videos.overview: Guest host Vince Vaughn charms the audience and hits on Rosie Perez.

videos.title: Elvis Costello, Kim Cattrell, Eddie Izzard, Mitch Hedberg
Will Ferrell, Chris Rock, Crispin Glover, Jake Johannsen, American Hi-Fi
videos.overview: Will Ferrell joins fellow ""Old School"" star Vince Vaughn as a guest host on Letterman.   In his monolouge, Will does his famous George W. Bush impression and serenades the absent host with his version of Kenny Rogers' ""Lady.""  Later on, the up and coming rock band The American Hi-Fi performs their hit ""The Art of Losing.""

videos.title: Megan Mullally, Molly Shannon, Isaac Mizrahi, Bonnie McFarlane
videos.overview: Will & Grace star Megan Mullally shows a clip of her tripping as she walked onstage to accept an award at last Sunday's Screen Actors Guild awards.  Later, she sings a blues number called ""Guilty.""

videos.title: Brad Garrett, Cuba Gooding Jr., Julie Bowen, Reggie McFadden, Lyle Lovett
videos.overview: Brad Garrett of Everybody Loves Raymond fame does a very Letterman-esque, one-liner heavy monologue, then mentions a recent medical mishap where his testes broke his fall.  Also, Lyle Lovett sings ""Straighten Up and Fly Right.""

videos.title: Tom Dreesen, Kiefer Sutherland, Frank Gershin, Suzanne Westenhoefer, The Music
videos.overview: Chicago-born comedian (and old friend of Dave's) Tom Dreseen becomes the latest fill-in host for Dave.  He mentions that a fan outside the theater mistook him for Regis, then goes a spiel about his daughter's love of hip-hop.  Also, lesbian comedian Suzanne Westenhoefer performs.

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, Carson Daley, Eddie Griffin, Ron Beth-Israel, Fabolous
Paul Schaffer, Bob Dole, Connie Nielsen, Jeff Foxworthy, Cat Power
videos.overview: Paul fills in for Dave, lamenting in song about the big shoes he has to fill; Mike Smith of the Dave Clark Five fills in for Paul, who later sings the band's hit ""Because""; indie rocker Cat Power makes her network television debut, and is so camera-shy she can't seem to eye contact with the audience.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Andrew Firestone, Clark Tery, Sofia Vergara, The DA
videos.overview: In a bizarre running gag, Bill Cosby pretends to be so senile that a substitute cue-card boy introduces all of tonight's guests; Hilton Ruiz, Spaceman Paterson, Steve Berrios, and Andy Gonzales all sit in lieu of a temporary depleted band tonight (only Paul, Sid and Bruce bothered to show up); Sofia Vergara promotes Chasing Papi; the D4 performs ""Get Loose.""

videos.title: Luke Wilson, Kelly Preston, Taye Diggs, Hilary Burton, Seether
videos.overview: Luke Wilson brings up a story about how he told his Old School co-stars Will Ferrell and Vince Vaughn he was hosting the Late Show. He was surprised by how unimpressed they were, as they also filled in for Dave.  Later in the show, Seether performs ""Driven Under.""

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Michael Barimo
videos.overview: Dave returns from a month-long hiatus and makes fun of his health problems.  He also shows an old ""Tonight Show"" clip as a tribute to the late, great George Miller.

videos.title: Colin Farrell, Rosanne Cash
videos.overview: ""I have to be here tonight,"" Dave utters in the monologue, ""I'm out of sick days.""  An ""Incredible Dog Challenge"" sponsored by Purina Dog Chow has been postponed by the weather, but that doesn't stop George Clarke from welding a metal garbage can.

videos.title: Helen Hunt, Jeremy Suarez, Cory Branan
videos.overview: Dave shows footage of Donald Rumsfeld unintentionally flipping the bird at a press conference, and later he chats with adolescent ""Bernie Mac Show"" star Jeremy Suarez.

videos.title: High-Jumping Dogs, Vin Diesel, Bo Diddley
videos.overview: After admitting that his medicine is making him bloated, Dave loosens his belt for all the world to see; during Biff's annual visit to Yankees Spring Training, he and Hideki Matsui recreate Abbott & Costello's ""Who's On First?"" routine; ten members of an Air Force base in Alaska present the Top Ten; Bo Diddley and the Debby Hastings Band performs ""Who Do You Love.""

videos.title: Hilary Swank, Jimmie Walker
videos.overview: Mailbag: ""Does Alan Kalter really have a twin?""  Dave points out that he does have a brother named Rick, but Alan interrupts with a chin rub. Apparently, Big Red recently discovered he has a twin sister, Denise.  After catching up on lost time at a local restaurant, Alan and Denise go to his place and make out.

videos.title: Adam Sandler, The Folksmen
videos.overview: Dave shows a clip of Les Moonves on last night's episode of The Practice; Dave warns Steph/Monty to not ask the monkey question, but she does anyway; The Folksmen (stars of the film ""A Mighty Wind"") perform ""Old Joe's Place.""

videos.title: Lisa Marie Presley, Jamie Kennedy
videos.overview: Dave and Paul wonder openly what to ask Lisa Marie Presley, who is on the show tonight to promote her first solo album.  Later in the show, she sings ""Lights Out.""

videos.title: Jane Krakowski, Jim Boeheim, Pete Yorn
videos.overview: Dave reminds us that his 56th birthday was on Saturday, but he claims it was really his 34th and CBS aged him; Dave tells a funny story about George Miller's memorial service; ""Hootie Johnson"" presents Dave with a green Masters jacket.

videos.title: Tom Brokaw, Tom Russell & Nanci Griffith
videos.overview: Dave announces that the Late Show (and not CNN) has the legal rights to a screen caption that reads ""Showdown: Syria""; Tony Mendez gets scolded by Daddy for abbreviating ""Dr. Phil's Words of Wisdom"" to ""Dr. Phil's Words of W"" on a cue-card; a woman who lost her luggage at JFK Airport participates in the new Hello Deli game ""What's Your Problem?"" (and she loses).

videos.title: Michael Douglas, Todd Rundgren
