videos.overview: Dave shows footage of chaos on the streets of Baghdad that bears that striking resemblance to West Side Story; a man balancing a burning bowling ball participates in ""Is This Anything?""; Todd Rundgren performs ""Hello, It's Me"" (a song he would perform on the show again later that year).

videos.title: Anthony LaPaglia, Brian Regan, The Exies
videos.overview: Dave congratulates cameraman Dave Dorsett on fifty years in the biz; during Mailbag, a viewer asks why Dave doesn't throw stuff off the roof anymore, resulting in a flashback where Paul and his office supplies are thrown onto 53rd Street; The Exies perform ""My Goddess.""

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Due to today's weather, Dave raises the temperature inside the theater from 53 to 57 degrees; Dave comments on the Iraqi playing cards, then points out that Mickey Rooney is the 8 of diamonds; Jack Hanna brings two emus and an oryx (an African antelope) onstage.

videos.title: Ellen DeGeneres, John Malkovich
videos.overview: Sam Moore sits in again; Carmen Rasmussen of ""American Idol"" presents the Top Ten; John Malkovich promotes his new clothing line.

videos.title: Charlize Theron, Sue Johanson, Minus 5 with Wilco
videos.overview: An Iraqi Republican guard that bears more than a passing resemblance to a dazed Calvert walks by Dave right after the monologue; Dave attempts to make ""Wash it, gas it, give me the keys"" his new catchphrase; Lily Chin (the world's fastest crocheter) makes Dave half of a sweater; The Minus 5 and Wilco join together to perform ""The Town That Lost Its Groove Supply.""

videos.title: Bernie Mac, Amanda Peet
videos.overview: Mailbag: ""Whatever happened to the bear that mauled Alan Kalter?""  According to VH1's Where Are They Now?, the bear was fired for stealing a monitor in 1999, but he rebounded and now works in middle management for Oglivy & Mather.  Dave invites the bear in to take a bow, and he runs over towards Alan in a frightening pose, then backs off and walks offstage.  Also, Pulitzer Prize winner Robert A. Caro presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Halle Berry, Don Rickles
videos.overview: Dave has Kentucky Derby announcer Dave Johnson on the phone so he can hear him say, ""â€¦and down the stretch they come!""; the latest ""Rejected FDA Items"" include baloney playing cards; Don Rickles does stand-up.

videos.title: Kelly Rippa, Good Charlotte
videos.overview: Prompted by an audience member's request the week before, Pat, Steph/Monty, and a new employee throw stuff off the roof throughout the show for the first time since 1998; Dave meets Christy Smith, the first disabled contestant to appear on ""Survivor"" (she's hearing-impaired).

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Hugh Jackson, Kelly Clarkson
videos.overview: Dave shows off his regular coffee mug, then a mug given to him by Dr. Phil that's almost twice that size, then the new, even larger Late Show mug; during ""Stupid Human Tricks,"" a man puts pennies up his nose with his tongue; Kelly Clarkson sings ""Miss Independent.""

videos.title: David Hyde Pierce, Rube Goldberg Contest Winners, Ziggy Marley
videos.overview: A staffer dressed as Nightcrawler from the ""X-Men"" movies tries to hail a cab, but ends up on a rickshaw; Joe Lieberman presents the Top Ten; Ziggy Marley performs ""True to Myself.""

videos.title: Megan Mullally, Marilyn Manson
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Biff answers yet another question about his headset by unsuccessfully attempting to seduce the author of the letter; ten celebrity moms (including Dorothy) present the Top Ten; Marilyn Manson discusses painting with watercolors and later hangs out in the green room with the mothers.

videos.title: Albert Brooks, Jeffery Ross, The Libertines
videos.overview: Dave shows a CBS promo for ""Saddam Week""; a box of fish sticks and a bottle of perfume are subjected to a rare ""Will It Float?"" doubleheader; Albert Brooks promotes Finding Nemo and pretends to complain about his woes.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Kevin James, Jenna Morasca
videos.overview: A high school senior in Jersey decides on his prom tuxedo, and ends up choosing a powder blue leisure suit; during ""Stupid Pet Tricks,"" a pink poodle sorts out blocks of different shapes; Survivor: Amazon winner Jenna Morasca is interrogated on all fronts, with burning questions from Dave, Paul, Rupert, and Monty.

videos.title: David Williams & Ronald Young, Jada Pinkett Smith, The Jayhawks
videos.overview: Dave reads the new disclaimer on the New York Times (""Not all articles are factual""); Chief Warrant Officers David Williams and Ronald Young, Jr. tell their incredible story of survival as Iraqi POWs; Jada Pinkett Smith promotes The Matrix Reloaded.

videos.title: Sean Hayes, Eric Ripert, Avril Lavigne
videos.overview: Biff walks the streets of New York City looking for celebrities, or, for that matter, celebrity lookalikes; during a cooking segment with Eric Ripert, Dave slings back a bottle of Jack Daniels; Avril Lavigne performs ""Losing Grip.""

videos.title: John Goodman, D.H. Hughley, NAS with Alicia Keys
videos.overview: John Goodman discusses his ""promotion"" to President on The West Wing; Johnny Knoxville delivers Paul's cape; Nas and Alicia Keys perform ""Warrior Song.""

videos.overview: Dave does the ""Charts and Graphs"" segment for the first time in over a year; Mark Wahlberg talks about his girlfriend, unborn child, and new house; The Sounds perform ""Seven Days a Week.""

videos.title: Jim Carrey, Chevelle
videos.overview: After Dave makes a joke about CBS' recent miniseries about Adolf Hitler, Paul and the band plays ""Danke Schoen;"" a woman is given the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to call, and then hang up on Regis; Alan has a few words to say about ""American Idol;"" Jim Carrey shows off his idea for a reality show; Chevelle performs ""Send The Pain Below.""

videos.title: Regis Philbin, 3 Doors Down
videos.overview: Dave shows off the latest oversized Late Show mug; Regis admits his contempt for last night's comedy bit at Hello Deli; 3 Doors Down performs ""The Road I'm On.""

videos.title: Antonio Banderas, Heidi Klum, Liam Lynch
videos.overview: Dave announces that the unwieldy-huge Late Show mug that debuted last night is available for parties, and Dave attempts to sip some coffee out of it; Liam Lynch performs his novelty hit ""United States of Whatever.""

videos.title: Peter Krause, Jim Gaffigan, Widespread Panic
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Biff assembles a Weber Grill in the lobby; half the audience is comprised of sailors; Kareem Abdul-Jabbar delivers Paul's cape.

videos.title: Adrien Brody, Gil de Ferran, John Mellencamp
videos.overview: In honor of a recent Team Rahal victory, Dave makes car noises; Steph/Monty discusses last weekend's Indianapolis 500 via telephone; ""What's on the Barbeque"" finds Biff trying to guess what type of meat is being cooked on the grill built last week on the show; Dave tries to persuade tonight's guests to also make engine noises.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Tom Dreesen
videos.overview: Tisziji Munoz (a mentor of Paul's) sits in on guitar; Rupert and a Long Island girl play ""Stop the Slicer""; Alan introduces a video montage of what are intended to be various celebrities, but Dave criticizes him and Alan starts sobbing; Alec Baldwin tells an amusing story about his hypochondria.

videos.title: Seth Green, Amy Sedaris, Lucinda Williams
videos.overview: Dave mentions that Tom Arnold will be filling in for him Friday night; staffer Eddie Valk participates in ""Can a Guy in a Horse Suit Get into FlashDancers?""  After successfully enter the nudie bar, Eddie then attempts to hail a taxi but ends up annoying passerby.

videos.title: Barbara Walters, Tanya Streeter
videos.overview: Dave and Paul discuss skin diving; Dave makes the new Hillary Clinton memoirs the butt of several jokes; Seth Green promotes The Italian Job.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Darrell Hammond, Karolina Kurkova, Eddie Brill, Train
videos.overview: Tom Arnold fills in for Dave as he takes yet another night off. Later on, Tom welcomes longtime ""SNL"" cast member Darrell Hammond and rock group Train.

videos.title: Juliette Binoche, Joe Queenan, Blur
videos.overview: Dave talks about a weekend onion-slicing accident involving his pinky, which results in a medical procedure live on stage.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Chris Moneymaker
videos.overview: Dave and Paul play ""Millionaire or Kenny?"" Later, Barbara Gaines (making a rare on-camera appearance) receives a surprise birthday cake; Bruce Willis shows off his new hairdo.

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Marv Albert, Bright Eyes
videos.overview: Lauren Graham talks about her recent real estate acquisition; Marv Albert shows some of his favorite bloopers.

videos.title: Harrison Ford, Annie Lennox
videos.overview: On ""CBS Mailbag,"" Alan Kalter is beaten up by leprechauns, plus Dave welcomes Harrison Ford, which gives him the chance to rehash a favorite line: ""I bought my first car at ""Harrison Ford!""

videos.title: Tom Green, Jolene Blalock, Scott Stevens, Isaac Britty, Damien Rice
videos.overview: Host Tom Green (an Ottawa Senators fan) gets body-checked by Scott Stevens of the rival New Jersey Devils.  Also, comedian Isaac Witty and singer-songwriter Damien Rice make their respective network television debuts.

videos.title: Hilary Clinton, Emmylou Harris
videos.overview: Dave celebrates an important milestone; Biff Henderson goes to a senior prom in New Jersey; Dave chats with Hillary Clinton.

videos.title: Rob Reiner, Paul Teutul Sr. & Jr., The New Pornographers
videos.overview: Rupert and Dave play ""Name That Baldwin""; Rob Reiner brags about his recent weight loss; Paul Teutel and Paul Teutel Jr. of the cable reality show American Chopper demonstrate their knack for building motorcycles.

videos.title: Johnny Depp, Christine Todd Whitman, B.B. King
videos.overview: B.B. King sits in with the band; Biff teaches Dave how to ride a Segway; ""Dr. William Gammons"" gives the audience advice on monkeypox.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer, Treat Williams, James Earl Jones, Jamie Lynn-Sigler, Kathleen Madigan, Jesse Malin
videos.overview: Kelsey Grammer (aka Frasier Crane) talks about his 20-month-old daughter, then chats with fellow deep-voiced thespian James Earl Jones.

videos.title: Demi Moore, Verbana

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Simon Cowell
videos.overview: Drew Barrymore promotes her new movie; Simon Cowell of ""American Idol"" fame talks about his new reality show ""Cupid.""

videos.title: Lucy Liu, Avigayil Wardein, Nick Cave and The Bad Seeds
videos.overview: During ""Who Asked For It?,"" Alan uses CPR as an excuse to make out with an audience member; Dave makes his first PA announcement in almost four years, telling the crowd outside the theater that they're about to be hosed with ""Mountain Dew"" (water); Dave chats with a six-year-old girl from Florida who ran a controversial lemonade stand.

videos.title: Piedmont Bird Callers, Luke Wilson, The Yeah Yeah Yeahs
videos.overview: Dave talks about his recent trip to the dentist.  Later, Stephanie ""Monty"" Birkett dresses up as a princess for ""CBS Mailbag.""

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon, Kristanna Loken, Dax, Chloe Sevigny, Bill Scheft, Rufus Wainwright
videos.overview: Jimmy Fallon of ""SNL"" fame sings an original composition about December-May relationships.  Later, he chats with Chloe Sevigny and ""Late Show"" writer Bill Scheft.

videos.title: Lisa Marie Presley, Ryan Pinkston
videos.overview: Dave half-jokingly announces his candidacy for Ohio's seat in the US Senate, then flirts with Lisa Marie Presley.

videos.title: Allison Janney, Nigella Lawson, Howard Tate
videos.overview: George Clarke and Dave play ""Would You Like To Ride In Our Freight Elevator?""  Later, Dave welcomes an elderly (if not faithful) fan who made it to the audience after watching the show every night for 15 years.

videos.title: Barry Zito, Mandy Moore, Grandaddy
videos.overview: Cy Young Award-winning pitcher Barry Zito stands on the roof of the Broadway Theater, throwing baseballs at the Ed Sullivan Theater windows.  Later, Grandaddy performs ""Now It's On.""

videos.title: Ari Fleischer, Beyonce Knowles
videos.overview: Steph/Monty dresses up as a cowgirl for CBS Mailbag; Ari Fleishcher talks about his 2 1/2 years as Dubya's press secretary; Beyonce sings her smash hit ""Crazy In Love.""

videos.title: Jeff Bridges, Alan Harvey, Joseph Arthur
videos.overview: Dave ventures into the audience for yet another round of ""Know Your Current Events;"" Jeff Bridges promotes the movie ""Seabiscuit.""

videos.title: National Hollerin' Champions, Kristin Davis, Jane's Addiction

videos.title: Joaquin Phoenix, Blues Traveler
videos.overview: Following last night's performance by Jane's Addiction, ""Mr. S"" (Paul) hires backup dancers for the CBS Orchestra; Osama offers condolences to Saddam; Ten baseball greats present a special Top Ten about the perks of being in the Hall of Fame.

videos.title: Sylvester Stallone, Ben Curtis
videos.overview: Stephanie, dressed as a jockey, counts off the letters for ""CBS Mailbag."" (Her horse has its own way of signifying ""number two."")  Later, British Open champion Ben Curtis shoots golf balls off the roof of the theater.

videos.title: Denis Leary, Queens of the Stone Age
videos.overview: Dave wants to know if the 500 feet of co-axial cable being used in tonight's ""Will It Float?"" is coiled or not.  When he finds out that it is coiled, he demands it to be uncoiled.  Later, Queens of the Stone Age perform their hit ""Go With The Flow.""

videos.title: Jesse Grabow, Jason Biggs, Robert C. Nichol
videos.overview: Dave meets a six-year-old bowling phenom; Jason Biggs promotes the movie ""American Wedding.""

videos.title: Eugene Levy, Eels

videos.title: Seann William Scott, Jonathan Ames, Fountains of Wayne
videos.overview: As a tribute to George Miller, Dave repeatedly uses his favorite catch phrase, ""In my pants!""  Meanwhile, a commercial that Dave taped reveals that California governor Gray Davis once beat a man to death with a crowbar in a convinence store.

videos.title: Melanie Griffith, Pamela Reed
videos.overview: Dave thinks somebody is ""monkeying"" with his chair; Stephanie dresses up as a mountie; Alan debuts his new show ""You're Busted!"" during CBS Mailbag.

videos.title: Naomi Watts, Jeff Stilson, O.A.R.

videos.title: Kate Hudson, Cast of Camp

videos.title: Colin Farrell, Robert Randolph & The Family Band

videos.title: Samuel L. Jackson, Rick Reilly, Pharrell with Clipse

videos.title: Brittany Murphy, Carey Hart, Dashboard Confessional

videos.title: David Duchovny, Brett Butler, The New Amsterdams

videos.title: Bill Murray, Pete Sampras

videos.title: David Spade, Bob Sarlatte, Maroon 5
videos.overview: Venus and Serena Williams present a special Top Ten list.  Later, David Spade promotes ""Dickie Roberts: Former Child Star.""

videos.title: Tony Hawk, John McEnroe, Rooney

videos.title: Craig Kilborn, Dave Salmoni, Kings of Leon
videos.overview: Kings of Leon perform their breakthrough hit, "Molly's Chambers."

videos.title: Gen. Tommy Franks, Rodney Crowell

videos.title: Nicolas Cage, Alton Brown
videos.overview: "CBS Mailbag," including Stephanie dressed as Batman, "CBS Vice President of Late Night Programming Vinnie Favale," and "George W. Bush" (Gerard).

videos.title: Whoopi Goldberg, Vic Henley, Ima Robot
videos.overview: Paul's "Stump the Band" losing streak continues; Whoopi Goldberg promotes her new sitcom.

videos.title: Salma Hayek, Chris Elliott

videos.title: Sharon Stone, The Raveonettes

videos.overview: Steph/Monty dresses up as Don Mattingly for CBS Mailbag; she closes the segment by playing catch with Dave.

videos.title: Cuba Gooding Jr., Simon & Garfunkel

videos.overview: Miss America 2004 Ericka Dunlap presents the Top Ten List; Dave tells the story of his weekend encounter with a bear at his house in Montana; Dr. Phil gives Dave some parenting tips.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Elvis Costello
videos.overview: Ben Stiller talks about his new movie, Duplex; Elvis Costello performs a song from his new CD, North.

videos.title: The Rock, Lynne Cheney
videos.overview: Cold opening: The Rock shows Lynne Cheney how to apply a "chicken wing" to Paul; New York Giants kicker Matt Bryant attempts rooftop field goals across 53rd Street.

videos.overview: Paul asks "Survivor 7" castaway Ryan "Skinny" Shoulders (who is wearing a Rage Against The Machine t-shirt) if he digs Audioslave; Denzel Washington promotes Out of Time; The New York Philharmonic performs "The Marriage of Figaro" atop the roof of the Ed Sullivan Theatre building.

videos.title: Tom Cavanagh, Ray Wald, Dido
videos.overview: It's time for "How Many Guys in Gorilla Suits Can Fit Into a Eyeglass Store?"  Quote Dave: "I was going to buy a pair of eyeglasses, but the optical store was full of gorillas."

videos.title: Tim Robbins, Sting
videos.overview: The latest role call reveals that Michele O'Callaghan's five-month-old daughter (named "Zoogie") picks Dave's ties; Dave and Paul are dumbfounded by a pitching machine in a new game called "What Is It?"; Tim Robbins plugs "Mystic River"; Pat Farmer destroys the pitching machine.

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Lisa Kudrow, R.E.M.

videos.title: Jessica Simpson, Rufus Wainwright
videos.overview: Jessica Simpson mentions that she was on Oprah recently, much to Dave's chagrin; fill-in bandleader Todd Rundgren sings "Hello It's Me;" Pat Farmer drops 20,000 ping-pong balls from the roof.

videos.title: Uma Thurman, Ricky Gervais, Renee Fleming
Amy Sedaris, Tom Dreesen, Anthony Hamilton

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, John Mayer
videos.overview: During CBS Mailbag, Alan has an awkward reunion with the first girl that ever kissed him, and "Ah-nuld" (Gerard) has an enlightened conversation with Dave.  Later, Charlie Sheen promotes "Two and a Half Men."

videos.title: John Cusack, Scott Dixon, Hot Hot Heat

videos.title: Katie Holmes, Brian Greene, Jonny Lang

videos.title: Dustin Hoffman, Jamie Oliver
videos.overview: Ten US Soldiers in Iraq present the Top Ten via satellite; Dustin Hoffman plugs "The Runaway Jury," British chef Jamie Oliver cooks some scallops.

videos.title: Darrell Hammond, Radiohead
videos.overview: For CBS Mailbag, Steph/Monty dresses up as a soccer player and kicks balls (poorly) into the audience.  Later, Radiohead performs "2+2=5."

videos.title: Kiefer Sutherland, Emmylou Harris
videos.overview: Paul sneezes during the monologue; the band area is remodeled; Biff makes his annual report from the World Series; a 1,030-pound pumpkin explodes (via SFX) outside.

videos.title: Courteney Cox, Doris Roberts
videos.overview: Dave announces that he's been transferred to Chesterton, Indiana; on tonight's "Meet the Governor," a young Ah-nuld ogles an exotic dancer; Courtney Cox Arquette almost sings TLC's "Waterfalls;" after a one-day rain delay, a real pumpkin explodes.

videos.title: Keanu Reeves, Sue Johanson
videos.overview: Steph/Monty dresses up as an elf on a rare Wednesday CBS Mailbag; during Mailbag, Rupert takes part in his yearly tradition of watching the coleslaw change colors; Dave is so fascinated by Canadian "sexpert" Sue Johanson that he interviews her twice.

videos.title: Eric McCormack, Dante Hall
videos.overview: The Slapinski Brothers, world-class jugglers, interrupt the monologue; Dave points out that Rupert was on last night's episode of "Ed"; Dante Hall of the Kansas City Chiefs catches a football on 53rd Street.

videos.title: Pamela Anderson, Amanda Lollar, Bubba Sparxx
videos.overview: Amongst this year's "New Halloween Costumes": a George Foreman grill, the button on the remote control that you never use, and the "Queer Eye" fab five.  Also, Rosie Perez delivers Paul's cape for his weekly, blues-induced breakdown.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Amy Brenneman
videos.overview: Dave gives a recap of the events leading up to -- and including -- the birth yesterday of son Harry Joseph Letterman; "Indian Larry" performs motorcycle stunts on 53rd Street; Regis continues his string of appearances tied to memorable occasions; Amy Brennaman chats about the 100th episode of "Judging Amy."

videos.title: Will Ferrell, Jack McKeon, Lyle Lovett
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Steph/Monty dresses up a police officer, while Dave tries to make some sense out of "Liza Minnelli" (Gerard in fishnet stockings).  Later, it is revealed that the winner of the "Guess the Name of Dave's Baby Contest" is Dave himself.

videos.title: Howard Stern, Iggy Pop with Sum 41
videos.overview: Amongst the "New Catalogs": Harry & David Pre-Owned Fruit, Victoria's Secret for Monkeys, and special edition of California Style in which all the models have been groped by Arnold Schwarzenegger; Howard Stern mentions to Dave that the impersonator that regularly calls into his show is a big fan and meant no harm; Iggy Pop featuring Sum 41 perform "Little Know It All."

videos.title: Lauren Graham, Paul Tracey, Wyclef Jean
videos.overview: An elf named Perry helps out during "Know Your Current Events"; Bert and Ernie (of "Sesame Street" fame) diss Dave; Lauren Graham talks about a recent parking ticket.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald, Jack Hannah

videos.title: Madonna, Chris Elliot
videos.overview: Cold Opening: Dave compliments Madonna's latest children's book: "I like the picture of the monkey."  Also, Chris Elliott introduces Dave's son Harry, who says his first words: "S***."

videos.title: Russell Crowe, Pink
videos.overview: A sheep herder walks into the theater with his flock along side him; Pink sings "Trouble."

videos.title: Jessica Lynch, Shelby Lynne
videos.overview: During "Know Your Current Events," a visiting audience member from Liverpool, England is quizzed on his knowledge of Prince Charles.  Later, potential Minnesota gubernatorial candidate Al Franken delivers Paul's cape.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Cate Blanchett

videos.title: Dakota Fanning, Rocco DiSpirito, Cast of Wicked

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Freddy Adu, Cyndi Lauper
Wesley Clark

videos.title: Paul Newman, Clay Aiken
videos.overview: Biff spends a day on the campaign trail with Howard Dean; Gerard stands in for unavailable Survivor loser Rupert Boneham; Paul Newman discusses all things auto racing; Clay Aiken sings "Invisible" from his CD Measure Of A Man.

Also, Dave has yet another rant about Paris Hilton, claiming that she won't be on because a "no-good weasel, beady-eyed putz publicist" told her not to appear. "He's lower than pond scum," Dave observes, then later he calls him a nitwit and a knuckle-dragging neanderthal.

videos.title: Mike Myers, Jay-Z
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Harold Larkin tries a new product, then, in honor of Thanksgiving, starts bleeding gravy; Mike Myers plugs The Cat in the Hat.

videos.title: Danny DeVito, Tim Russert

videos.title: Amanda Peet, Barry Sonnenfeld
videos.overview: During Mailbag, the voices in Alan's head result in the horrific demise of his precious ceramic figure collection.  Also, upon reading an article in Time about Oprah's refusal to have Dave on her show, he suggests a "Super Bowl of Love" with Dr. Phil reconciling the talk show hosts.

videos.title: Julia Roberts, Alkaline Trio
videos.overview: Dave announces that he's been invited to appear on Oprah (at long, long last), while Julia Roberts interrogates Dave for his inability to marry the mother of his child.

videos.title: Liv Tyler, John Witherspoon, Alicia Keys

videos.overview: During Mailbag, Dave tries to make sense out of "Saddam Hussein" (Gerard), while a reindeer takes a dump onstage.  Also, Neve Campbell promotes the upcoming Robert Altman film "The Company," while Wellwater Conspiracy performs "Wimple Witch."

videos.title: Charlize Theron, Dave Matthews
videos.overview: During "Audience Show & Tell," a man recites the names of all 50 states in alphabetical order in just fifteen seconds.  Also, Golden Globe nominee Charlize Theron promotes "Monster."

videos.title: Steve Martin, Shannon Eis
videos.overview: Dave mentions some strange advice his mother gave him about Harry: "Well, David, I think it would be nice if one day he joined a gang."  Also, "The Kalter Brothers" sing "The Little Drummer Boy" without incident, and Steve Martin talks about the burden of being beautiful.

videos.title: Renee Zellweger, Darlene Love
videos.overview: It's the annual "Holiday Night" on the Late Show: Paul does his impersonation of Cher singing "O Holy Night;" Jay Thomas successfully dethrones the objects on top of the Late Show Christmas Tree; for the nineteenth year in a row, Darlene Love (featuring Bette Sussman and a 26-piece orchestra) performs "Christmas (Baby, Please Come Home)."

videos.title: Jennifer Aniston, Ryan Adams
videos.overview: Dave brings out Biff and thanks him, Paul, the USO and a variety of soldiers for making the Christmas Eve trip to Baghdad possible; in the premiere edition of "Will It Explode?" Pat Farmer throws 18 industrial-size cans of chocolate and butterscotch pudding off the roof; Parents magazine calls Dave "America's Most Moronic Father."

videos.title: Eddie Griffin, Marv Albert
videos.overview: Dave celebrate's Steph/Monty's birthday with a cake that reads "Happy Birthday Tammi!"  Also, recent baseball Hall of Fame inductees Paul Molitor and Dennis Eckersley present the Top Ten.

videos.title: Nathan Lane, Ruben Studdard
videos.overview: During his interview with Nathan Lane, Dave suggests to Paul that they should perform together in the musical "The Producers."  Also, Ruben Stoddard performs "Sorry 2004."

videos.title: Billy Bob Thornton
videos.overview: It's time for another round of "Stump the Band," and as usual Paul does his Carnac schtick; ten interns present the Top Ten; Billy Bob Thornton describes his short-lived tenure as the assistant manager of a pizza parlor; The Darkness performs "I Believe In a Thing Called Love."

videos.title: Patricia Heaton, Kate Bosworth
videos.overview: Dave goes on a rant about Jay Leno's appearance on CBS' "People's Choice Awards" home site, while Dick Gephardt presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Jeff Daniels, Isaiah Thomas, The Shins
Bette Midler, Howie Day
videos.overview: Mailbag: Alan gets clobbered by an angry Irishman, George Clarke takes a shower with former basketball star Manute Bol, and Steph/Monty gives heart surgery fun facts.  Also, Howie Day performs "She Says."

videos.title: Dave Chapelle, Carmen Electra
videos.overview: Throughout the night, foreigners tell jokes; Dave and Paul play a new game called "Mars or Nevada?" then come to agree that it's utterly stupid; Al Roker presents the Top Ten; Carmen Electra promotes her new striptease-workout video.

videos.title: Christina Aquilera, Gary Muledeer
videos.overview: During "Audience Show & Tell," a woman from Texas shows off photos of her Chinese hairless in various costumes; Dave reads a fan letter from someone whose life depends upon "Will It Float?"; Christina Aguilera sings "Walk Away."

videos.title: Jessica Simpson & Nick Lachey, Al Green
videos.overview: Stephanie demonstrates her ex-boyfriend's lackluster dancing abilities once more; John McEnroe does the Top Ten and promotes his new talk show at the same time; Gavin MacLeod makes a guest appearance in "Potatoes or Gavin MacLeod?"; by the end of the show, Steph, Gavin, and John are dancing together.

videos.title: Ashton Kutcher, Paula Abdul
videos.overview: Singer-songwriter John Mayer sits in; Dave shows footage of Howard Dean's head exploding; in the latest edition of "Pat Farmer's Gaffe Alert," our favorite film-loving stagehand points out that the entire cast of Casablanca is now dead.

videos.title: Kristin Davis, Joe Simpson
videos.overview: Dave does a really bad Howard Dean impression; during Mailbag, Rupert puts a ruined slice of turkey in the soup of the day; Dave chats with a mountain climber with an epic story of survival.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Jim Garvin
videos.overview: Dave shows several photos that answer the question "What's the Deal with Donald Trump's Hair?;" Howard Dean presents the Top Ten live via satellite from New Hampshire.

videos.title: Al Franken, Jake Johannsen, Phantom Planet
videos.overview: Al Franken comments on his trip to Iraq; Phantom Planet performs "Big Brat."

videos.title: Regis Philbin, The Thrills
videos.overview: Dave mentions the passing of influential late night great Jack Paar; Biff introduces his annual "Biff at the Super Bowl" segment; Bill DeLace does another Top Ten remote, this time from a nearby Starbucks.

videos.title: Harry Connick Jr., Sean Astin
videos.overview: Dave announces that after 22 years on the wagon, he would like to start drinking again, but only during the show.  Later, he wishes Oprah a belated happy 50th birthday.

videos.title: Bill Belichick, Cindy Crawford
videos.overview: Dave mentions that water is not running in the building for the time being; during Mailbag, Pat Farmer tortures a stagehand with a George Foreman Grill; Dave shows a (bogus) clip of Barbara Walters topless.

videos.title: Hilary Swank, Todd Barry, Nellie McKay
videos.overview: Dave recaps last night's accident on 53rd Street: snowboarder Tara Dakides slid off a landing platform and fell to the pavement.  She was taken to New York's Bellevue Hospital, and was treated for injuries.  The audience was informed of the incident, and taping for the evening's two shows was cancelled.

videos.title: Dr. Phil, Tara Dakides, Clip of The Beatles
videos.overview: Dave chats with snowboarder Tara Dakides, whose accident during a demonstration on 53rd Street cancelled the taping of last Thursday's episode.  Also, in honor of the 40th Anniversary of Beatlemania, Paul does an Ed Sullivan impression, while Dave shows the entire clip of the Fab Four performing for the first time in this very theater.

videos.title: Drew Barrymore, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Rupert selects a 53rd Street Loser to play "What Did Merv Have For Lunch;" Drew Barrymore and Jack Hanna remain clothed during their segments.

videos.title: Adam Sandler, Eve
videos.overview: Dave tries out a new catchphrase: "Ba da boom, ba da bing."  Also, Steph/Monty dresses up a 1980s-era Olympic hockey player, and Dave goes back to calling her "Smitty."

videos.title: Bill Murray, Jermaine O'Neal
videos.overview: Throughout the night, the CBS Orchestra plays songs by Air Supply; Dave mentions that the continent of Australia has demanded to see that clip of the monkey washing a cat; Bill Murray gets a "Dave" tattoo on his arm.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin, Sofia Coppola, Kylie Minogue
videos.overview: This week's "Will It Float?" item is a box of chocolates; Alec Baldwin and Sofia Coppola visit; Kylie Minogue performs "Red Blooded Women."

videos.title: Stupid Human Tricks, Ray Romano, Kayne West
videos.overview: Dave makes fun of a new commercial, and the clip is repeated throughout the broadcast; during "Stupid Human Tricks," a man stuffs his mouth with a tennis ball; Ray Romano promotes Welcome to Mooseport.

videos.title: Kelly Ripa, Lindsay Lohan
videos.overview: Leon Russell sits in; Dave is still fascinated by a quote from last night's film trailer ("If you need help, here I am") and repeats it several times throughout the show; Dale Earnhardt, Jr. and Kelly Ripa both attempt parallel parking.

videos.title: Ashley Judd, Ben Harper
videos.overview: Mailbag: Steph/Monty/Smitty is dressed up as Dale Earnhardt, Jr., while "Senator John Kerry" (Gerard) brags about the perks of being married to the heir of a ketchup empire.  Also, a Mongolian throat chanter performs on "Is This Anything?" but nobody seems all that impressed.

videos.title: Gordon Geisbrecht, Sarah Jessica Parker, Nelly Furtado
videos.overview: Noted hypothermia expert Dr. Gordon Geisbrecht jumps into a tank of icewater to demonstrate its effects; the US Senate announces that when referring to George W. Bush, "president" will be used in quotation marks; Dave shows the audience a new photo of little Harry.

videos.title: Amber Tamblyn, Brian Regan, Leona Naess
videos.overview: During "Audience Show & Tell," Dave meets a former White House intern; George Clarke fills in for Kiva "Grinder Girl" Kahl during "Will It Float?"; comedian Brian Regan comments on psychics.

videos.title: Jeff Goldblum, Norah Jones
videos.overview: Demolition demo (shut down by Hizzoner Bloomberg's office) on 53rd St. turns into Pat Farmer dropping stuff off the roof; Survivor loser Rob Cesternino drops by Rupert's; Jeff Goldblum visits; Norah Jones sings "What Am I To You?"

videos.title: Edie Falco, Steven Bailey, Edie Brickell
videos.overview: It's "Steve and Edie" night on the Late Show: Edie Falco promotes the upcoming fifth season of "The Sopranos;" Dave meets Steven Bailey of "My Big Fat Obnoxious FiancÃ©" fame; Edie Brickell (making her first LS appearance in nearly 10 years)promotes her latest solo album.

videos.title: Diane Sawyer, Benjamin McKenzie
videos.overview: Stephanie/Monty/Smitty is in dentist garb (and Dave-ordered model posture) for "CBS Mailbag;" Diane Sawyer gushes over Oprah Winfrey's 50th birthday party; Benjamin McKenzie ("The O.C.") visits.

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, Tim Robbins, Evanescence
videos.overview: Dave shows an (bogus) political ad in which Dennis Kucinich announces he's marrying Lorenzo Lamas; in an all-dog edition of "Stupid Pet Tricks," one canine says hello to Dave; Ernest Borgnine presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Bill Cosby, Toby Lightman
videos.overview: On "Audience Show & Tell," Dave make his contribution to an audience member's collection of gum chewed by celebrities; "Will It Float?" sinks a tray of billiard balls; Bill Cosby does stand-up; Lou Reed capes; Toby Lightman sings.

videos.title: Anne Heche, Cee-Lo
videos.overview: The studio audience votes Dave off the show, so Gaines orders Paul to take over during "Survivor Loser."  When Dave reappears during Paul's interview with Richard Hatch, Paul goes to a commercial.  Later, a miffed (and naked) Hatch walks into the backdrop during Anne Heche's visit.

videos.title: Turkey Callers, Julia Stiles, Jessica Simpson
videos.overview: National Turkey Calling champs are trotted out; Ryan Seacrest presents the "Top Ten Catch Phrases Ryan Seacrest Rejected Before 'Seacrest Out!'" (via satellite); Julia Stiles visits; Jessica Simpson sings.

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Robert Rudolph and The Family Band
videos.overview: During Mailbag, Biff goes to bed with a guy named Cameron Diaz; George Clarke fills in for Anna Jack on hula hoop; Alan admits to a $1000-a-week addiction to Vicodin; Robert Randolph and the Family Band brings the house down with "Going In The Right Direction."

videos.title: Viggo Mortensen, Sting, Bill Murray
videos.overview: Dave announces that he's on steroids, then shows before-and-after photos to prove his point; Biff goes on a cruise; the outside cam finds Bill Murray lying in the gutter, a desperate and broken man; "Oprah" (Pat Farmer) interviews "Beyonce" (Kenny Sheehan).

videos.title: Charles Grodin, Chloe Pang
videos.overview: Twelve-year-old piano prodigy Chloe Pang plays Bach's "Goldberg Variations."  Dave is almost brought to tears by the performance, declaring it one of the show's best.

videos.title: Jim Carrey, Steve Winwood
videos.overview: Dave points out that for the nineteenth year in a row, the WMDB/CBS Orchestra will be the house band for the Rock n' Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremonies; Dave and Les Moonves chat via telephone; Jim Carrey and Dave attempt a "talk show without talk" that only lasts about 47 seconds.

videos.title: Kate Winslet, Bruce McCall, The Vines
videos.overview: After two weeks of plugging their product, Dave shows a single Shick Quattro razor the company sent, and reads a very peculiar letter to Gaines from someone in the company; the Top Ten is now sponsored by myheadhurts.com; Canadian satirist Bruce McCall promotes his new book; The Vines perform "Ride."

videos.title: Tom Hanks, N.E.R.D.
videos.overview: Cold opening: Tom Hanks gives Harry Letterman an Oscar, and Dave accepts it on his behalf.  Later, the Ladykillers star gives the absentee infant a $50 savings bond, while Congressman Dennis Kucinich presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx, Al Franken
videos.overview: All-American basketball player Andre Barrett throws various items off the roof, aiming towards a basketball hoop at ground level, the misses the basket on all six chances.  Also, Al Franken promotes his upcoming liberal-friendly radio network.

videos.title: Ricky Gervais, Blondie
videos.overview: Mailbag: George Clarke's attempt at surgically losing weight is thwarted when some guy steals his clothes.  Also, Blondie performs "Good Boys."

videos.title: Janet Jackson, John Mayer
videos.overview: Throughout the night, Columbia University professor and 1999 Nobel laureate in economics Dr. Robert Mundell tells lame redneck jokes; Bill DeLace presents another hidden-camera remote Top Ten; Janet Jackson is grilled at length by Dave on her "wardrobe malfunction" at this year's Super Bowl.

videos.title: Matthew Perry, Lou Reed
videos.overview: After weeks of shilling their product, Dave finally receives a thousand Schick Quattro razors in the mail, then promises to give them out to the audience.  Unfortunatly, Gaines and Laurie Diamond tell Dave that the staff has already taken their fair share of the razors.  Later in the show, he compensates by having Rupert, the Hi-Ho girls, and a British guy giving candy and razors to the audience.

videos.title: Johnny Knoxville, Sahr Singh, The Walkmen
The Rock, Liz Phair
videos.overview: A minor controversy that started earlier in the week is resolved by a very apologetic CNN anchorwoman (see recap).  Also, Dave congratulates Craig Kilborn on five years at CBS.

videos.title: Tyler Crotty, Michael Imperioli, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: Audience Show & Tell: a husband and wife tandem demonstrates a neat trick involving a yo-yo and a shiny quarter.  Also, Dave chats with Tyler Crotty, the tired pre-teen who has been at the center of a minor controversy on the Late Show for the last week.  For appearing on the show, Dave gives Tyler several cans of Red Bull.   Also, very tall man(Paul Olkowski) gives Dave a one arm hug before he shows a "glory day" highlight from 12 years ago when he sank a full-court shot on ESPN.

videos.title: Bruce Willis, Renee Askins
videos.overview: The Top Ten list is now sponsored by rake-attack.com, while Bruce Willis shows off his new, stealthy, Trump-style hairpiece.

videos.title: Billy Crystal, Alex Rodriguez
videos.overview: Alan brings a video of celebrity well-wishers for Dave's 57th birthday (just a tape of a fleeing Regis); it's "More With Les," as Dave phones up CBS-TV head honcho Les Moonves; Billy Crystal plugs his new children's book; "A-Rod" chats, then jacks a few balls with Dave on 53rd Street.

videos.title: Chris Rock, The Upside Down Act
videos.overview: Biff makes his annual trip to Spring Training, where he for the second year in a row, he and Hideki Matsui perform Abbott & Costello's "Who's on First?" routine; Jerry turns Dave upside down to preview Kai Leclerc's gravity-defying juggling act; "Dwight the Troubled Teen" makes another visit to Alan's booth.

videos.title: Amy Sedaris, Damien Rice
videos.overview: Mailbag: After noticing that a letter-writer misspelled his name, Paul comes with a homonym for his moniker, resulting in a rival homonym from Biff.  Also, Dave kisses a donkey, while Ruben Stoddard presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: David Duchovny, Chris Russo
videos.overview: In the "season finale" of "Trump or Monkey?," a dancer from the musical Hairspray wins an alleged trip to Acapulco; David Duchovny discusses his son's linguistic skills; after getting bumped twice in the last year, NYC sportscaster Chris "Mad Dog" Russo is finally grilled by Dave.

videos.title: Phil Mickelson, Kathryn Morris, Patti Smith
videos.overview: Phil Mickelson brags about his victory at the 2004 Masters; James Lipton delivers Paul's cape.

videos.title: Megan Mullally, Eli Manning, Diana Krall
videos.overview: al-Qaeda takes responsibility for Derek Jeter's batting slump; Dave resurrects his two favorite Cold Mountain sound clips; stuntman "Magic Brian" eats a lightbulb.

videos.title: Andy Richter, Davy Rothbart, Mary Chapin Carpenter
videos.overview: Dave declares that the new mission statement for the Late Show will be "We are here for you. We'll make things better." Also, Rupert hosts the debut edition of "Stop the Pump," a game involving pumping fuel at a gas station on the corner of 44th and 10th in Manhattan.

videos.title: Julianne Moore, Robert Klein, Todd Rundgren
videos.overview: Dave announces that he's going to be "more dynamic," resulting in spasm-like movements by him and Paul; to accompany Steph/Monty/Smitty dressing as Amelia Earhart for Mailbag, Dave repeatedly orders to hear airplane SFX inbetween letters; Julianne Moore tells Dave what it's like to kiss Barbara Walters.

videos.title: Kelly Ripa, Jennie Finch
videos.overview: The theater audience is given the option of either having Tom Hanks drop by or watch stock footage of a camel on skis.  Dave claims the camel tape won.  Also, Dave thinks he's addicted to Bexstra, claiming "the inside of me itches."

videos.title: Hillary Clinton, The Roots
videos.overview: An audience member turns her hand 360 degrees; Hillary Clinton discusses her husband's book and the war in Iraq; The Roots perform "Don't Say Nuthin'."

videos.title: Stupid Pet Tricks, David Spade, Loretta Lynn & Jack White
Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen, Adam Brody
videos.overview: Nobel Economics Prize winner Robert Mundell tells "Yo Mama" jokes; a woman off the street pretends to be in an earthquake with Rupert; Survivor All-Stars loser Shii-Ann Huang presents the Top Ten.

videos.title: Diving Dogs, Tina Fey, Morgan Spurlock
Kelsey Grammar, Orchestra Baobob with Trey Anastasio and Dave Matthews
videos.overview: Ten celebrity moms (including Dorothy and Gerard as "Betty Lou Roberts") present the Top Ten, and later the faux mother of Julia Roberts delivers Paul's cape.

videos.title: Amber Brkich, Regis Philbin, Black-Eyed Peas
videos.overview: Dave announces that motorcyclist "Johnny McCoy" will be performing a very dangerous and complicated stunt out on 53rd Street, but it ends up getting cancelled; Dave makes Jerry play the airplane SFX again; it turns out Johnny McCoy can't even ride a motorcycle; Dave, Regis, and Paul weigh themselves.

videos.title: Amy Sedaris, Modest Mouse
videos.overview: A special edition of the show taped in the middle of the night. Dave arrives on horseback; vermin expert Robert Sullivan searches for rats; Dave shows footage of Eric Stangel trying to call Bob Borden from his apartment/hotel room; ten nighthawks present the Top Ten; Amy Sedaris takes a tour of her West Village neighborhood.

videos.title: Charlie Sheen, Jack Hanna
videos.overview: Chef Emil Castillo makes a $1000 frittata (read: omelet), and when completed, Dave smothers it with ketchup; Dave pays tribute to Tony Randall, who passed on that morning; Dave resolves a tickle in his throat with a bottle of Tanqueray.

videos.title: Kiefer Sutherland, Incubus
videos.overview: Dave gives Steph/Monty/Smitty another weird nickname ("Gunther") while baseball star Randy "Big Unit" Johnson presents a perfect game-themed Top Ten.

videos.title: Ellen DeGeneres, The Strokes
videos.overview: Dave claims he has a rare form of tuberculosis, and that a Dave stand-in is waiting backstage for when the time comes; Kiva "Grinder Girl" Kahl reports from her apartment in Brooklyn to discuss a recent leg injury; Gary Mintz fills in for Kiva during "Will It Float?"; The Strokes perform "The End Has No End."

videos.title: Nicole Kidman, Avril Lavigne
videos.overview: Dave's stand-in is still waiting for his cue; Dave demands to hear the airplane and Cold Mountain SFX again; the stars of The Sopranos perform the Top Ten; Nicole Kidman makes her first appearance on the show in three years.

videos.title: Dennis Quaid, Velvet Revolver
videos.overview: Dave congratulates Sid McGinnis on becoming a grandfather; karate expert Leif Becker attempts to break 500 boards in a minute, but ends up tying his personal record of 415; ten NBA legends present the Top Ten; for the fourth show in a row, the credits roll over footage of Alan presenting flowers to an unknown woman.

videos.title: Mandy Moore, Nate Erwin, Counting Crows
videos.overview: Mailbag: Steph/Smitty/Gunther is dressed up as Rahal/Letterman racer Buddy Rice; the upcoming cable channel "Logo" declares the Late Show "the gayest show on television;" Dave is interrupted by "Gerry the Cicada" Mulligan, who attempts to dance the Lambada.  Later, Gerry is invited back onstage to eat actual cicadas with Dave, Paul and bug expert Nate Erwin.

videos.title: Darrell Hammond, blink-182
videos.overview: Dave announces that he's had another falling-out with CBS, which may or may not give him the justification to mock the network again; hundreds of sailors walk onstage for "Is This Anything?"; Darrell Hammond performs his best impressions, plus a new imitation of Senator John Kerry.

videos.title: Andy Dick, Bob Woodward
videos.overview: A 1 1/2 pound Porterhouse steak is subjected to "Will It Float?" and despite Dave's scientific argument that a dead animal would more than likely float in water, the meat sinks.  Also, Bob Woodward discusses his new book and recent interview with George Bush.

videos.title: Bill Murray, P.J. Harvey
videos.overview: Dave brags about his Indy 500 win last week; Alan's recap of the first game of the NBA Finals turns into a striptease; Bill Murray announces that he's now moonlighting as a circus clown, wearing an outfit to prove it.

videos.title: Bette Midler, David Tidmarsh
videos.overview: In honor of one of tonight's guests (a spelling bee champ), Dave mentions that the most commonly used word in the English language is "biscuit"; a new game called "Cicada/Secada" is botched by Rupert's revealing of the game-board; Bette Midler promotes The Stepford Wives and discusses the joy of bowling.

videos.title: Buddy Rice, Christopher Walken, Kid Rock
videos.overview: Dave and Paul have a heated discussion over who would win a fight- "badass" Kid Rock or "nerves of steel" Buddy Rice; during Mailbag, Biff goes to Wisconsin to help out a law student, and ends up smashing a bottle over the kid's head; Dave tries on a racing helmet given to him by 2004 Indy 500 winner Buddy Rice.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick, Jamie Cullum
videos.overview: In honor of his death earlier that day, Paul and the band performs Ray Charles' "What'd I Say"; Dave sends Matthew Broderick outside to get hosed with water; jazz pianist Jamie Cullum performs "All at Sea."

videos.title: P. Diddy, Jim Gaffigan
videos.overview: Jim Gaffigan comments on married life and becoming a father for the first time. Also, Paul Anka delivers Paul's cape for this Friday night James Brown homage, then in honor of the retirement of the long-standing gag, performs a parody of "My Way."

videos.title: Paris Hilton, Patti Scalfa
videos.overview: Dave shows us another photo of Harry; Paris Hilton discusses The Simple Life and her now-infamous sex tape; Patti Scialfa (Mrs. Bruce Springsteen) performs "23rd Street Lullaby."

videos.title: Ben Stiller, Beastie Boys
videos.overview: To further promote Popeye's Green Beans, Dave and Paul eat Popeye's chicken and give fun facts; Ben Stiller attempts to break windows across the street with a dodge-ball, but ends up falling off the building.

videos.title: Michael Moore, Jennifer Hawkins, Los Lobos
videos.overview: Michael Moore discusses his infamous speech at the 2003 Oscars and promotes Fahrenheit 9/11; Dave tries on Miss Universe's sash and tiara; Los Lobos performs "Charmed."

videos.title: Larry Brown, Sean Hayes, Phish
videos.overview: Throughout the night, George Clarke eats fish sticks on the roof to honor a certain band performing on the marquee; for the third night in a row, Dave shows (well-edited) footage of a guy cheating on Jeopardy; Phish performs "Scents and Subtle Sounds" and unwittingly stops traffic in the process.

videos.title: Kevin Kline, Nicole Richie
videos.overview: Dave announces that he and Paul will be in this weekend's Gay Pride parade; past contestant Jennie Ford plays "Super Trump or Monkey;" Ken Griffey, Jr. presents the Top Ten; Nicole Richie (reality star and adopted daughter to Lionel Richie) tells Dave how she conquered heroin addiction.

videos.title: David Alan Grier, Britton Keeshan, the Von Bondies
Kid Inventors, Shawn Wayans, Secret Machines
videos.overview: During a "New Products" segment, Dave sinks his teeth into some charcoal briquets, which he swallows with mouthwash.  Also, The Secret Machines (in their TV debut) perform "Now Here to Nowhere."

videos.title: Bonnie Hunt, Dylan Moran
videos.overview: "Know Your Current Events" is played for the first time in over six months; Dave spills coffee on his lap, and Paul suggests hydrogen peroxide to clean it off; "Dwight the Troubled Teen" breaks character to remind people not to download illegally.

videos.title: Piedmont Bird Callers, Kirsten Dunst, Chris Robinson
videos.overview: Dave admits that after spending all weekend watching documentaries about building motorcycles, he wants a hog for himself.  At the end of the show, Dave forms a motorcycle "gang" with Paul, Dave Dorsett, and Chris Robinson of the Black Crowes.

videos.title: Keira Knightly, Joseph Wilson
videos.overview: A husband and wife combo plays the "Late Show Bill Clinton Memoir Challenge," in which they must find the name "Monica" in his new book within thirty seconds.  Later, Pat and Kenny recreate Oprah's recent interview with the former president.

videos.title: Ethan Hawke, Jon Heder
videos.overview: Dave turns on the hose-cam again, shooting water at unsuspecting passersby; during Mailbag, Dave shows footage from the new Spiderman movie (actually the classic 60's cartoon) of Doc Ock torturing Spidey with a clip from the Late Show; Jon Heder promotes Napoleon Dynamite.

videos.title: Will Ferrell, Dashboard Confessional
videos.overview: Two lumberjacks compete against each other out on 53rd Street, while Will Ferrell shows Dave a home movie of his four-month-old "baby" (a sports car).

videos.title: Christina Applegate, David Sedaris
videos.overview: The musical talents of Paul, Felecia, and Bruce are laid to waste once more on "Stump the Band"; "Fat Spider-Man" (George Clarke) presents a remote Top Ten; David Sedaris reads an except from his new book, Dress Your Family in Corduroy and Denim.

videos.title: Kristin Davis, Ali G
videos.overview: In the debut edition of "Where They Would Have Gone For Their Summer Vacation," Biff tells Dave that Charles Bronson would've gone to Mohegan Sun Casino in Connecticut; Jeopardy! super-contestant Ken Jennings presents the Top Ten; Dave admits to Kristen Davis that he was "watching hard" while viewing Sex & the City reruns on TBS.

videos.title: Will Smith, Jet
videos.overview: Dave continues to discuss motorcycles; Alan's baseball commentary is interrupted by the return of that guy who used to beat the daylights out of him several years back; to prove some sort of point, Will Smith sticks his butt in Dave's face.

videos.title: Hilary Duff, Jonathan Ames
videos.overview: Dave compares President Bush to Porky Pig; during Mailbag, a young, fairweather Letterman fan is thrown out of the theater; Hilary Duff promotes A Cinderella Story.

videos.title: Julianna Marguiles, Bob Sarlatte, Ashlee Simpson
videos.overview: Audience Show & Tell: Dave chats with a meteorologist from Connecticut who was once mentioned on "Know Your Current Events."  Also, Dorothy celebrates her 83rd birthday with a Dave stand-in and a refrigerator full of Red Bull and vodka.

videos.title: Denzel Washington, Jim Rome
videos.overview: Dave gloats over Rahal/Letterman Racing's visit to the White House earlier in the day; three stagehands attempt to smear a camera lens with sunscreen from 90 feet above street level; Denzel Washington promotes The Manchurian Candidate.

videos.title: Halley Berry, Maria Mena
videos.overview: In honor of the 35th anniversary of the moonwalk, it's time for a new game at Hello Deli called "Would You Like to Plant a Flag on the Moon?"  Rupert brings in a contestant from Yukon, Oklahoma, and Dave gives her a hard time about it.

videos.title: Matt Damon, Carmelo Anthony, The Hives
videos.overview: We watch news footage of Pete Rose's restaurant being looted of everything except a Late Show t-shirt; while addressing the Sandy Berger controversy, Dave unwittingly spits on Tony; The Hives perform "Walk Idiot Walk."

videos.title: Brittany Murphy, Paula Poundstone
videos.overview: An audience member from Cincinnati suspends a grape in air by blowing on it; Dave comments on Krispy Kreme's new doughnut shake, followed by a fake ad for Burger King's new liquid Whopper; Britney Murphy and Dave pinky-swear; troubled comedienne Paula Poundstone jokes about her time in detox.

videos.title: Holly Hunter, US Olympic Synchronized Swimming Team
John McEnroe, Zach Braff
videos.overview: With the Olympics approaching, Dave reminds the audience that he's on steroids; a standby audience member calls up Regis and tells him to shove it; Biff makes his second report from Boston; Dave scratches his chin in a borderline-offensive manner.

videos.title: Bob Newhart, 213 with Snoop Dogg
videos.overview: A remarkably ornery Dave attempts to apologize to Regis via telephone but hangs up on him, then answers every question on CBS Mailbag with a resilient "who cares?"  Also, Bob Newhart discusses the statue built in honor of him in Chicago and then does a fairly decent impression of Dr. Henry Kissinger.

videos.title: Natalie Portman, Ambulance LTD
videos.overview: Biff tries unsuccessfully to interview Michael Moore; Natalie Portman talks about sleeping with her dog Charlie; Ambulance Ltd. performs "Primative."

videos.title: Rosie Perez, Greg Giraldo
videos.overview: Anton (still filling in for Paul) plays "Will It Float?" for the first time; Rosie Perez tells a funny story about an actor who spits when he speaks; Alan Kalter asks Dave to talk about his latest love of his life, then gets beaten up by the women's brother.

videos.title: Pamela Anderson, Al Franken
